sanskrit: dvividhaṃ trividhaṃ ca pare jaguḥ taccaturbhedaṃ yatoṣṭavidhamucyate kumudakaṃ śeṣamaṣṭadhāṃśaṃ vibhajya tu aṃśenātha tribhirbhāgairvājanaṃ parikalpayet āttādhiṣṭhānatuṅge tu caturviṃśatibhāgike paṭṭikā kampaścaikaikāṃśād galaṃ dvayāt viprabandhamidaṃ proktaṃ cārubandhaṃ tathocyate kampaścaikaikaṃ kaṇṭhoṃ'śāvabjamaṃśataḥ cārubandhamadhiṣṭhānamidaṃ saṅkṛtibheditam [kam] ca vedāṃśaiḥ śeṣaṃ prāgiva puṣkalam vyāpikriyaṃ [g: yaṃ na pra] tat pratibandhakam sthāne vasvaṃśe bṛhadambujam ūrdhvapadmamathaikāṃśādāliṅgāntaritaṃ tribhiḥ śrībandhākhyamidaṃ proktaṃ devadvijanṛpocitam kumudaṃ prāgvat kampaṃ ca vājanam āliṅgāntaritaṃ dvyaṃśaṃ pratyunnatamathāṃśataḥ dvicaturyavapādārdhatripādāṃśavivardhanāt upānoparyupopānaṃ sapadmaṃ kampakaṃ tathā vedāśraḥ kumbhamaṇḍisamanvitaḥ aṣṭāśro viṣṇukāntākhyaḥ skandakāntaḥ ṣaḍaśrakaḥ ṣāḍaśāśraścandrakānto vṛttaścedīśakāntakaḥ kumbhamaṇḍyādisaṃyuktaṃ rudrakāntaṃ pracakṣate sabhadramadhyabhāgaśca bhadrakānto dvimaṇḍikaḥ iṣṭākārastathaivordhvaṃ tattatkāntāhvayo bhavet syānmūlacaturaśrākhyaḥ padmāpadmāsanaḥ smṛtaḥ

sa vijñeyo muktāstambhaḥ samauktikaḥ madhye ṣoḍaśāśrairalaṅkṛtaḥ evāṣṭāśrako madhye śrīkhaṇḍaḥ paṭṭabandhavān paṭṭakṣepaṇasaṃjñaḥ syāccaturaśrastripaṭṭadhṛk daṇḍapādākhyo vajrapādaḥ kalāśrakaḥ tribhāgaṃ ca bhittistambhavinirgamaḥ mūlabhūstambhavistāro hyaṣṭāviṃśatikāṅgulaḥ āttādhiṣṭhānatuṅgāt tu stambhotsedho dvidhā mataḥ mūlāgrayorvyāsatuṅgatā stambhakuḍyayoḥ kartavyā sthāpyāḥ [g: pāḥ] sarve tathāśmasu [kh: tma] pādoccanandabhāgād vā vasvaṃśād vedikocchrayaḥ citrakhaṇḍā śaivalā citraśaivalā vediḥ puṣpakhaṇḍeti kathyate citrakhaṇḍābhidhīyate ūrdhvādhaḥpadmapatrāḍhyā pāde pādāntare'pi ca saivādharordhvāmbujayorvetrayugmamanoramā [rtha] vedikāṃ naivacchindyādanyatra toraṇāt puṣpakhaṇḍā citrakhaṇḍā nṛṇāṃ dve vedike smṛte tribhāge syād vedāśroṃ'śastu mūlataḥ agrabhāgo'pi vedāśro bhavet stambheṣu keṣucit antyoṃ'śaḥ saptamāṃśono mūlavistārito bhavet sādhyardhāḥ pādahīnā vā dviguṇā vā bhavanti hi kumbhāścaturdhā syurvṛttānāṃ [g: vā] śrīkaro bhavet stambhānāṃ caturaśrāṇāṃ saumukhyaḥ kumbha iṣyate kumbhabhāge navāṃśe tu dhṛgekena vidhīyate

śiṣṭabhāgadvayaṃ tryaṃśaṃ kṛtvaikenāmbujaṃ bhavet stambhāgrakarṇamārgeṇa skandhaḥ syāt samavistṛtaḥ triguṇitaṃ caturguṇamathāpi vā maṇḍyutsedho bhavet tāvān vīrakāṇḍasya cocchrayaḥ sārdhena phalakāsthaulyaṃ tatsamo vetranirgamaḥ yajamānasukhāvaham prakāro'nyo dhṛkkaṇṭhāpādavistṛtiḥ [kh: ṇṭhaḥ] ambhojamālāsthānāni stambhāgre yojayet kramāt sāṣṭāṃśādhikamardhaṃ vā tripādodayamambujam bhavet pādāt triguṇo vā caturguṇaḥ tribhiraṃśaistripādairvā vīrakāṇḍaśca tatsamaḥ ca tatsamaṃ jñeyaṃ maṇḍyutsedhopapādakam potikā sthāpyā tasyā lakṣaṇamucyate pañcaguṇaṃ vāpi nīcamadhyottamā smṛtā nāmabhirjñeyāstāsāṃ lakṣaṇamucyate madhyamā syādūnadvyaṃśā kaniṣṭhikā sā khyātā citrapotikā potikā syāt taraṅgiṇī kāryāstūbhayatastulyāḥ paṭṭikācchannamadhyagāḥ tadardhārdhena tadadhaḥ kṣemacchāyānvitaṃ bhavet svavyāsārdhāt tripādād vā kuryāt tākhagramaṇḍanam geheṣu narāṇāṃ śubhadāḥ smṛtāḥ patrabandhaṃ tato rūpottaraṃ bhavet syādetasmāt pādonaṃ patrabandhakam nīcaṃ rūpottaramidaṃ bhavet

tadūrdhvāṃśadvayenāpi vedheyā padmapaṭṭikā tu kapotaṃ syādupānasamanirgamam kampakaṃ kuryācchiṣṭenāpyūrdhvapaṭṭikā tricatuṣpañcadaṇḍānāmāyāmastasya sammataḥ vājanasyopariṣṭāt tu kuryād bhāratulāvalim [g: lī] tāsāmapyūrdhve kuryājjayantikāḥ jayantyaścānumārgaḥ syād daṇḍārdhabahalaścitaḥ tulādvārānugatāḥ syustato'pi ca śilāmaye [g: yo] śilābhiḥ syādācchādyaṃ vājanopari vāpi nidrā vā daṇḍamucchritā varṇapaṭṭī ca tulāpādaśca tadgataḥ kapotaniryūhamutsedhaṃ bhinnaveṇuvat kapotālambanaṃ punaḥ potikādhastād gopānasyāstu lambanam tribhirvāṃśaistu bāhalyāṃ kampā yojyāḥ samantarā gopānanīprārdhād daṇḍikāniyamo bhavet caturāyatasaṃsthānamanumārgeṇa bandhayet muṣṭibandhaṃ tatpṛthag vājanopari pādāt pādavinirgatā tattuṅgatricaturbhāganirgamāt ūrdhvādhastalayorbūmeravadhiḥ pratireva hi devānāmardhendurvaiśyaśūdrayoḥ pratiḥ saśikharaṃ mukhapṛṣṭhaṃ pratidvayam pratyuparyeva dvāraṃ kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ stambhāyāme tu diṅnandavasusaptāṃśake kramāt

tadardhavistṛtaṃ ca syād dvāraṃ devālayeṣu vai vāṃśakaistribhiḥ labdhotsedhe tu diṅnandavasusaptāṃśake bhavet ardhamaṇḍanakastambhau dvārasyobhayapārśvayoḥ dvāravyāsoccamakhilamaṅgulicchedavarjitam rāmavṛddhāni manvāptāni vyayaḥ smṛtaḥ triṃśadāpte tu tithirvāraṃ ca saptabhiḥ mārgarūpatarustambhakoṇaviddhamaśobhanam dvāroccaśeṣe paccāṃśe bhavedaṃśadvayaṃ tvadhaḥ śreṣṭhamadhyādhamaṃ jñeyaṃ kramāt sarveṣu dhāmasu talpadaṇḍasya vistārastadardhaṃ taddhanaṃ bhavet bodhipatraṃ vāpyaśvaskandhanavākṛtiḥ kavāṭaṃ caiva yogaścāpyekajātitarūdbhavau ca syāt tasmānmiśraṃ na kārayet caturdhā syuryugmaṃ cāyugmameva ca kavāṭayugalābhyāṃ tu sthitābhyāṃ vāmadakṣiṇam sthitaṃ tvekamayugmākhyaṃ kapāṭakam kapāṭaṃ tad bhittigūḍhaṃ ca dhāvanam cānyeṣāṃ kavāṭāni bhavanti hi manuṣyāṇāṃ syādayugmābhireva hi syāt kathyate skandhapaṭṭikā nānārūpalatācitrā caturaśrā tu nirvraṇā skandhapaṭṭikā yugmapraveśe dakṣiṇāśritā śeṣamūrdhvaṃ kavāṭādermañjarībhiśca paṅkajaiḥ siṃhādibhirvyālairalaṅkuryād yathāruci

bhavecca talpavistārakarṇāyāmā tvayugmake parighāpādayostuṅgaṃ taddairghyād dviguṇaṃ bhavet sthūlā tvekatalpasya [g: katve yasya] cārgalā badhnīyād yathaiva sudṛḍhaṃ bhavet vā vṛtto vā syād yathābalam pañcānanopetaṃ kaṇṭhayugmaṃ yathārhataḥ kavāṭe yojayet samau syād daṇḍairdaṇḍopadhānakaiḥ kavāṭayogamadhyaṃ syāt tanmadhyaṃ bhittimadhyakam kramāccharāśvibhāge vā sthāpyo yogo'dhiko'ntare śeṣāṇāmupamadhye syād dvāroparyaṣṭamaṅgalam sārdhaṃ vā vistāro'pyanayormataḥ tadūrdhvottaradaṇḍārdhasatripādasamodayam pañcavaktrāṇi tāni syurdvidaṇḍoccāni madhyataḥ dvitrivedāṅgulaṃ yuktyā patrāṇāṃ vitatiḥ smṛtā dṛḍhapraveśāsyāt pārśvapatravicitritā tānyeva devānāmapi varṇinām dvārālaṅkṛtiścābhyadhāyi devadvijanṛpāṇāṃ tu śastaṃ makaratoraṇam pārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhataścāpi prakuryāt kuḍyatoraṇam vistārastadvyāse'tha śarāṃśake śobhāntaraṃ tatra guhāveśo bhavedapi nakrayorvadanāsaktamadhyapūrimamaṇḍitam makarasyottharatnamālādhiropitaiḥ tūbhayato bhavenmakaratoraṇam

nyasyennārīnarādīṃśca yathāśobhaṃ vicitritam syustatkuḍyaṃ pañcadhā smṛtam phalakāmayamapyantyaṃ mṛnmayaṃ cāparaṃ kramāt nānājālakaniṣpādyaṃ kuḍyaṃ yajjālakāmayam madhye kuḍyaṃ syāt phalakāmayam caturaśrāṃ vā kuḍyopari niyojayet tanmadhye kāryā kuḍyalatā tridhā padmāsanaṃ kuryāt tadūrdhvaṃ ca yathāruci patrairvinirgataiścitraṃ yathāśobhaṃ niyojayet kuryāt padmakumbhalatāyutam nakratoraṇavannyastā stambhakumbhalatā matā vijñeyā hi latā bhavet nandīśvaramahākālau pūrvadvārādhipau nyaset vāpyatha kaubere durgāṃ brahmāṇameva vā tu kṣetreśaṃ caiśagocare vinyaseduktalakṣaṇam dakṣiṇāmūrtiṃ vīrabhadramathāpi vā caivaṃ tṛtīye tu marudgaṇān gandharvānapyapsarasaḥ siddhān nāgāṃstathā munīn kaṇṭhādadhaḥ praterūrdhvaṃ koṇe koṇe vṛṣān nyaset kaṇṭhādadhaścāntyatale prākārādau ca vinyaset garbhārddhasamavistārā mahānāsāścaturdiśam kṣudranāsāstadardhād vā rāmāṃśād vāpi kārayet siṃhapañjaramādau syāt pañjaraṃ cārdhapañjaram tathā khaṇḍaniryūhajhaṣapañjaram

sūcipādadvayopetaṃ śliṣṭaprākāranīprakam tathā sammukhapaṭṭikam prāsādanīprasaṃśliṣṭakhanīprādardhanirgatam saśikharaṃ śaktidhvajasammukhapaṭṭikam ca vistārapādasammitanirgamam smṛtaṃ cātha svatulyaśikharāgrakam niryūhapañjaraṃ tvetallambanāsikamucyate yuktasarvāṅgaṃlambanāsikam nīprasaṃśritakarṇāṃśaṃ siṃhaśrotrābhidhānakam kapotādyaiḥ khaṇḍaniryūhakaṃ yutam kaṇṭhordhvatoraṇopetaṃ kapotādyaṅgasaṃyutam prāsādaṣaḍabhāgādaṃśaḥ śālā dvi gataḥ pañjarotsedhastadvibhāgo'tra kathyate prastarotsedhastatsamaḥ karṇakochrayaḥ tatstambhārdhādadhiṣṭhānaṃ śeṣeṇāpyupapīṭhakam toraṇaśālāyā mūlādhiṣṭhānato'rdhataḥ śālākūṭāntare śālāmadhye vā pañjaraṃ bhavet nāsīṃ tu na kurvīta kadācana sārdhaṃ vā dvitridaṇḍaṃ vā vedikoccaṃ prakalpayet prāgvadābhūṣya pādādau kuḍyabhūṣaṇam tricatuṣpañcadaṇḍaṃ vāpyuttarāntonnataṃ bhavet gavākṣaṃ ca gajākṣaṃ gulikā tathā jālānāṃ saptabhedānāṃ pṛthag lakṣaṇamucyate āyāmacaturaśrordhvakarṇakaṃ syād gavākṣakam mūlāgramadhyagulikamṛjubhittyantarārpaṇāt

vidigvakragattacchidraṃ gomūtrākhyaṃ tadākṛti pañcasūtrāntarā randhraiḥ prādakṣiṇyakṛtaṃ tu yat vedikādviguṇo'dhyardhaṃ samo vā syād galodayaḥ grīvāveśastadūrdhvaṃ syāccharāṃśāno'pi tatsamaḥ vyālanāṭyakathābhirvā galabhūṣaṇamācaret dvidaṇḍamānena bhavecchikharanirgamaḥ sakumbhāṃ kurvīta yathaiva śikharākṛtiḥ caturaśramāyatāśraṃ vṛttaṃ vṛttāyataṃ tathā ityaṣṭau śikharākārāsteṣāmatha nigadyate dvayadhā bhaktamekadvitryaṃśako'pi ca śikharoccānāṃ nāmānyapi ca saptadhā gāṅgeyaṃ śikharāṇi pṛthag viduḥ stambhā vā hastavaṃśatulā api manuṣyāṇāṃ praśastāḥ sarvadhāmasu pādādhikaṃ vā syāt sārdhapādādhikaṃ tu vā agrasopānakaraṇaṃ guhyāguhyamiti dvidhā prakāraḥ syāt trikhaṇḍaṃ śaṅkhamaṇḍalam trikhaṇḍākāranicitaṃ yat sopānaṃ trikhaṇḍakam taddvikhaṇḍaṃ tu sopānamardhagomutrasaṃjñitam śayitavyāsapādārdhatripādoccāni vai pṛthak vādhyardhadaṇḍaṃ bhaveddhastabilaṃ tataḥ śayitasyāpi praveśaḥ syād yathābalam dvitricaturdaṇḍo'śvapādake hastaghanaṃ vā syāt tripādaṃ vāsya copari syāt prāsāde maṇḍape'pi vā

pārśvayormukhasopānamanyatra parimaṇḍayet upasañcitakaṃ ceti liṅgaṃ puṃstrīnapuṃsakam kapotādiśiroyuktaṃ puṁlliṅgaṃ nāma yad ghanam strīliṅgaṃ vimānaṃ tadudāhṛtam ṣaṇḍaṃ bhogābhogāṅgasaṃyutam kuryādadhaścordhve bāhye nālaṃ prayojayet nālasyāyāmaḥ pañcadhā smṛtaḥ tāraṃ] ṣoḍaśamātrāntaṃ pañcadheti jagāda ha tricatuṣpañcatanmātraṃ tāraṃ tatsamanimakam siṃhavaktreṇa ghaṭitaṃ drāṅnatāgraṃ tu mūlataḥ antaḥsthapīṭhanālasya samaṃ vā bāhyanālakam maṇḍapasyāpyadhiṣṭhānaṃ prāsādoktaṃ yadeva tat ūrdhvadaṇḍāgravipulamārgaṃ ca kārayet svastikākhyaḥ syād vīrāsanamināṅghribhiḥ yutāḥ stambhairviśālāste'pi maṇḍapāḥ caturaśrāyataṃ kuryānmaṇḍapaṃ daivamānuṣam yuktitaḥ kuryād bhāranāhottarocitam ārāmapuṇyakṣetrādau grāmagehādimadhyataḥ sārdhahastaṃ tu rasāṅgulavivardhanāt ekadvitricatuṣpañcabhāge bhaktyāntare [g: kṣyā] kṛte tritrimātravṛddhyā karāntataḥ tatsarvaṃ tannāmnaiva prapadyate aṣṭahastāntamaṅghryaccaṃ trayoviṃśatpramāṇakam aṣṭāṅgulaṃ samārabhya cārdhārdhāṅgulavardhanāt stambhotsedhe tu rudrāṃśe paṅktinandāṣṭabhāgike [ga]

śarabhāge tu dvibhāgoccaṃ tu vā talam [lakam] sopapīṭhamadhiṣṭhānaṃ kevalaṃ vā masūrakam kapotapratisaṃyuktaḥ sāmānyo maṇḍapaḥ smṛtaḥ prapāthavā vā caturdvāraṃ caturbhistoraṇānvitam vadantīha maṇḍapaṃ vā prapāmapi puroktaḥ syād vedartvaṣṭadaśāṅgulaiḥ tvaksārairnirmitā vā syurūrdhvavaṃśottarāṇyapi anyairvāpyupapattyā tu patraiḥ pracchādayet prapām vedikoccaṃ syānmadhye raṅgaṃ ca kalpayet dvyaṃśastalimāyāmaḥ prastaroṃ'śena tasya tu vasustambhaṃ ṣoḍaśastambhakaṃ tu vā śālāsabhāprapāṇāṃ vā maṇḍapānāṃ tu madhyataḥ mṛt sudhā ceti ṣaḍvidhāni pracakṣate pañcānāṃ saṅgrahaḥ pūrvamucyate latāśliṣṭāḥ kīṭajuṣṭāḥ sakaṇṭakāḥ bahupakṣimṛgairjuṣṭāścaityamārgaśmaśānajāḥ palāśāḥ kuṭajā lodhrā bilvapīluśirīṣakāḥ pathyākṣāmalakāḥ pārthāḥ snuhisnugvaraṇā api nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaplakṣaśalmalitindukāḥ sarpamārārimedāśca putrajīvāḥ saḍuṇḍukāḥ varjanīyāḥ syurdevamānuṣadhāmasu varṣavātātapasahā jalasthalasahāśca ye kṣīrataravo na manuṣyagṛhocitāḥ vṛttākārastu mūlāgrād bahuśākho dṛḍhāyataḥ

mūlāgrayoḥ kṛśatvaṃ ca madhye sthaulyaṃ ca ṣaṇḍatā sarveṣu triliṅgairapi śasyate sitāmbarālepaḥ kṛtakautukamaṅgalaḥ vrajed deśamuddiṣṭaistarubhiryutam uddiṣṭavṛkṣacchāyāyāmupalipya tu maṇḍalam kṣetreśamoṣadhīśaṃ ca tathaiva vanadevatāḥ dadyād bhūtānnakṛsaraudanaiḥ bhūtāni devatāśca saguhyakāḥ mahīputrā yuṣmabhyaṃ cāpi naḥ sadā namaskṛtya pādapebhyaḥ prasannadhīḥ sthapatiḥ suptvā susvapnaiḥ prātarutthitaḥ paraśorāsyaṃ pañcagavyena vāgyataḥ kiṣkumātraṃ tarormūlaṃ tyaktvā chindyāt tadūrdhvataḥ vināśāya kurtuśchindyānna taṃ tarum hasitākrośaruditakūjitānyaśubhānyataḥ indreśārthadadikpātastanmukhāgraṃ ca śasyate saṅgo'pi vighnakleśakaro'śubhaḥ iṣṭapramāṇataśchittvā caturaśraṃ tu takṣayet samāropya yathoddeśamupāharet dārvāhāraṇamiṣṭaṃ syādanyeṣāṃ nṛbhirāharet dāru śāyayet pūrvamastakam dārorvidhānena saṅgrahed dhāmakarmaṇi atheṣṭakānāṃ karaṇaṃ sudhā caiva nigadyate tāmraphullā tu karmayogyā mṛdiṣyate sūkṣmasikatā tāmraphulleṣṭakocitā

āloḍya padbhiḥ saṃkṣobhya mardayet tāṃ punaḥ punaḥ mardayenmāsamātraṃ tu tatkarmakuśalairnaraiḥ tadardhavistṛtāḥ kuryād vyāsarāmāṃśamucchritāḥ sulagnādau culliṃ kṛtvānumārutam kāṣṭhaiḥ palālabhārādyairācitāḥ syurnirantaram tanmukheṣvagnimādhāya daśāhaṃ pakṣameva vā salile varṣamaṣṭau māsān ṣaḍeva vā iṣṭakoktamṛdā tadvanmṛlloṣṭakaraṇaṃ smṛtam āyatānyuttamādīni mṛlloṣṭāni bhavanti hi vyāse rāmābdhibāṇāṃśe loṣṭotsedhoṃ'śato bhavet suvarṇarūpyatāmrāṇāṃ loṣṭaiḥ śreṣṭhādikaṃ phalam lohānāṃ jñeyaṃ vittānuṃsārataḥ dvikoṇāgraṃ pārśvaloṣṭaṃ ca vartulam kramapaṅktiniveśastu tervidheyaṃ tu yuktitaḥ sudhāprakṛtayo matāḥ mudgasamā jñeyā mudginaḥ kṣudraśarkarāḥ śarkarāśuktyoryad gulmāsaṃ taducyate cūrṇasya piṣṭaṃ yat kalkamiṣyate pūrvaṃ pūrvoktāṃstriḥ prakuṭṭayet tvagjalaistriphalātoyaṃ māṣayūṣaṃ ca tatsamam khurasaṃkuṭṭanaṃ kṛtvā srāvayitvātha vāsasā dadhidugdhamāṣayūṣairgulājyakadalīphalaiḥ tacca samabhāgaṃ niyojayet tu kadalīpakvaṃ nālikerāmbumāṣayūḥ triphalāmbhaśca tryaṃśādikamidaṃ kramāt

karālaṃ ca prakṣiped dṛḍhapeṣitam śākhādidaṇḍaiḥ santāḍayenmuhuḥ sukuṭṭitaṃ yuktyā sudhā bhavati śobhanā jñeyā sudhāa saudhādibandhanī śuddhāmbhasādau prakṣālya dadhikṣīragulānvitam yuktyā yathā yatrocitaṃ bhavet svāgamoditadevādipurāṇoktakathānvitam tatratatrocitākārarasabhāvakriyānvitam ato'nyadaśubhaṃ citraṃ viparītaphalapradam dravyāṇāmapi dārūṇāṃ balāyāmādisiddhaye cābhyantaraṃ pārśve'pyadhastācca tathopari pūrvāgramuttarāgraṃ ca yojayet sandadhyādagreṇāgraṃ na yojayet dvāre devāṃśeṣvapi karṇayoḥ trikhaṇḍaṃ ca saumadraṃ cārdhapāṇikam ṣaṭśikhaṃ jhaṣadantaṃ ca sūkaraghrāṇamapyatha stambhadravyasya vistārād rāmāṃśānmadhyataḥ śikham saubhadramiti tat proktaṃ pārśvaprāptacatuśśikham niśchidramarpitaḥ proktaḥ sandhiḥ syādardhapāṇikaḥ nivṛttākṛtiniṣpādye yojayeduktamārgataḥ samadhyasthitakaliṃ ca yatra syāt ṣaṭchikhastu saḥ yathābalaśikhāyutam yathāyogaṃ śūlairnānāvidhairyutam svavyāsakarṇādhyardhaṃ vā sandhyāyāmaḥ sthite bhavet ca vāme ca stambhacūḍāntaraṃ tu tat

anyonyasandhividdhaṃ tu śikhākīlaṃ na vedhayet dakṣiṇottarayoryuktā śikhā sampatkarīi bhavet kīlakasyāpi vistāro bhāgato bhavet miśrasandhirvināśāya tasmānmiśraṃ tu varjayet antarantaniyojyaṃ syād dakṣiṇādakṣiṇā tathā sandadhyācchayitadravye samaṃ vāpi trayaṃ kvacit bahiścātra śayitadravyasandhiṣu tridravyairbrahmarājākhyo veṇuparvābdhibāṇakaiḥ bahusandhirbahudravyairdaṇḍikāsandhirucyate sarvatobhadraṃ tattadākārasandhayaḥ vināśāya yatastanna samācaret prakurvīta saukhyāyussaṃpravṛddhaye yathāvat sthapatireṣṭavyaḥ śilpaśāstraviśāradaḥ vṛtaḥ kartā vastukarma samācaret niṣpādyamāsamāpteḥ syāt tābhyāmeva hi netaraiḥ āsamāptervidheyaṃ hi citrasthaguruśāsanāt prāgvadadhivāsya vidhānataḥ sarvaratnauṣadhībījalohadhāturasānapi pradakṣiṇakrameṇaiva madhyaśvabhre nidhāya tu koṇeṣu catasro'pīṣṭakā nyaset sūcikāgraṃ vā śikharākārameva vā ānupūrvyāt kṛśaṃ kuryādagre cāṅgulivistṛtam śikhipādavat madhyame garte stūpyāyāme śarāṃśake

śilābhiriṣṭakābhirvā badhnīyāt parito dṛḍham mūrdhni stūpyāstu paritaḥ smṛtam padmamaṣṭadalaṃ kṛtvā stūpikāṃ bhūṣayet tataḥ stūpyantamūlabhūmyādivyāyataṃ samavistṛtam someśānendradigbhūmiṃ yadi pūrvaṃ spṛśed dhvajaḥ sahasraṃ saṃhitāmantrairghṛtena caruṇā tathā tathācāryaṃ hiraṇyavasanādibhiḥ atha kumbhaṃ tu sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ śaulbameva vā sudinarkṣamuhūrtādau snātvātha sthapatiḥ sudhīḥ tu vinyasya hemaratnauṣadhīrasān ṛjumālāgravinyāsamekaṃ trīn vātha pañca vā eva syāt traye brahmaharīśvarāḥ [g: rān] dṛḍhaṃ suniśchidraṃ kumbhamūlaṃ samantataḥ niṣṭhitasya vimānasya pratiṣṭhāvidhirucyate aṅkurārpaṇapūrvaṃ tu kṛtvaiśānyāṃ tu maṇḍapam dvādaśāṣṭacatustambhaṃ vitānādyairalaṅkṛtam caturaśraṃ vitastyuccaṃ catuṣṣaṣṭipadānvitam pañcaviṃśatisaṅkhyāṃstu kalaśānambupūritān sthapatiḥ snātaḥ śuklavastrādibhūṣitaḥ prāsādataḥ prācyāṃ prāgvad vedāśramaṇḍape maṇḍapavyāsarāmāṃśāṃ vyāsoccāyāmataḥ samām caturaśrāṇi kuṇḍāni vidikṣvaśvathapatravat mūrtipaiḥ sārdhaṃ mūrtimantraiścaturdiśam mūrttipairdikṣu hotavyamācāryeṇāṣṭakoṇake caturdikṣu vṛttakuṇḍeṣumūrttibhiḥ

janmādistūpyantaṃ vasanairnavaiḥ caturvarṇaudanaiścāpi yā (vī? vaiḥ) kṛsarapāyasaiḥ samāpūrya vāstubhūtabaliṃ niśi kriyāḥ kṛtvā vimānamadhiruhya tu vimānaṃ tad gandhādyairarcayet tataḥ likhitvā tu netramokṣaṃ tathācaret viprāṃśca dhānyarāśiṃ ca kāñcanam dhvajaṃ prāgvat stūpyagragranthitānanam vedisthakalaśakuśāmbhobhiśca sarvataḥ vimānādavaruhyātha sthapatistakṣakairvṛtaḥ saṃprokṣya cāṣṭa dhānyāni vikiret sarvato'pica pūrṇāñjalirimāñślokān paṭhed devānanusmaran pṛthivīmavatāt śrīsaubhāgyārogyabhogān kṛṣīran sthāpako'pi svakarmātha samāpayet cāśeṣaṃ prāsādaṃ prokṣayet kramāt prāsādabījaṃ haṃsāḍhyaṃ dvādaśāntād viniḥsṛtam tataścārghyādibhistadvad gandhādyaiśca yathākramam yajamānastataḥ svarṇavasanābharaṇādibhiḥ vimānakaraṇodīrṇaparikleśaphalātmakam tu sthapatirdadyāt saliladhārayā na gṛhṇīyāt pramugdhadhīḥ athānyānapi takṣādīn kartā karmakarānapi godhānyadhvajavastrādyaṃ dadyāt sthapataye'khilam sthapatiḥ sākṣād yajamānaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ

sthirameva syād dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalapradam caturdvārādisaṃyuktaṃ prāgvadābhūṣya maṇḍapam tarpaṇāntaṃ tu karma dīkṣāvadācaret tu saṃsnāpyācchādya vāsasā śāyayed vedyāṃ puruṣaṃ pralayākalam tārahṛtsampuṭaṃ haṃsamuddhṛtyātmapadaṃ tataḥ uccāryāthāñjaliṃ puṣpairāpūrya dvādaśāntataḥ hṛtpadme nāḍīmārgeṇa yojayet anenaiva prakāreṇa vidyārāgādikānyapi viśeṣeṇa kāryaṃ bhinnaṃ praśasyate candro diśaśca vāyuśca sūryo'tha varuṇo'śvinau viṣṇurmitro brahmā ca te kramāt śco)ditaṃ karma syāt saṅkalpavikalpakam uktyupādānagamanavisargānandakarmaṇām tārahṛdbījapūrvaṃ śabdādipañcakam pañcātha namontaṃ pūrvavad vadet pūrvavad vācyā namontaṃ sacaturthikam tārahṛtpūrvakaṃ tadvannamontaṃ sacaturthikam suyaśālambuṣe pūṣāṃ kuhūmapyatha śaṅkhinīm kṛkaraṃ devadattaṃ dhanañjayam svādhikārapūrvakatvena saṃsmaran aṅguṣṭhamātraprabhṛtimantraiḥ prerakatāṃ tathā nirodhayenniṣṭhurayā trikhaṇḍādhvānamapyatha kuṇḍāntikaṃ gatvā śaktimādhārasaṃjñitām vinyasya tathājyāhutibhiḥ punaḥ

vidyādyādhāraśaktyantaṃ pṛthagitthaṃ nirodhayet kḷptaśayyāyāṃ hemādyekatamaṃ ghaṭam sūkṣmavāsoyugacchannamiṣṭvā gandhādibhiḥ kramāt prāyaścittamaghoreṇa hutāthācāryadakṣiṇām ca vahniṃ ca yathāpūrvaṃ visarjayet prāsādaḥ syāt supratiṣṭho maheśaḥ skhalitaṃ jīrṇaṃ prāsādāṅaṃ yadā bhavet prāgvadeva syādalaṅkārādikaṃ ca yat jāticchandavikalpānāṃ syānmānaṃ prāgvadeva hi patitaṃ tasya na vṛddhirdoṣamāvahet tatproktasthāne kuryāt salakṣaṇam pūrvasaṃsthānasundaram cālayelliṅgaṃ pūrvasthāne'rhati sthitim sahasradaṇḍāntakṣeme saṃsthāpayet punaḥ prāyaścittādanantaram mūlālayād rakṣoyamāgnimarutāṃ diśaḥ bharturnṛpasyāpanmarudrakṣogniṣu kṣayaḥ proktanād dhiṣṇyāt prāgvodakparito'dhikam pūrvasmāddhīnamānādyaṃ sthānaṃ kartṛnṛpāhitam vinaṣṭavastuno garbhaṃ tyaktvā garbhaṃ nyaset punaḥ prāktanadravyairniṣpādyaṃ ced gṛhādikam yogairnavairnaveṣviṣṭaḥ purāṇānāṃ purātanaiḥ puragrāmālayādīni pūrvavastvanukūlataḥ bahirmūlādalpaliṅgālayādikam mūlālayasamaṃ kṣudramadhikaṃ ca na śaśyate

kramādindrādivāyvantaṃ mūlāt tu śivamandiram dhanaṃ ca sasyaṃ ca tasmāt tat parivarjayet mukhyādiparjanyāntaṃ ca pūrvataḥ prākpaścimāsyastu manuṣyāṇāṃ hitāvahaḥ saumyā devatāḥ śubhadā nṛṇām manuṣyālayaṃ kuryād devāgārādhikonnatam śubhaṃ nyūnaṃ samaṃ vā mānuṣa gṛham vairūpyaṃ hīnādhikyaṃ ca ninditam deśadeśādhipasthānakartṛbhartṛvināśanam strīvināśāya stambhe nṛpaparājayaḥ nāsikāsu svapakṣaghnaṃ śikhare rājavibhramaḥ asthānadvārasopānaṃ sarveṣāmaśubhāvaham acoditālaṅkaraṇamanyaccāniṣṭaduḥkhadam tasmād dhāma kuryāt salakṣaṇam sukhaṃ ca nairdhanyaṃ kuryāt pūrvādidigdarī ca puṣṭiṃ ca vināśaṃ cāvahet kramāt kṣaudrasya nyāsaḥ sarvatragarhitaḥ kanyāgamaṃ putraṃ kalahaṃ raktakanyakā uktādavāntare'nyatra dvāre ca kalahādikam vanakapotakāḥ devamānuṣageheṣu maṭhagoṣṭhasabhādiṣu khananādikriyābhistadapanīyopalipya tu vāstuhomaṃ ca dattvā vāstubaliṃ tataḥ yathāvadāvaset tasmin sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ bhavet kramaśaḥ kuryāt pañcatridvyekasaṃkhyayā

maryādā mahāmaryādakaṃ tataḥ śararṣibṛhatīrudrahastaṃ yathākramāt mūlārdhaṃ prathamaṃ tvatha carṣibhiḥ syād viṣkambhaḥ sārdhahastavān tattadviṣkambhamānāt tu triguṇaṃ vā caturguṇam kṣudrālpabhittiviṣkambhaṃ hastādārabhya pūrvavat sottarāvājanacchatraśīrṣavatyaśca bhittayaḥ [k, kh: rāṃ] kuryāt parito vṛṣabhāvalim hīnaṣaṇmātraṃ pratisālaṃ ca tatkramāt mahāmaryādabhittyantamevaṃ hāpyamathāpi vā taccaturmātrairyāvat pañcāntasālakam tu yamopānte gajavaktrasya nair-ṛte vāyavyāmathavaiśānyāmumādurgālayaḥ smṛtaḥ dhātuḥ syānnṛttasyaiśe'thavā puraḥ snapanāmbugṛhaṃ smṛtam rakṣombumadhye śastrāṇāṃ gośālā varuṇe bahiḥ vidyāpīṭhaṃ bhavenmukhye parjanye kṣetrapasya tu lokeśānāṃ svadikṣveva cendrāgnyormadhyato'śvinoḥ śāstuśca rakṣodigbhāge bhadrakālyāstathā bahiḥ vastūnāmambumarutormunināṃ vāyusomayoḥ parivāravimānānāṃ mānaṃ garbhārdhamānataḥ vapraṃ syāt parivārāṣṭakaṃ tathā caṇḍeśvaraścāṣṭau parivārāḥ prakīrtitāḥ madhyame dhāmni dvādaśaite bhavanti hi parivārāḥ syurmadhyame dhāmni ṣoḍaśa

vāstudevāṃśca kramādīśānapūrvakān śayane'pi syuriti prāha pitāmahaḥ lokeśān yajedeva pradakṣiṇam devaṃ pranālamapi cottare tripādaṃ vā prāsādārdhamathāpi vā tridvyekahastamuccaṃ taduttamādiṣu kalpayet kumudaṃ bhāgaḥ paṭṭikāṃśaistribhirgalaḥ bhāgenetyatha tadvyāse daśāṃśe dvyaṃśahānitaḥ vābjodayaḥ proktaḥ karṇikā tattribhāgataḥ alaṅkārairvimānoktairyuktaṃ vā baliviṣṭaram bahiḥ prācyāṃ dhvajastambhaṃ tu vinyaset dvāraliṅgasamaḥ śreṣṭho madhyo vedāṃśahīnataḥ dvārādadhyardhamucco vā sapādadviguṇocchritaḥ lakṣma yathāvadatha kathyate dvārāṇāṃ tatra vistārādutsedhaḥ pañcadhocyate dviguṇo'rdhādhikaḥ pādamadhikaḥ pañcadhocchrayaḥ saṃtyajya dakṣiṇādakṣiṇakramāt pādādhiṣṭhānatuṅgaṃtvaṃ vedeṣvṛṣibhujaṅgamaiḥ sādhiṣṭhānāṅghrituṅgaḥ syāccheṣaṃ syādupapīṭhakam paṭṭikāṅgamadhiṣṭhānastambhamānaṃ tu mūlavat homāntaṃ jitvādhiṣṭhanakaṃ nyaset(?) garbhaṃ nyasedārūḍhabhittike puragrāmarājadhānyādiṣūditam tu vaprāntaṃ kuryānmadhye surālaye ṣaṭtalāntāni madhyānāṃ gopurāṇyapi

stūpyantamuttarādūrdhvaṃ ṣoḍhā bhaktaṃ la gopuram kandharotsedhaḥ satripādāṃśakaṃ śiraḥ dvitalādīnāṃ talādhikyavibhāgataḥ gopuravyāsapañcāṃśe garbhāgāra tribhāgataḥ gopuravyāse garbhaṃ tu caturaṃśakaiḥ kūṭavistāraṃ tribhiraṃśaistu koṣṭhakam yathāśobhaṃ dvitalaṃ gopuraṃ bhavet śarabhaumaṃ syāt sūryāṃśe ṣaṭtale tathā mūladvārasya vistārād vedaśonaṃ śarāṃśataḥ sopānamuparyupari vinyaset yathāśobhaṃ tathā yojyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ kuryādākṛtiśobhādyaṃ vimānabhavanādiṣu ramyaṃ [g: mya] mahādvāraṃ pradakṣiṇam ūhapratyūhaśobhāḍhyaṃ dvisaptamu(pa? kha)paṭṭikam pārśve tyaktvā pūrvatalaṃ punaḥ ekadevasabhāśīirṣaṃ ṣaṇmahānāsikānvitam parito bhāgavṛddhyā sagaṇḍimam bhaktyā yuktaṃ bhavyābhidhānakam karṇeṣu pauṣṭikaṃ nāma gopuram khaṇḍaharmyapatākāḍhyaṃ sumaṇḍākhyaṃ tu gopuram sastambhakūṭaśālaṃ satoraṇam devaśreṣṭhanarendrārhaṃ subhadraṃ nāma gopuram caturnāsīsāṅgāvayavasundaram aṣṭāśrakūṭaśālāḍhyaṃ bhadrasundarasaṃjñitam tu talaiḥ saptabhiranvitam

ceti ca talliṅgamacalaṃ ca calaṃ dvidhā mukhaliṅgaṃ syānmiśralakṣaṇalakṣitam kṣaṇikaṃ ceti ṣoḍhā syāt kramālliṅgaṃ tu niṣkalam kṛṣṇāśca liṅgāni kuryāt tābhiryathākramam dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ dadyuḥ śuklādikāḥ śilāḥ vidrumaṃ puṣyaṃ ratnaliṅgaṃ tathāṣṭadhā bhedāḥ syuḥ kāmamokṣārthadāḥ kramāt padmarāgādiliṅgānāṃ kramaśo'rcanāt kalaṅkaśca kākāṅghrikṣatadhūlayaḥ rājataṃ tāmraṃ paittalaṃ kāṃsyamāyasam bhuktimuktipradaṃ haimaṃ liṅgaṃ raupyaṃ tu puṣṭidam āyurārogyadaṃ vidyādāyasaṃ maraṇaṃ smṛtam catvāri hemādīni śubhāni hi devadāruśca śamīpippalaśiṃśapāḥ viprādīnāṃ tryastrayaḥ tīrthakṣetrācalārāmapuṇyadeśodbhavāṃ mṛdam yavagodhūmamāṣāṇāṃ cūrṇānāṃ guggulorapi pakṣaṃ māsamātroṣitaṃ punaḥ śoṣayed dharme liṅgamāmaṃ tu mārttikam pañcagavyādbhirmāsamātraṃ tathoṣitām kuśalairagnau pakvaṃ liṅgaṃ tu tad bhavet ca liṅgāni saptaiva kṣaṇikāni tu kṣaṇaliṅgāni yajatāṃ prativāsaram trikhaṇḍaṃ mānaṃ vā na śirovartanādikam sadyastalliṅge śivamāvāhya pūjayet

svayoniḥ piṇḍikaiva syācchailādīnāmadūṣaṇā tāmrajā vā syācchreṣṭhamadhyādhamakramāt uttarāyaṇasaṃsthe'rke śuklapakṣe guṇānvite dvijānagre vācayitvāśiṣastataḥ prācīmudīcīṃ vā nimittānyupalakṣayan puṣpānnapūrṇakumbhājyaśaṅkhakṣīradadhīni ca maṅgalyayoṣito rājā dhvajapūrṇadhanūṃṣi ca yāturiṣṭārthasiddhyai syāt sutarāṃ tat pradakṣiṇam śastaṃ kṣutaṃ hyādāvaśobhanam bharaṭādīnāṃ vāme śastaṃ tu dakṣiṇe sṛgālavāyasavyāghracakorabakapotakāḥ śaśakauśikagṛdhrāśca śyenāśca mṛgaḍuṇḍubhāḥ bāleyagodhvanirvāme gatirdakṣiṇataḥ śubhā vātyā kalahaśceti ninditāḥ varṇavāhanaveṣāṇāṃ manaśśastradiśāmapi pratisūryoparāgolkābhūkampendradhanūṃṣi ca cakrikṣapaṇanagnāśca muṇḍitāmaṅgalāṅganā sūnāḥ pāṣaṇḍā daṇḍapāṇayaḥ ārdravastrāśca nindyāḥ syurdṛṣṭāḥ pratimukhāgatāḥ yaduddiṣṭaṃ girikṣetravanādikam mahendrasahyamalayāḥ kalaśo vedaparvataḥ gaṅgādikāḥ kṣetrāṇyamareśādikānyapi syuryathālābhaṃ śilāgrahaṇamārabhet śilā jñeyāstattannāmopalakṣitāḥ yuktā bhūrvāruṇī smṛtā

yāmyāṃ ca sā māhendrī kṣitiḥ smṛtā dūrapānīyā bhūrāgneyī vininditā nirjalā bhūmiraśubhā vāyavī smṛtā māhendryāṃ sambhūtāḥ sarvasiddhidāḥ valmīkāhiśmaśānāḍhyā nindyā bhūrapi tacchilā śilāyāśca grahaṇe ninditāstyajet anveṣayecchilāṃ tatra mantraṃ cedamudīrayet deveśa ! prasanno vṛṣabhadhvaja ! śuklagandhasragālepau bhūṣitau śilpibhirvṛtau bhūtāni devatāśca saguhyakāḥ sādhayiṣyāmi kriyatāṃ vāsaparyayaḥ tadambhobhirabhiṣicya śilāṃ punaḥ cācchādya paścime'gnau juhoti ca pāśupatāstreṇa śataṃ hutvā punarghṛtam darbheṣu svaped rātrāvimaṃ japan viśvarūpāya svapnādhipataye namaḥ kāryāṇi hṛdayasthāni yāni vai vā śobhanaṃ grāhyā syācchilā liṅgakarmaṇi snātvābhipūjyeśamācāryaḥ sthapatistathā mukhaṃ tasyāḥ pṛṣṭhamūrdhvaṃ tu pūrvataḥ śilā tyājyā bharturduḥkhakarī yataḥ mukhamūlaśiraḥpṛṣṭhānyaṅkayitvāmbarāvṛtām pelavā ca śilā bālā vininditā romarekhā caṇḍālī sā ca varjitā liṅgayogyā syād vṛttā vṛttāyatā ca sā

tryaśrāyatā cāpi ṣaṇḍā pādaśilocitā puṃlliṅgapīṭhe ca tathā liṅgapīṭhe ca ṣaṇḍake pādaśilāpīṭhaliṅgānāṃ trividhāḥ śilāḥ dāruyugale tato liṅgaṃ tu kārayet lakṣayelliṅgaṃ sagarbhaṃ cet parityajet liṅgaṃ niśśeṣamekarātroṣitaṃ tataḥ brahmaviṣṇvīśavaiṣṇavīḥ paripeṣya [veṣṭya tu] tu klinnā śilā yatra tu lakṣyate kāsisacorau gokṣīrapiṣṭā vālipya yā śilā | māṃsīkuṣṭhahayā rātriṃ triphalāṃ vāridāmbubhiḥ kālakūṭākhyaṃ viṣaṃ tatra vinirdiśet pūrvoktaviṣakāsīsagairikakṣīralepataḥ gaulikā vṛściko vā rakte tu kṛkalāsaḥ syāt khadyoto madhusannibhe vimalā dhūmre pataṅgaḥ sikatāstu vā maṇḍūke kartuśca nṛpaterapi kulīrālipataṅgeṣu rogaduḥkhādisambhavaḥ pravāsāya vimalā sthānanāśanam lakṣayelliṅge śobhanāścāpyaśobhanāḥ indrāyudhanibhāḥ śastā rekhāḥ śaṅkhāmbujopamāḥ hastoccamānādārabhya pādavṛddhikrameṇa tu caturhastāyatālliṅgāt prāgvat pādavivardhanāt saptahastoccamārabhya pādavṛddhyā tu pūrvavat tricaturhastayormadhye prāgvalliṅgatrayaṃ bhavet prasiddhaliṅgānāṃ trayastriṃśadudāhṛtam

kāryaḥ prakāro'nyaśca kathyate navabhāge syālliṅgaṃ pañcāṃśamāyatam tatraikahastaliṅgasya caturhastaṃ tu vistṛtam dviguṇoccaṃ tu nāgaraṃ triguṇaṃ yadi valabhirnāma vimānaṃ bhavati sphuṭam pauṣṭikaṃ sārvakāmikaṃ nāgare smṛtam trayodaśāṃśakaṃ mukhyaṃ garbhe'ṣṭāṃśe tu pūrvavat pauṣṭikaṃ sārvakāmikaṃ drāviḍe bhavet trayodaśāṃśamadhamaṃ tayormadhye'ṣṭabhāgataḥ dairghye vasusaptaṣaḍaṃśakaiḥ liṅgānāṃ brahmaviṣṇavīśadaivatam tribhāgamevaṃ vijñeyaṃ teṣāṃ bhedaśca likhyate caturdhā syāt tallakṣma pṛthagucyate viśāmiṣṭaṃ śūdrāṇāṃ svastikaṃ hitam anyavarṇoditaṃ liṅgamihāmutrārthanāśanam liṅgavistāraḥ pariṇāhastu tasya yaḥ brahmaviṣṇvīśabhāgāḥ sarvasame matāḥ vedāśrapiṇḍikāyāstu liṅge sarvasame tvidam syācchāyādoṣo'nyathā bhavet vedāśrapiṇḍikākṣetrāpekṣayā vartulādiṣu kṛśeṣu liṅgeṣu piṇḍikādhikavistṛtam śivāṃśe tu brahmāṃśe hāpayet tu tat pūjābhāgaṃ tu kuryāddhrasvaṃ tadaṃśataḥ chāyādoṣavicāro'yaṃ liṅge sarvasame smṛtaḥ vyaktāvyakte ca ratnaje

vardhamānādiliṅgānāṃ trayāṇāmapyayaṃ vidhiḥ liṅgāyatipramāṇānītyādinā pīṭhavistṛtiḥ saṃkṛtyaṃśe tu liṅgocce saptāṣṭanavabhiḥ kramāt prakṛtyaṃśe ṣaṭsaptāṣṭāṃśakalpitāḥ pañcaṣaṭsaptabhāgairvā catuṣpañcaṣaḍaṃśakaiḥ liṅgāyāme tu paṅktyaṃśe rāmāgniśrutisammitaiḥ liṅgotsedhe tu nandāṃśe ṣaṭsaptavasubhāgikaiḥ trairāśikaṃ nāma bhavet sarvasame tu tat vardhamānaṃ ca talliṅgaṃ nāmnā suragaṇārcitam kāraṇākhye ca yathoktaṃ tatra kathyate viśāṃ yogyaṃ saptāṃśādyaṃ tu vārṣalam ākṛtyaṃśe tu liṅgocce saptasaptāṣṭabhāgikam trayodaśāṃśe liṅgocce vedavedaśarāṃśakaiḥ ṣaḍbhiśca bhāgairbrahmādyaiḥ kṣatrayogyaṃ śivādhikam daśāṃśe tu guṇāgniśrutibhāgikam pūrvoktasamaliṅge tu dhārāliṅgaṃ vikalpataḥ ca śaivāṃśe dhārādvidviguṇīkṛte sarvatobhadraliṅge tu dhārāḥ syuḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ tu dhārāyāṃ catvariṃśatprasaṃkhyayā brahmādibhāgasiddhau tu vedāśraṃ proktamārgataḥ koṇārdhasūtralāñchanamadhyataḥ liṅgavistāraṃ saptadhā vibhajet samam siddhyati samamatha vṛttaṃ nigadyate digantamānena bhrāmayed vṛttasiddhaye trapuṣākāraṃ kukkuṭāṇḍanibhaṃ tathā

pūjāṃśāyāmatattvāṃśādekadvitryaṃśakāt kramāt saṃsthāpyopari netrordhvaṃ śirasaḥ siddhaye punaḥ tanmadhye binduṃ sampādya śāstrataḥ vartanaṃ kuryācchatrākārādisiddhaye ke'dhaḥ saṃlambya liṅgasyobhayapārśvayoḥ dvitīyaṃ ca samaliṅge niyojayet saṅkaraṃ naiva kuryāt tadaśubhaṃ yataḥ śiraḥ sidhyed rāmāṃśaiḥ kukkuṭāṇḍakam liṅgavyāse'ṣṭadhā bhakte sārdhāṃśatrayavartanāt sarvaliṅgeṣu vartanāstrapuṣādikāḥ sthūlaśiraskaṃ ca caturdheti mayoditam ca hīnaṃ ca sthūlamūlādikaṃ smṛtam śivāṃśo vṛtta eva syācchiraso vā na vartanam cātidīrghāṇi phalakāsadṛśāni ca ṣaṭpañcatridaśāgrāṇi mānonmānādibhirvinā sapīṭhānyapyapīṭhāni sālayānyagṛhāṇi vā darśanasparśanārcābhireṣāṃ siddhiranuttamā śodhayet teṣāṃ śodhanaṃ sarvanāśakṛt mūrtivibhāgo'sti na ca syānmantrasaṅkaraḥ bāṇaliṅgaṃ tu yat sarvaṃ yathājātaṃ nidhāpayet pīṭhe salakṣaṇe śaile saudhe vā sthāpayecchubhe gobālarajjubhiścaiva gharṣayennirvraṇaṃ samam śuddhāmbugokṣīranālikerekṣuvāribhiḥ sarṣapamātraṃ ced yatra syuḥ svarṇabindavaḥ tyājyaṃ liṅgaṃ pīṭhaṃ ca tad bhavet

tithinakṣatrakaraṇamuhūrtādau guṇānvite savitānaṃ caturdvāraṃ pradīpādyairalaṅkṛtam sitavastrayugāstīrṇe tasmilliṅgaṃ tu śāyayet tu talliṅgaṃ namaskṛtyābhipūjya ca mayā jñānāt tvayi yad duranuṣṭhitam deveśaṃ liṅge lakṣaṇamuddharet brahmasūtraṃ pārśvasūtre śivāstrataḥ samaṃ sūtrāṇyālambayet sphuṭam savatsāṃ gāṃ dvijaṃ svarṇaṃ ca kanyakām pādonabhāgamardhaṃ vā brahmasūtraviśālatā pārśvasūtrasya rekhā madhyayavā bhavet nandadigrudrabhāgoccaṃ hīnādyuccamihoditam yugāgnidvitaye madhye bāṇayunāgniṣu drāviḍe sūtravyāsaḥ svāṃśārdhataḥ samaḥ ṣoḍaśāṃśe śivāyāme sūtrāyāmo daśāṃśataḥ mukulākāramārabhya pārśvasūtradvayaṃ kramāt ṣoḍaśāṃśe'dho bhāgaṃ vedāṃśamūrdhvataḥ itthaṃ drāviḍaliṅgasya lakṣaṇoddhāraṇaṃ smṛtam daśāṃśaḥ syād vasvaṃśaprabhṛti kramāt tayoryutirbhavecchreṣṭhe viṣkambhaḥ ṣoḍaśāṃśataḥ trayoṃ'śāścādhoṃśā guṇabhāgāt prabhṛtyadhaḥ tridhā bhakte vyāso bhāgadvayena tu kaniṣṭhavesarasyātha dvādaśāṃśe śivocchraye pūrvavajjñeyo vyāse vai ṣoḍaśāṃśake kaniṣṭhavesarasyaivaṃ lakṣaṇoddharaṇaṃ smṛtam

dhṛtyaṃśe vedāṃśānupari tyajet dvyaṃśaṃ tathā pṛṣṭhe bhāgābhyāṃ tu yutirbhavet nālaṃ daśāṃśaiḥ syādaṣṭāṃśaiḥ pārśvayoryutiḥ avicchinnamatisnigdhamajarjharamanākulam bhasmanā pūrvamāsphālya mukulaṃ tataḥ chatrābhamastake liṅge sūtrāgraṃ syād gajākṣavat trapuṣābhe tu sūtrāgraṃ kukkuṭāṇḍavat liṅgānāṃ sūtrāgramatha kathyate sāmānyaṃ hi yavopamam madhyasūtratatidvyaṃśastadardhaṃ pakṣasūtrayoḥ vṛddhāvaṅgulivicchedaṃ parihṛtyāṅguliṃ punaḥ bhāni syuḥ śiṣṭānyatra yathākramam bhojanaṃ śaktirdhanaṃ rājā napuṃsakam vipat ṣaṇḍho vipannindyāḥ pare śubhāḥ dhanamṛṇaṃ caiva yoniśca syād yathākramam dhvajasiṃhavṛṣebhāścecchubhāścānye hyaśobhanāḥ śubhadāḥ śubhāḥ krūrāstvaśobhanāḥ rājñaśca deśasya taduktaṃ sampadāṃ padam tallakṣaṇoddhāravidhiśca gītaḥ saṃyogaṃ tu liṅgānāṃ pratiṣṭheti vidurbudhāḥ dārave liṅge svajātiścenna labhyate ṣaṇḍhena syāt pādaśilā strīśilā piṇḍikā bhavet pūjāṃśadviguṇaṃ hīnaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ liṅgonnateḥ samam tribhāgaikaṃ caturthāṃśamathāpi vā kuryāt tu viṣṇvaṃśasamānoccaṃ hi sarvathā

pīṭhānāṃ janmāntaṃ mūlavistṛtiḥ nāgarāditrayāṇāṃ tu pīṭhalakṣaṇamucyate dvyaṃśato nīcaṃ tayormadhye'ṣṭabhāgike śreṣṭhaṃ dvibhāgoccaṃ nīcaṃ vyāsārdhamunnatam trikhaṇḍena tulyavyāsamihottamam tayormadhye'ṣṭabhāge tu pīṭhavyāsā nava smṛtāḥ śeṣāṃśoccaṃ tu nīcādi pīṭhocco drāviḍe mataḥ tatsamaṃ vyāsaṃ jagatyaśaistathādhamam sarveṣāmapi liṅgānāṃ pīṭhoccādavaśeṣitam pīṭhamūlasya vistārād vasunandadigaṃśakaiḥ caturaśrāṇi vasvaśravṛttānīti tribhedataḥ vardhamānaṃ dvitīyaṃ syāllakṣmīsundaramapyatha samāṅgabhadrākhyaṃ rudrakāntaṃ tataḥ param puṣṭivardhanasaṃjñaṃ ca sarvasaumyaṃ tataḥ param niṣkalaliṅgānāṃ vijñeyaṃ sarvataḥ samam pīṭhocce bhāgāt syānmūlapaṭṭikā dvyaṃśaṃ punaḥ padmamardhamardhena kampakam ardhena kampo dvyaṃśāt syāt krameṇaivordhapaṭṭikā pīṭhocce janmadvyaṃśamihoditam tribhistadvat kampamekena paṭṭikām tu pīṭhocce janmasārdhāṃśato bhavet dhṛtyaṃśādekenābjaṃ tu kārayet kaṇṭhaṃ tathāṃśena vājanaṃ tvatha bhāgataḥ lakṣmīsundarasaṃjñaṃ tu pīṭhamevaṃ prasidhyati jagatyabjavetrapaṅkajapaṭṭikā

aṣṭādaśāṃśe pīṭhocce bhavet sārdhāṃśataḥ khuram cārdhenopapaṭṭaṃ kaṇṭhastryaṃśastadūrdhvataḥ vājanamuddiṣṭamardhaṃ paṭṭājyabhṛd bhavet pīṭhatuṅge tu ghṛtavāryardhataḥ smṛtāḥ pañcāṃśā jagatī tadvat sārdhāṃśena khuraṃ bhavet atyaṣṭyaṃśe tu pīṭhocce khuraṃ bhāgena vaprakam kampo'rdhamardhenāmbhojaṃ vṛttaṃ dvāvardhato dalam dvyaṃśaṃ vājanamardhena padmaṃ kṣepaṇamardhataḥ galaṃ cārdhamabjaṃ vṛttamatyardhato bhavet vetraṃ sārdhāṃśaistribhirūrdhvāmbujaṃ bhavet pīṭhocce ṣoḍaśāṃśe tu bhāgābhyāṃ mūlapaṭṭikā vṛttaṃ tu bhāgenārdhena paṅkajam dhṛtabhṛt proktametat sarvāṅgabhadrakam netrendubhirjagatyabjadhṛgvetraṃ dhṛk ca paṅkajam sārdhāṃśājjagatyardhena kampakam ṣoḍaśāṃśe khuraṃ dvyaṃśamathārdhataḥ vajramekaṃ syādūrdhvābjaṃ vedabhāgataḥ sāmānyaṃ nāgarādīnāṃ saumyaṃ pīṭhamudīritam āyāmastatsamastasmāt tricaturbhāgahāapanāt rāmāṃśāt khātaṃ vyāsasamonnatiḥ syādūrdhvapaṭṭabahulaṃ samaṃ pādādhikaṃ tu vā mūlaparyantaṃ tatkrameṇonnataṃ bhavet adhomaṇḍanamekaṃ vā syānnaikaṃ copapattitaḥ uparyaṅgāvasānaṃ tadūrdhvasantānamācaret vedartuvasusūryāśraiḥ ṣoḍaśāśraṃ ca vartulam

pīṭhotsedhe tripañcāṃśe janmadvyaṃśaṃ yugāṃśakaiḥ kṣepaṇamadhyardhaṃ kaṇṭho'rdhaṃ kṣepaṇaṃ punaḥ padmapīṭham pīṭhatuṅge tu manvaṃśe sārdhaṃ janmārdhato'vaṭam vajraṃ nimnamardhaṃ kampo'rdhaṃ tribhirambujam vajrapadmāhvayaṃ pīṭhaṃ sarvaliṅgasamaṃ bhavet caturbhiḥ paṭṭamardhaṃ syādardhaṃ nimnaṃ tu sārdhataḥ tribhirūrdhvāmbujaṃ paṭṭamardhamadhyardhamambujam pīṭhotsedhe ṣoḍaśāṃśe candrāgniśrutisaṃkhyayā dhṛk paṅkajaṃ tryaṃśaṃ paṭṭikā sārdhabhāgikā tadvyāsanirgamau tryaṃśau tathāgraṃ śrīkaraṃ smṛtam nimnaṃ paṭṭanimne'bjapīṭhe ardhyardhendvardhasārdhāśvibhāgairadhyardhakārdhakaiḥ kṣepaṇāmbhojapaṭṭāni nimnaṃ ceti yathākramam tu sūryāṃśe candranetrārdhabhāgataḥ adhyardhena tathārdhena janmapadmakanimnakam paṭṭikānimnakaṃ paṭṭaṃ śrīkāmye tu kramād bhavet pīṭhānāmaṅgānāṃ parikalpayet syānnirgamaḥ praṇālasya mūlavyāsaṃ ca tatsamam gajauṣṭhākāramathavā gomukhābhaṃ ca tad bhavet iṣṭadiṅmukhaliṅgānāṃ praṇālaṃ pīṭhamadhyataḥ vistāraṃ soccatulyaṃ prakalpayet paṭṭasya samaṃ khātaṃ tu mūlataḥ tvardhacandrākhye pīṭhe syād dvārasammukham pīṭhāśraṃ vedhasaṃ na praśasyate

doṣāya syāt tat pariharet tataḥ tadalābhe'pyekayaiba prakuryādūrdhvamaṇḍanam madhye karṇe sandhirna śasyate trikhaṇḍaṃ naikakhaṇḍaṃ vā yuktyā kuryādadhogatam pūjāṃśadviguṇā nīcā tayormadhye'ṣṭabhāgike svavyāsārdhonnatā mukhyā nīcā vedāṃśato ghanāḥ liṅgaviṣkambhācchreṣṭhā syād dviguṇā ghanāt brahmaśīlāmadhye brahmabhāgopamaṃ bhavet ratnanyāsānvitaṃśliṣṭaṃ liṅgamūlena tad bhavet pīṭhabrahmātmanormadhye prādakṣiṇyena yojayet ekadvitricatuḥpañcaṣaṇmātraṃ vādhikaṃ tataḥ nijāyāmā maṇḍanaṃ piṇḍikāsviva proktaḥ śayane vāsane sthite brahmaviṣṇuśivānāṃ ca (śau? gau)ryādīnāṃ tathāsanam daivārṣakāṇāṃ bāṇānāṃ liṅgānāṃ ca svayambhuvām dviguṇaṃ liṅgavistārād vistṛtaṃ vedabhāgataḥ garbhakarṇacaturthāṃśavyāsā śreṣṭhāyatasya tu tu navadhā brahmaśilāḥ syurdrāviḍe śive brahmaśilāyāḥ syānnavadhā drāviḍāhvaye vyāsārdhavedabhāgoccā prāgvanmadhye'ṣṭabhājite dviyavādhikavistāraṃ vistārāṣṭāṃśataḥ smṛtam ihālaṅkaraṇaistvāṣṭravidāṃ prītikaraḥ aśvinetrāgnibhāgaiḥ syāt skandhaḥ kaṇṭhastathānanam bhāgena mukhaviṣkambho vistṛtaścordhvaliṅgavat mānonmānapramāṇena sarvaṃ sakalavat smṛtam

puruṣādimukhānāṃ tu lakṣaṇaṃ tvatha kathyate candrāṅkitajaṭājūṭaṃ prāci tatpuruṣānanam daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ daṣṭoṣṭhaṃ saṃlihadrasanojjvalam sendukhaṇḍamarālabhrūḥ syādaghoraṃ tu dakṣiṇe lalitabhrūyugaṃcārutilakaṃ maṇikuṇḍalam vāmadevākhyaṃ mukhaṃ kuryānmanoramam candrāṅkitajaṭājūṭaṃ sadyojātaṃ tu paścime dvārābhimukhamevāsyaṃ trimukhaṃ cet tu pārśvayoḥ bhavane kuryālliṅgaṃ caturmukham sthāpayecchatrunāśāya vijayāya ca bhūpatiḥ mṛdvṛkṣāśmamayaṃ liṅgaṃ sarvasiddhipradaṃ sadā mukhaliṅgānāṃ nirgamaḥ syāt pṛthak pṛthak hastādipañcahastāntaṃ mukhaliṅgaṃ prakalpayet ekāṅgulaṃ samārabhya kramāṅgulavivardhanāt saptāṅgulādikaṃ liṅgaṃ madhyamā dvādaśāṅgulāt bhavantyeṣu mānaṃ mātrāṅgulena hi maṇḍanaṃ niṣkaloktaṃ hi pīṭheṣu sphāṭikeṣvapi sphaṭikānyaśilāpīṭhaṃ liṅgaṃ madhyaṃ svayonikam kaniṣṭhaṃ tatrāpi haimādyaṃ tūttamādikam sarvanāśakaraṃ yasmāt sadoṣaṃ taṃ na pūjayet binduḥ kalaṅkaśca trāsaḥ kāka padaṃ kṣatam ceti ratnadoṣāstuvarjitāḥ padmarāgādiliṅgānāṃ pīṭhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ svayonikam ekāṅgulādidviyavavardhanenā ṣaḍaṅgulāt saptāṅgulādidviyavavardhanenā navāṅgulāt

kaniṣṭhamadhyaliṅgāni ratnāni sphāṭikānyapi pratiṣṭhāpya sthiraliṅgāni pūjayet smṛtaṃ tasmāt sthirāṇyūrdhvaṃ bhavanti hi liṅgāni trihastāntāni kalpayet liṅgāni trayastriṃśad bhavanti hi ṣoḍaśāṅgulavṛddhyā syuḥ ṣaḍḍhastāntāni vai nava trayastriṃśalliṅgānyā rasahastataḥ tadanusāreṇa satataṃ tat samāśrayet śivatantradarśanaviniścayataḥ caiva calācalamiti tridhā dāravaṃ lauhaṃ trayaṃ caitaccalaṃ smṛtam citrārdhaṃ citrābhāsamiti tridhā likhitaṃ paṭabhittyādau citrābhāsāhvayaṃ smṛtam liṅgagarbhagṛhadvārastambhādhiṣṭhānakiṣkubhiḥ mānamityekādaśadhā smṛtam pādahīnamathaiteṣāṃ dvyantare vedabhāgike hastādinavahastāntaṃ tanmānaṃ navadhā smṛtam caturviṃśatyadhikaṃ śatabhāgike mūlaberāṅgulakṛtapratimāyāstadaṅgulaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ saptabhiścāṣṭabhiḥ kramāt śālyāyataistribhistaiśca sārdhaistairvedasammitaiḥ tadbharturdakṣiṇakare madhyamānmadhyaparvaṇaḥ yajamānasamaṃ tasya netrāsyahanudossamam niṣkale liṅge pūjābhāge śiro vinā liṅge śiromānaṃ na labhyate

tadvadārṣādau śirovistāravarjite pratimāmāne kramāt saptāṅgulāditaḥ sacaturviṃśatiśataṃ yāvat proktāṅgulairiha aṅgulairyajamānasya tatrāpi vidhirīritaḥ teṣu yonyādyaṃ nayet svaiḥ svairihāṅgulaiḥ caturaśītyaṃśe dviṣaṣṭyaṃśe samucchraye ekāṃśāropaṇāduktaṃ jātyaṃśāropaṇaṃ hi tat vidyād yathākramam navāṣṭaṣaṭcaturyugmatārāḥ śastāstu netare kramāt tad yonyṛkṣavāravibhavarṇanavāṃśakāḥ syuḥ tathaivāśobhanā varjyā dhūmaśvakharavāyasāḥ kṣemaḥ pratyaraṃ sādhako vadhaḥ sampatsādhakamaitrāṇi kṣemaṃ paramamaitrakam candrajñaguruśukrāṇāṃ vārāḥ śastāstu netare ṛṇādhikaṃ ced varjyaṃ syād vipattaskaraṣaṇḍakāḥ taskaro bhuktiśaktī ca dhamaṃ rājā napuṃsakam grāmavāstunṛpādīnāṃ yajamānasya cāpyuta triṃśadaṃśāditaḥ kramāt yonitārādighaṭanāṃ yojayecchobhanaṃ yathā pramāṇamunmānaṃ parimāṇaṃ tathā punaḥ syāt pramāṇaṃ tiryagarpitam tūpamānaṃ lambamānaṃ pralambitam gaurīlakṣmīgirāṃ matam daśatālena trimūrtīrvā prakalpayet sūryendraskandacandrāṇāṃ caṇḍakṣetreśanandinām

lokapālāṣṭamūrtīśavidyeśavasubhoginām marudgaṇānapsaraso'pyastramūrttīśca guhyakān siddhānasuragandharvān kaniṣṭhanavatālataḥ bhūtāni tritālād yakṣakinnarān pratimākaraṇaṃ tattaddehalabdhāṅgulena tu caturviṃśatyadhikaṃ śatabhāgike vidyādekāṃśaṃ yavamevaṃ paratra ca savikāraśatāṃśeṃ'śaḥ kaniṣṭhadaśatālake vedāṃśaśatāṃśeṃ'śo navatāle tu madhyame ṣaṇṇavatyaṃśakeṃ'śaḥ syācchreṣṭhe tu vasutālake saptatālādiṣu kramāt mātraṃ cāpyaṅgulaṃ ca samaṃ smṛtam akṣigolakapakṣastu dvyaṅgulasyābhidhāyakaḥ atha śreṣṭhāt paṅktitālāt pratimāmānamucyate tato'kṣisūtraṃ vedāṃśaiḥ sayavatritayaistataḥ vedayavaṃ tataḥ kaṇṭhastu saptabhiḥ trayodaśāṅgulaistasmānnābhistāvadbhiraṅgulaiḥ aṅgulairūrumānaṃ syāt tasmād bhāgena jānunī tu pārṣṇyantaṃ talaṃ saptadaśāṅgulam korparaṃ tasmāt trisaptāṃśaiḥ prakoṣṭhakam tiryagvistāraḥ karṇānto dvādaśāṅgulaḥ ekāśīterardhamātraiḥ sabāhvantaravistṛtiḥ kakṣayorantaravyāso dvāviṃśatyaṅgulairmataḥ hṛdayāvadhivistāraḥ sārdhāṣṭādaśamātrikaḥ śroṇervyāsaḥ kaṭivyāso viṃśatyaṅgulasaṃmitaḥ

bhānvaṃśairūrumadhyasya jaṅghāmūle'ṣṭamātrakaiḥ vistṛtāthākṣigulphāntaṃ sa yaveṣvaṃśavistṛtam ṣaḍaṃśaḥ prapadavyāsastalāgrasya saṣaḍyavaḥ tadardhena tadardhānnakhavistṛtiḥ vedarāmāgnidṛṅmātraiḥ satriṣaṭkacaturyavaiḥ kramājjñeyo navabhiḥ sārdhasaptakaiḥ sapādāṣṭāṃśasaptāṃśairdormadhye korpare tatiḥ saptāṅgulāyāmaṃ madhyā sārdhaṣaḍaṅgulā sapādeṣvaṅgulānāmā kaniṣṭhābdhyaṃśapādayuk aṅguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāntamaṅgulīnāṃ tatirbhavet aṅgulyagratate'gnyaṃśe dvyaṃśavyāsā nakhāḥ pṛthak svanakhāyāmādagraparva pṛthak pṛthak madhyāyāḥ satripādākṣi sapañcayavamātrataḥ yacchiṣṭaṃ madhyemūlāgraparvaṇoḥ sārdharturasasārdheṣumātravyāsastalasya tu tarjāmūlato'gnyaṃśaistathāṅguṣṭhasya mūlataḥ sārdhayugmāṃśaṃ [śā] karaparṣṇyā ghanaṃ kalā cakraśaṅkhābjamakarasvastikādyaṅgavat talam karṇayormadhyanāhaḥ prāg dvāviṃśatyaṅgulaiḥ smṛtaḥ mūrdhno madhyāṃt tu keśāntamānamuktaṃ navāṅgulam bhrūyugaṃ kuryāt sajyacāpānataṃ śubham bhrūvorantaramardhāṃśāccharāṃśairāyataṃ bhrūvoḥ kalāyāmavyāsā syādatha ṣaḍyavaḥ ṣaḍyavo netravistāro netrānto'rdhayavo'ruṇaḥ ūrdhvādhovarmavistāro yavaṃ cārdhayavaṃ bhavet

nāsāpuṭāntasīmāntavyāsapādāṃśapakṣataḥ tu nāsāgraṃ dvyaṅguloccaṃ puṭordhvataḥ nāsādvāroccavistārau pañcasaptayavairmatau madhyakuḍyocccatāṃśena tadvyāso'rdhayavaḥ smṛtaḥ sārdhavedayavāyāmā gojī [k: jjī] tasyārdhatastatā tadvyāsaḥ sārdhatriyava īritaḥ trivakrāvanatā tāvadāsyāyataṃ bhavet tatpālī tvadhaḥ sārdhayavaṃ tataḥ nimnaṃ hanustriyavamunnatā karṇabandhāddhanormadhyaṃ daśāṅgulamudīritam netrāntāt saptāṃśaiḥ śravaṇāntaram karṇabandhaḥ syāt sayavāṃśadvayāyataḥ mātrārdhamātravistāre syātāṃ sārdhāṃśato ghane tadardhavistṛtā vātha piñcūṣī syāt kalāyatā caturyavāyatā karṇapālī sārdhayavād ghanā kaṇṭhordhvakeśānte'rdhāṃśanimnā kṛkāṭikā sāṣṭārdhamātraṃ tadadhaḥ skandhasīmni daśāṅgulaiḥ hikkāsūtrordhvataḥ skandhasandhirvedāṃśamunnataḥ kaṇṭhādadhoṃśena kakut tasmādadhoṅgulaiḥ kakuddeśādadho hitvā vedāṃśāt kakṣayoḥ sthitiḥ rasāṅgulayavaiḥ kakṣādūrdhvaṃ bāhvoḥ samucchrayaḥ tadadhastryaṅgulo vyāso vaṃśo dvyaṅgulanimnavān bṛhatyorāstanaṃ madhye ghanaṃ ṣoḍaśamātrakaiḥ vikārāṃśairghanaṃ tasmādadhaścātyaṣṭimātrakaiḥ ardhonakṛtimātrā syāt kaṭibandhasya vistṛtiḥ

sārdhavedāṃśataścorumūlāt spikpiṇḍanirgatiḥ grīvātha tannāhe yugmarekhā samanvitā sārdhatrayodaśāṃśaiḥ syuḥ kakṣāt kakṣadharā tatiḥ stanapīṭhonnatirdvyaṃśāt sayavaṃ kucavartulam syājjānuyugmaṃ dvimātrakam sayavabāṇāṃśā śroṇī pārśve rasāṃśakā sayavadvayabāṇāṃśadīrghaṃ sayavavṛttataḥ syānmeḍhrādūrdhvorubandhanam sārdhakalayā pārśvabandhastu bhāgataḥ tūccanimnādyamanyadūhyamataḥ param daśatālena beraṃ kurvīta sundaram berocitapummānamaśeṣādiha uṣṇīṣāt tasmād bhāgaḥ saṣaḍyavaḥ syādatha hanvantaṃ rāmāṃśaistu saṣaḍyavaiḥ trayodaśāṃśaiḥ syurūrū ṣaḍviṃśadaṅgulaiḥ pādau ca talau bhāgāyāmau prakalpayet kramādarghāṅgulānāḥ syuḥ śeṣāstvaṅgulayaḥ pṛthak sārdhasaptayavā madhyānāmā saptayavaistataḥ udañcitāgrāḥ kiñcit te pārṣṇivyāsastu bhāgataḥ rasāṅgulaistalāgraṃ syādakṣagulphau śarāṅgulaiḥ saptamātrairūrvorvyāsastu tālataḥ caturmātrairaghovyāsastaccāśvatthadalākṛti ṣaḍyavavyāsanimnā syānnābhirmadhye'ntatastanuḥ stanādho'tijagatyaṃśairnandāṃśaiḥ syāt pratistanam stanākṣamardhamātraṃ syād dviyavaḥ syāt tadunnatiḥ

sabāhusīmāvistāraḥ syādekatriṃśadaṅgulaiḥ dhṛtyaṃśaistu prakoṣṭhaṃ syāt talaṃ saptāṅgulāyatam nandarṣivasvṛṣirasayavairaṅgulayastatāḥ nakhāyāmastalavyāso rasāṅgulaiḥ mūlaṃ ca vistīrṇaṃ syāt krameṇa tu bhaved vaktraṃ sārdhāṃśakalayā bhrūvoḥ sayavāṃśāt puṭādāsyaṃ gojidairghyaṃ tadardhataḥ tadāyāmastrivargottarapālikā yavavistīrṇā sayavadvayabhāgataḥ cibukaṃ dviyavaṃ tatra kaṇṭhaveśastato hanoḥ sadviyavābdhyaṃśairnālalambaḥ śarāṃśakaiḥ karikarākārau syād vapuḥ sarvasundaram madhyena daśatālena mānaṃ puṃso'tha kathyate keśāntānnetrāntaṃ ca puṭāntakam (?) hṛdayāntaṃ syājjagatyaṃśaiḥ saṣaḍyavaiḥ saṣaḍyavābhikṛtyaṃśairūrvordairghyamudāhṛtam utkṛtyaṃśairbāhudairghyaṃ kalāyāmastu korparaḥ trayodaśāṅgulaiścātha sabāhvantaravistṛtiḥ kaṇṭhabāhūnāṃ jānumadhyadvayaṃ tvadhaḥ kakṣādharastu kalayā prakṛtyaṃśairurastatiḥ trayodaśaiḥ kukṣimadhyaṃ sārdhapañcadaśāṅgulaiḥ kaṭivyāsastathaivorvormūleṃ'śaistu trayodaśaiḥ śrutyaṃśairnalakāvyāsaḥ sapādaistu śarāṅgulaiḥ sayavadvayavedāṃśaiḥ sapādeṣvaṅgulaistataḥ sapādavedāṃśo'ṅguṣṭhastarjanyasmād yavādhikā

sārdhadvyaṃśā kaniṣṭhā ca vistāre'pi yathākramam nakhavyāsā vasviṣuśrutisaṃmitaiḥ vasvṛṣisārdheṣusārdharāmāṅgulaiḥ kramāt talāyāmaḥ saptāṃśaiḥ syāt ṣaḍaṅgulaiḥ la]ṣṭhayādairghyaṃ sapādaiścaturaṅgulaiḥ aṅguṣṭhādyaṅgulīnāṃ tu syāt sūryavasunandakaiḥ rāmāṃśe dvyaṃśā syānnakhavistṛtiḥ śarāṃśaḥ syāt tadvyāso dvyaṅgulaḥ smṛtaḥ karṇāntarāyāmo bhavenmātraistrayodaśaiḥ netravistārastāvat syāt kṛṣṇamaṇḍalaḥ jyotiḥ syāt kṛṣṇamaṇḍalamadhyagam apāṅge'rdhayave rakte dviyavenordhvavarma yat kāryaṃ tāvān karṇocchrayo bhavet tadantaraṃ syādardhāṃśāt tayorānatiraṅgulāt tāvān syāt sādhikāṃśaḥ sabhūṣaṇaḥ tvardhamātrāt karṇamūlamapāṅgataḥ kāryā ṣaḍyavaḥ puṣkarocchrayaḥ puṭāvardhāṅgulasamau syātāṃ yavaghanau ca tau uttaroṣṭhatatistvardhamātrāt pālitatiryavāt taddairghyaṃ dviguṇaṃ tasmāt tatpālī yavasaṃmitā sādhyardhayavamātraḥ syāt tataḥ sārdhadvimātrataḥ kaniṣṭhadaśatālena strīmānamatha kathyate tataḥ puṭāntaṃ ca sayavairvedamātrakaiḥ kaṇṭhāddhṛcca hṛdo nābhiḥ sārdhasūryāṅgulāntaram uṣṇīṣakakṣajānvaṅghritaloccaṃ vedamātrakaiḥ

sapādavedamātraiḥ syāt tataḥ sayavabhāgataḥ nābhistato yoniḥ sārdhasūryāṅgulaiḥ pṛthak padāyāmo bāhū corvoḥ samau matau sārdhartvaṃśaistalāyāmaḥ ṣaḍaṃśairmadhyamāyatā nandarṣyaṣṭarṣiṣaḍyavaiḥ ato yavādhikaṃ dairghyaṃ talavyāso rasāṃśataḥ madhyakorparabāhvośca trivadeṣurasastatam jānvośca vyāsaḥ saptāṃśatastatiḥ tayostadardhamutsedhaścūcuke tu trimātraka stanādho'tijagatyaṃśairmadhye rudrāṅgulaistatiḥ ūrvorvyāsastu sūryāṃśairjaṅghāmadhye ṣaḍaṃśakaiḥ pārṣṇivyāsonnatirbhāgāt talamadhyāgrayorapi tarjanī madhyā sārdharāmāṅgulāyatā rasarṣisārdharṣivasuvikārayavavistṛtāḥ tatpādonāyatā vṛttā unnatāgrā manāk ca te puṭādadho'ṅgulādāsyaṃ gojyāyāmastadardhataḥ syādadharastadardhena tu vistṛtaḥ netradairghyaṃ vyāsastu ṣaḍyavaiḥ gojīmūlāt tu nāsoccaṃ syāt saṣaḍyavamātrataḥ syāccheṣamūhyaṃ hi pūrvavat tu kaniṣṭhāt strīmānasyeha lakṣaṇaṃ kathitam tatromāskandayuktasya śambhorlakṣaṇamucyate śāyayet pīṭhe dakṣiṇaṃ tu pralambayet jānunorbāhyapārśve ca jānvantād bāhupārśvakam kuryāt sarvametad yathākramam

dakṣiṇaṃ jānu sūtrād dvitryaṅgulaṃ bhavet manvaṃśairantaraṃ sūtrād dakṣiṇāt pāṇimadhyataḥ asavyapāṇimadhyāgraṃ stanasūtrasamonnatam hikkāsūtrasame smṛte meḍhrādakṣāntaraṃ tadvat kukṣispṛg ghrāṇasūtrakam kartarīhastāvantarvā bahirānanau dakṣiṇe haste vāme tu kaṭakaṃ kare keśāntāt satripādadvitālakam sahāsīnāṃ kuryād devasya pārvatīm devāśritā namravadanā samalaṅkṛtā pīṭhasthavāmahastāthavā bhavet pañcatālena vibhajyāṅgāni kārayet sārdhatrimātraistaireva puṭāntaṃ ca tato hanuḥ hikkāyā hṛt tato nābhirnābhermeḍhraṃ ca saṃmitam rudrāṃśaiḥ kalayā pādastalāyāmo daśāṅgulaḥ syāt talāyāmo madhyā ca caturaṅgulā kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhike tryaṃśe sotpalaṃ syāt karadvayam candraśekharalakṣmātha samapādasthito bhavet hikkāhṛdayaguhyoraḥ pādamadhyeṣu lambayet nābhisīmāntaṃ kaṭyantaṃ vāpi kārayet parahastāntaṃ daśāṅgulamathāpi vā ekāṅgulenorumūle jānumadhyaṃ tu bhāgataḥ aurdhvakartarihastau tu kuṭhāramṛgadhāriṇau pravālābhaḥ kāryaḥ syāccandraśekharaḥ ṛjuḥ sthito dakṣiṇāṅghrirvāmapādo'sya kuñcitaḥ

vāmabhāle tu vāmanetre puṭāntake tiraścīnajaṅgho'yamatibhaṅge tu nānyathā pātayennābherūrdhvaṃ prāgvadihāpi ca korparo vāmo hikkāto'ṣṭādaśāṅgulaḥ kaṭīdeśāvalambī vā vāmetarakaro bhavet devī lambavāmakarā bhavet naṭeśvaraścaturbāhustriṇetraścandraśekharaḥ sūryāṅgulaṃ vā sūtrasya lambanaṃ tvatha kathyate bhyo)stathā madhye savyagulphe ca pātayet parakarāgraṃ tadaṣṭapañcāśadaṅgulaiḥ catvāriṃśadbhiraṣṭāṃśaiḥ karṇasīmāsamo(bha? da)yam prasāritajaṭābhāraḥ kiñcit prahasitānanaḥ gaṇairdevarṣiyakṣādyairvighneśaskandamātṛbhiḥ nādayan nandī sūpavisṭaścaturbhujaḥ sthitadakṣiṇapādaḥ syāt kuñcitānyapadāmbujaḥ nābhideśād dakṣiṇe dvyaṅgule tataḥ sācīkṛtaśarīraḥ syād vāmāṃśāvanatātataḥ(?) vāmordhvakareṇa hariṇaṃ dadhat cārayaiśca munibhirvandito bhavet tripurāntakadavaḥ syād vaiśākhasthānakānvitaḥ rāmavedeṣumātraiḥ syānnatimānaṃ triṣu kramāt sapinākaḥ karo vāmaḥ kakṣāntoccaḥ karo'paraḥ devī vāmapārśve sthitā bhavet puṭānte ca hikkāmadhye ca dakṣiṇe devasya gantukāmasya pāvakam

syāt parahastau yathāpuram śrībhūmibhyāmanugatā gaurī devānugāminī sarvadevarṣigandharvayakṣādyairvandito bhavet dvibhujo dakṣiṇāṅghriḥ sthito'sya tu tu yat sarvaṃ prāgvadūhena kalpayet raudra ūrdhvakeśo bṛhattanuḥ kaṅkālā gamanodyuktaścākrāntamaṇipādukaḥ mṛgapotānanaṃ spṛśan tu śirasā vahadbhūtapurogataḥ tacchatracāmarakaragaṇāścaivānuyāyinaḥ vāmakaraḥ sābhayo dakṣiṇo bhavet kirīṭārdhaṃ kapardārdhaṃ ca dakṣiṇe ramyā tathā kāryāhyekā mūrtirharīśayoḥ viprakīrṇajaṭābhāro digvāsā gamanodyataḥ vāmastathāsyordhvakaradvaye bhujaṅgahāropavītakaṭisūtravibhūṣitaḥ umāsahitavat kuryāccaṇḍānugrahakaṃ param kṛtāñjalipuṭaścaṇḍa āsīno'dhaḥ śivāsanaḥ ardharjubadanaścārujaṭājūṭavibhūṣitaḥ sākṣamālānalakarastvadho dakṣiṇavāmayoḥ dakṣiṇorusthavāmāṅghrirlambitānyapadāmbujaḥ vidhātavyo vyākhyānavyāpṛto vibhuḥ dakṣiṇabhujo bhavedākarṇamudbhṛtaḥ bhya)ntaścāparastatra hala pallavasaṃyutaḥ nābhyantoddhṛtajānuḥ syād vāmo'ṅghriḥ kālahṛdgataḥ

kāryo nāgābharaṇabhūṣaṇaḥ vivṛttākṣo vyāditāsyo bhayaṅkaraḥ liṅgodbhavo liṅgamadhye candraśekharavat sthitaḥ kāryo haṃsarūpī pitāmahaḥ dvāraliṅgocchritaḥ śreṣṭho madhyo vedāṃśahānitaḥ dvārādadhyardhamucco vā sapādadviguṇo'thavā pañcāśadaṃśe bhāgo'ṅgulaṃ smṛtam paṅktyaṃśairdīrghaḥ kaṇṭho'ṣṭamātrakaiḥ dvimātraṃ jānu ṣaṇmātrā jaṅghā dvyaṃśonnataṃ khuram bhālaṃ nandāṃśavistīrṇaṃ mukhavyāsaḥ śarāṅgulaiḥ sārdhamātro'smād bhāgoccaṃ caturaṅgulam sārdhamātrāyataṃ ghrāṇaṃ tadvyāsāvaṭamaṅgulāt dīrghātatoccātha kakut ṣaḍvedāṃśatanornatā (?) śarāṃśaiḥ syād dvyaṃśaṃ jānvatha jaṅghayoḥ pucchāyāmastu jaṅghāntastryaṃśaistanmūlavistṛtītaḥ tadāyāmo dvimātraḥ syācchephāyāmastrimātrakaḥ atha triśūlaṃ dvāroccaṃ stambhoccaṃ vā vidhīyate vedarāmāśvisaṃkhyaiḥ śreṣṭhādikaṃ trayam madhyapatraṃ triparvakuliśākṛti madhyapatremadhyaparva dviyavenādhikaṃ bhavet uttānāmbujavannālaṃ nālordhvaṃ pārśvapatrake padmāgrāvadhi śūlāgrāt pārśvapatre tu vartayet pārśvapatrāntaḥ sīmāntaṃ vartayet samam pādonamagraṃ syāt tripādād vārdhato ghanam veṇupatrākṛtī pārśvapatrāgre madhyapatrakaḥ (?)

pañcapañcāṃśāt syādaṅgād daṇḍavistṛtiḥ maṇḍikumbhādipādālaṅkāravad bhavet ūhapratyūhato yuktyā śobhāṃ sarvatra yojayet tatra vṛttaṃ samākhyātaṃ tritaye'pi ca tat samam syādantare bhugnamardhataḥ parimaṇḍalāt nālamūle tu tatprotaḥ syāccharāṃśataḥ vetālaśūlavat sarvaṃ khaṭvāṅgasyāpi kārayet mayūrapiñchavṛttāḍhyaṃ phalakā mūlato bhavet khaṭveṣāvat tu vedāśro daṇḍo'sya phalakākṛtiḥ gaṇeśaḥ pañcatālastu svāsīno vā sthitau bhavet bhugnastu gūḍhaḥ syād gajavaktrastrilocanaḥ sārdhatālāyatau pādau pīvaraḥ sarvato bhavet pravikīrya pūrṇakalaśaṃ dīpaṃ ca madhye nyaset japādiṣu syāt vājinamityubhābhyām śannodevīrabhīti ca ṛg durgā prathamā bhavet pārayānavyo asmānādyaṃ tṛtīyakam pṛtanājitamityādiḥ pañcamo mantra ucyate vyāhṛtibhistadvadaghorāstreṇa vai punaḥ tathāmbuśeṣam darbhaistu yathāvadiṣṭvā vastreṇa samāstṛtaṃ syāt sahemavastrākṣatagandhapuṣpam vāstoṣpate dhruvā sthūṇāt tato gṛhyaṃbhayādinā

prataraṇo na edhītyādināpi ca śaṃnavargairjuhoti ca pañcagavyena dūrvāścāṣṭottaraṃ śatam sviṣṭakṛtaṃ paścādupalipya ca bhūtalam vāstoṣpata ityādinā kṣipet prakṣālya kasmiṃściccheṣājyaṃ śeṣamambu ca vātha darbhamuṣṭyāthavā punaḥ paryeti tataḥ sampūjya vai dvijān vācayitvāgre śivaṃ vāstviti vācayet pratiṣṭhā sthāpanaṃ tadvat sthitasthāpanamityapi brahmaśilāyāṃ talliṅgamādau nidhāya tu bāṇaliṅgānāmārṣāṇāṃ ca svayambhuvām sthitasthāpanamuddiṣṭaṃ jīrṇe cotthāpanaṃ bhavet athottarāyaṇe pūrvapakṣe lagne guṇānvite pūrvoktairhīne yukte susammate kuryāccaturaśraṃ tu maṇḍapam hastādinavahastāntaliṅgānāṃ prathamatrike ghṛtikṛtikaraiścotkṛtisammitaiḥ ekāśītipadāṃśasya syānmadhya[kh: tta]navakena tu kuṇḍāṣṭakaṃ tu pūrvādidikṣu kuryād yathākramam padmākāraṃ ca vasvaśraṃ navamaṃ caturaśrakam rakṣovaruṇayormadhye liṅge syāt paścimāmukhe kaniṣṭhāditriliṅgānāṃ ratnyaratnikarāṇi tu pañcamūrtipakṣe tu pañca kuṇḍāni tānyapi bhavet kuṇḍamaśaktau vā kaniṣṭhake

kuryādardhapramāṇena tadvat srapanamaṇḍapam ṣaḍaṃśoccāṃ paritastu rasāṃśakaiḥ ca bhaveduttarataḥ śubham nidrākumbhaṃ śāntikumbhāñchivakumbhāstravardhanīḥ abhyaṅgapātraṃ vastrāṇi tadvaccaivāṣṭamaṅgalam ca svarṇaṃ prabhūte madhusarpiṣī vṛṣebhaśṛṅgavalmīkasarastīrabhuvo mṛdaḥ kṣīrāgajambvāmratvacaḥ kisalayāni ca sarvauṣadhīrdhātubījalohāni musalādikam [kh: kādhikārān] gulakhaṇḍaṃ ca guggulum tailaṃ khaṭvāṃ vā phalakāṃ navām lakṣaṇoddhāramaṇḍape śivakoṣṭhaṃ syāt prāgādyaṣṭadiśāsvapi syustattvāntaṃ koṣṭhakāni tu homopakaraṇaṃ vāso dhūpopayogi yat tvakkaṣāyādyamanile caiśe syāccandanādikam plakṣodumbarāśvatthanyagrodhaistoraṇāni tu kaniṣṭhāditriliṅgānāṃ śarartumunikiṣkubhiḥ nandarudrātijagatītuṅgaśūlānyanukramāt śūlānāmaryamā mitrastvaṣṭā bhagapurandarau ca devatāḥ proktāḥ prāgādyeṣu tryastrayaḥ vibhūṣyordhvamadhivāsanamaṇḍapam muktādāmasragālambapūgapuṣpādyalaṅkṛtam darbhasandarbhamārjanyā sapalāśapalāśayā copalipyāntargālitodakagomayaiḥ

darbhairakṣataiḥ kusumaiḥ sitaiḥ tato'dhivāsanaṃ kuryādācāryo mūrtipairyutaḥ nātyantabālavṛddhāṃśca śrutavṛttādibhūṣitān pañcapakṣe tān mantraistaireva pañcabhiḥ vāhni pūrvaṃ kṛtvāṅkurārpaṇam srātvā vāgyato maṇḍapāntike maṇḍapād bāhye gaṇeśaṃ samyagarcayet prārthayet karma labdhānujñastato guruḥ tveti vā svāṅgaiḥ śūlairāyojayedapi uttiṣṭhabrahmaṇomantrāt [k: n] prāgādyantāṃstu vinyaset tathā madhye lokapālāyudhāṅkitān pītapadmāruṇān pāṇḍutāpiñchadhavalaprabhān adhyardhatoraṇāduccā dhvajāḥ sarve patākinaḥ mahākālaḥ kumbhodaramahodarau mūrttidharairviprairvedikāyāstu madhyataḥ kulaśīlaśrutācārasaṃpannāḥ śubhalakṣaṇāḥ kṛcchrādivratasaṃśuddhā vṛtāḥ prāgeva pūjitāḥ kuryuradhyayanasyādau svaśākhānumataṃ diśi puṇyāhasalilairmaṇḍapāntaḥ pradakṣiṇam tadaivādhyayanaṃ viprāḥ prārabheran yathādiśam yajet pūrvaṃ tārasvākhyānamontakam tatastoraṇaśākhānāṃ mūlakumbheṣu pūjayet cāgnijihvaṃ virūpākṣamathottare sahasravīcīṃ vimalāṃ śatadhārāṃ pramodinīm bhadrakarṇaṃ śvetakarṇaṃ ca nāmabhiḥ

tatastālatrayacchoṭipārṣṇighātanirīkṣitaiḥ paścimadvāramāsādya nārācāstraṃ prayojayet dehalyāṃ parikramya pradakṣiṇam vāstudaivādhipaṃ madhye brahmāṇaṃ svāsanaṃ tathā kṛtvādau sakalīkaraṇaṃ tataḥ mūlābimantritoṣṇīṣamuttarīyaṃ ca dhārayan candanālipte śivahastaṃ vidhāya tu tamātmamūrdhni vinyasya śivo'hamiti bhāvayan jñānakhaḍgakaraḥ prāgvat pañcakoṣṭhe yathāvidhi vikirānaiśe śivakumbhāstravardhanī gandhapuṣpādyairvṛṣakesarivāhane sañjīvanāmṛtārtheśakusmān dvāreṣu yugmaśaḥ mahākālaṃ bhṛṅgīśaṃ ca gajānanam svadigvinyastakumbheṣu śakrādīn daśa dikpatīn paribhrāmya tu vinyasya kumbhaṃ darbhopasaṃhṛtaiḥ śakrādilokeśāñ śivājñāṃ śrāvayet kramāt sthātavyaṃ sāvadhānena tvāyāgāntaṃ śivājñayā nivedyāntaṃ tatastasmai jñānakhaḍgaṃ samarpayet sahāmbena yāgādhyakṣeṇa śaṅkaraḥ ! arghyaṃ nidhāya kumbhāgre vikirairyāgamaṇḍapāt madhyamakuṇḍāgra upaviśya yathāvidhi pañcasaṃskāraiḥ saṃskṛtyārādhya taṃ guruḥ tattaddiganalāṃśāṃstu tattatkuṇḍe nidhāpayet tarpaṇaṃ kuryāt tacca mūlaṃ śivāntikam brahmāṅgamantrāṇāṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ juhoti ca
