śivamiṣṭvā yathāvidhi juhuyādājyaṃ śivāghorāstrimantrataḥ āgneyādiṣvaghorāstrāt sāvitryā ca śivājñayā devamabhyarcya dattvā bhūtabaliṃ niśi ājyenaindyādikuṇḍeṣu diśāṃ śāntyai juhoti ca daśāṃśena baliṃ dadyācca pūrvavat kalaśairdevamaṣṭottaraśatāntakaiḥ śaktyā tattalliṅgānusārataḥ ca syāt snapanānuguṇaṃ yathā brahmāṅgairjuhuyāt prāgvacchivāgnau śrapayeccarum yathāśakti juhuyurgurumūrtipāḥ ghṛtaṃ hutvā pṛthak pūrṇāṃ juhoti ca dattvā sāpekṣaṃ svamanuṃ tataḥ caturvaktraṃ prativaktraṃ trilocanam akṣasrakchūlaṭaṅkāṃśca bibhrāṇaṃ ca kamaṇḍalum talliṅgādāhṛtyātmahṛdambuje ādhāraśaktikamalapīṭhe saṃsthāpya taddhṛdi pūjayeccāsanārghyādikramānmukhyopacārakaiḥ mūlamantraśca dhunyādiścaṇḍeśvarapadaṃ tataḥ caṇḍaśabdādyaṃ hṛdayādīnyanukramāt āsanādikramādiṣṭvā snānādyairupacārakaiḥ saṃsnāpya mantrānuddipya pūrvavat madhyame kuṇḍe dadyādāhutisaptakam nityaśca tataḥ syādavinaśvaraḥ syurebhirhutvājyamaibhireva śivaṃ spṛśet

aghorāstravyāhṛtibhiḥ pūrṇāṃ ca juhuyāt punaḥ śivakumbhāstre lokeśān dvāradevatāḥ dattvā snātvā mūrttidharaiḥ saha hiraṇyavasanakṣetrabhūṣaṇavāhanaiḥ mūrttīśānadhyetṝṃśca tadardhataḥ liṅgino bhaktān dīnāndhādīṃstathārthinaḥ tṛtīyāṃśena vātmanaḥ vittaśāṭhyena yaḥ kuryāt pratiṣṭhāṃ śaktimānapi svasvakarmaphalārpaṇam svaputrādyaiḥ svajanaiścābhisaṃvṛtaḥ bhaktyā prāsādādyāṃ svaśaktitaḥ putramitrādyairante lokānabhipsitān varṣasahasrāṇi bhogān prāpya śivaṃ vrajet bahuprakāram yenāriṣṭāni śāmyanti guṇāstuṣṭiṃ vrajanti ca rudrapāriṣadebhyastu baliṃ dadyād yathāvidhi ṣoḍaśāṅgulavistīrṇe dhaute cājyābhighārite bhavelliṅgaṃ ravidigvasumātrakaiḥ sasvarṇapuṣpaṃ śirasi tasminnāvāhya mūlataḥ bherīpaṇavagovaktraḍhakkājhallarikānakaiḥ saveṇuvīṇākāṃsyaiśca baliyātrābhiśaṃsibhiḥ snātaṃ dvijaṃ śiṣyaṃ śuśrūṣuṃ vāgyataṃ śucim taṃ vṛṣaṃ dhyātvā talliṅgaṃ pātrasaṃsthitam sakalaṃ liṅgaṃ haimādikaṃ dvijaḥ śibikayā dvijārūḍhagajena vā

ca vitānaṃ ca ghaṇṭāṃ kusumacāmaram dīpakalasadarpaṇān hemapāduke gacchan sāmānyārghyakaro guruḥ devāgrato nāryaḥ surūpāḥ samalaṅkṛtāḥ praṇamantaḥ stuvanti ye caturdikṣu pūrvādidvārapālakān ṣaṇmukhaṃ devī * * * * * * * * svadikṣvindrādilokeśāṃstārādisvasvanāmabhiḥ prācyāṃ tu durgāyai skandapūrvataḥ mukhyābhirvikired balim vikirenmṛgāsyāya tathottare * * sthitvā tadunmukhaḥ rudrapārṣadāḥ sarve gṛhṇantu balimuttamam madhyahārāntarā gacchannā * * * kṣiped balim mahākālo bhūtanātho mahīdharaḥ kramādebhyaḥ svākhyābhirvikired balim pūrvādyaṃ saṃpūjya vikired balim triśikhaṃ ceti tribhujaṃ triśirasaṃ tathā tatkumudake harasenaṃ tathopari tannāmnā tadgāyatryā ca pūjayet namaskṛtya guruḥ praviśed devamandiram samāśritya dvitīyaṃ tu pradakṣiṇam pradakṣiṇaṃ devamālayāntaḥ praveśayet praviśenmaṇḍape vārdhamaṇḍape annaliṅgasthitaṃ devaṃ mūlaliṅgaṃ niyojayet

kṣaṇikamagādhe'mbhasi nikṣipet mahotsavavidhiḥ śambhoḥ kathyate yena tarpitāḥ pratisaṃvatsaraṃ vāpi pratiṣaṇmāsameva vā rathena syādathavā śibikādinā rathādyaṃ ca yānaṃ khaṭvādikaṃ tu yat śaikharī mauṇḍī trividhā śibikā bhavet stambhottarāntā tu śālācchādanasaṃyutā trivitastikavistārā dīrghā pañcavitastikam vāyatā vyāsāt svakarṇāyāmato'pi vā mūrtyaṅgulavihīnocce mukhyamadhyādhamakramāt svavyāsārdhamuccā syād dantadārvādinirmitā cetthamīṣikālaṅkṛtirbhavet sārdhadvimātratryaṃśaśca vistārau madhyamottamau vā chatrābho hasto dantādinirmitaḥ bhāgayormadhyato'nte cāpyādau syurvedakampakāḥ * bhāgau galikāphalakānvitau naranārīnāṭakādyairalaṅkuryāt tu yuktitaḥ * * * * * * * * tāḥ vā vyāsāyāmasthabhaktayā(?) stambhānāṃ tu ghanavyāsau kampānāṃ ca samau smṛtau ṣaṭsaptāṣṭāṅgulocchritāḥ kīlapaṭṭairyuktyā syuḥ sarvato dṛḍhāḥ kuryādanena mārgeṇa viśeṣastu nigadyate jālabhittisamāvṛtā madhyato mānaṃ śibikānāṃ vidhīyate

ratha * * * * hyāttu ṣaṭsaptāṣṭavitastibhiḥ svavyāsādhyardhamāyāmo rathopasthasya kīrttitaḥ baddhāścākṣottarordhvataḥ agrākṣānmadhyabhāro yaḥ sa ceṣādaṇḍa iṣyate tadāyāmo hastatrayamito bhavet bhāradārūṇāṃ phalakābhistu yuktitaḥ svāyāmavedabhāgena rathopasthāgranirgamaḥ akṣottarāyāmasamā cakrāṇāṃ vistṛtiḥ smṛtā tāsāṃ tu vistāraḥ paritaḥ smṛtaḥ pipīlikāmadhyā yavamadhyāstathāpi vā nemeḥ sīmādito bhavet puṣpasvastikakhaṇḍendumatsyādyaistadalaṅkṛtiḥ mūlāgrayoste vyāsena catustryaṅgulasasmitāḥ stambhoccarāmabhāgaikabhāgād bhittyunnatirbhavet bhūtavyālagajādyaiśca nāṭakaiśca vibhūṣayet yuktitaḥ kṛtvā stambhānāmupari kramāt prāsādamaṇḍapākāraṃ ramyaṃ saśikharaṃ bhavet dvicakraḥ syācchikharastambhavarjitaḥ dvicakraḥ syād bhittistambhādivarjitaḥ syustadākārāḥ kampapadmādyalaṅkṛtāḥ tripañcakāṅgulā madhyāḥ kaniṣṭhā dvādaśāṅgulāḥ vyālahariprakhyāḥ śreṣṭhā madhyāstvathādhamāḥ mithastulyāḥ śubhā dārvādinirmitāḥ kṣaumakārpāsapaṭṭābhyāṃ prastarau śreṣṭhamadhyamau siṃhavyālāṅghriparyaṅkau viprakṣattriyayoḥ smṛtau

navasapteṣūttaraistu kramād viṃśatimātrakaiḥ tatpādā vyālādyāstrividhāḥ kramāt saptadhaivāsanaṃ hastibhūtasiṃhavṛṣāṅghrikam sottarābjakapotaṃ tadāliṅgāntarikādibhiḥ paścārdhe hemaratnairvicitritam devānāṃ rājñāṃ ceṣvaṃśatuṅgapāt dvidvyaṅgulavivṛddhyātaḥ karāntād daśadhā tatam tripañcaṣaḍvasvaṃśairvā pīṭhapādonnatirbhavet piṇḍikākāraṃ hemarūpyādinirmitam nālasaṃyuktaṃ pīṭhaṃ syāt snapanocitam pādonamardhaṃ vā vyāsaḥ kūrmāsanasya tu rasanandenamātronā tūttamādikā * tacca kramāt kṛśam tatrāmbujādicihnaṃ syādagraṃ tu samakhaṇḍitam svoccavedaikabhāgena ghanaṃ syāt phalakāsanam praviṣṭādho'sya bhittikā āsanoccatribhāgoccā vṛttākārā manoramā narendrāṇāṃ vṛttaṃ kūrmāsanaṃ bhavet * * * * ratiḥ saṅkalpyāsmāt puraiva tu viśeṣapūjāṃ cāpyaṣṭā * * * * * * rudranandarṣisaṃkhyaiḥ śreṣṭhādikotsavāḥ dhvajāropaṇapūrvaṃ tu kuryā * * * * * * uttamādyutsavānāṃ tu tridvyekaguṇavāsarāt(?) bherīsaṃnādanaṃ smṛtam

prathamo dvitīyaścotsavāṅkuraḥ dhvajaṃdaṇḍataruḥ pūgastvaksāraḥ śāka eva vā syād ṛjurgranthyādivarjitaḥ samacchedāḥ sādhuvṛttā manoramāḥ pañcapañcaguṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ madhyamatyaṣṭisaṃmitaiḥ kaṇṭhamitaṃ madhyaṃ nīcaṃ vṛṣatalocchritam ṣaṭtriṃśat triṃśaccaivāṅgulāni tu dhvajadaṇḍasajātīyastūpadaṇḍatarurbhavet upadaṇḍasya tuṅgaṃ syāt tannāhodvādaśāṅgulaḥ sacchidrāgrāstrayaskandhāśchidraprotopadaṇḍakāḥ upadaṇḍaḥ ketudaṇḍādagre tālādhikāyataḥ patākābandhanīrajjustadantaḥ saṃviśed yathā dhvajadaṇḍoccā kṣālitā suviśodhitā madhyahārāyāṃ maryādāmadhyame'thavā nābhikaṭyūrudaghne gartte vilepite samucchritya darbhamālāṃdyalaṅkṛtam tanmūlavedikāṃ kuryād dvyekahastatatocchrayām tadvyāso vyāsārdhācchikharaṃ bhavet svāyāmapañcabhāgaikabhāgānmadhye vṛṣaṃ likhet sitāsitaviśālākṣaḥ sugrīvaḥ sumukhākṛtiḥ vā syād yathoktavṛṣalakṣaṇaḥ viśeṣapūjāṃ ca śivāya vṛṣabhāya ca sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā śālibhistaṇḍulairapi śuddhasalilaiḥ kūrcahemāmbrarānvitam samyag gandhādyairabhipūjya yathāvidhi

svairmantrairaṣṭalokeśāṃstadagre sthaṇḍile punaḥ tasmāddhastadvaye kṛtvā maṇḍalaṃ caturaśrakam hutvā vṛṣamantreṇa deśikaḥ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ cāpi hutvā vahniṃ visarjayet vātha madhyāhne pūrvarātre sulagnake dhvajamuddhṛtya yantreṇa vāhayecchirasāthavā praviśya nirdiṣṭe dhvajasthāne tu vinyaset mūle madhye'gre vṛṣaṣaṇmukhamārutān samānīya dhvajopānte tu vinyaset maṅgalāṅkuradīpādyairalaṅkṛtya yathāvidhi samyag rajjvā daṇḍaṃ ca veṣṭayet dhvajamārādhya nivedyāntaṃ yathāvidhi bherī vāsasā samalaṅkṛtām brahmāṇamārādhya koṇadaṇḍe guhaṃ yajet pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvadabhipūjayet bherīmidaṃviṣṇvādinā tataḥ tataḥ snātaṃ śuklavastrādyalaṅkṛtam śaṅkhabheryādiniḥsvanaiḥ kurvan brahmendrādīn digīśvarān āvāhya cā * bhiṣṭūya śuddhānnena baliṃ kṣipet devālayaṃ gatvā dhvajasya purataḥ sthitaḥ gandharvayakṣavidyādharāsurān siddhān nadīḥ śailān vanaspatīn ca brūyācchivājñāṃ śrāvayecca tān sevyo'yamutsavaḥ śambhoḥ susantuṣṭaiḥ śivojñayā

vikirecchaṅkhabheryādinisvanaiḥ athotsavadine prāpte vīthīstu pariśodhayet dvāragopuravaprāntarvīthīṣvapi ca sarvataḥ taddineṣūpapattitaḥ dhvajaiścitraiḥ puṣpamālāvalambitaiḥ ḍolāvitānayantrādyairalaṅkṛtya yathāvidhi tu vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ śītena cābhiṣiñcenmaheśvaram piṣṭadīpādyairnīrājyaṃ tu yathāvidhi rudraśrīpauruṣaiḥ sūktaiḥ snāpayitvā yathākramam candanāgarukarpūraślakṣṇapiṣṭaiḥ sakuṅkumaiḥ mālābhirhemapaṭṭaiśca bhūṣaṇaiḥ candanāgarukarpūrapuṣpadhūpaiśca pūrayet ālayāntarbahiścāpi nivedyāntaṃ yajecchivam yathāśakti naivedyaṃ vinivedayet tadannaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ śuci tvatha dadhyannaṃ saharidraṃ niśāmukhe sarvasandhyāsu pāyasādīnyanukramāt yantraliṅgādyaiḥ patracchedādibhistathā pūrvamadhyāparāhṇeṣu yātrā rātrau ca śasyate raṅgeṇa tathā śibikābhiśca vai kramāt samācchanne hemapaṭṭāmbarādibhiḥ citravasanaiḥ kusumotkaramaṇḍite sudṛḍhaṃ vidadhyāt pīṭharakṣaṇam vinaivomārdhaharyardhe kaṅkālaṃ ca vinaiva tu

samyagalaṅkṛtya sragambaravibhūṣaṇaiḥ pravartayed vādyagītanṛttādimaṅgalaiḥ vācayitvāgre paṭheyuḥ svastaye stutim sadā rudraḥ svastaye'stu śatakratuḥ nir-ṛtiścāstu svastaye varuṇastviha sadeśānaḥ svastaye'stu marudgaṇaḥ svastaye santu svastaye santu kinnarāḥ vidyeśāḥ svastaye'psarasastviha svastaye santu śailāśca svastaye tathā sarve svastaye santu naḥ sadā gobrāhmaṇebhyo'stu vaiśyebhyaḥ svastivardhatām svastyastu jaṅgamebhyaśca sthāvarebhyastathaiva ca sarvadevebhyaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svasti sarvadā pātālavāsibhyo divyebhyaḥ svasti sarvadā utsave'smin maheśasya balibhiḥ svasti vardhatām vīrabhadrasya mātṝṇāṃ śāstureva ca caṇḍakṣetreśayoścāpi tīkṣṇanetramṛgāsyayoḥ pīṭhasthabhūteśānāṃ tathaiva ca balimantrāstu likhyante teṣāmeveha tuṣṭaye nihatadaityāya nandīśāya namo namaḥ nihatadaityāya mahākālāya te namaḥ nihatadaityāya śāṅkarāya namo namaḥ nihatadaityāya śāṅkarāya namo namaḥ nihatadaityāya saurabheyāya te namaḥ nihatadaityāya śāṅkarāya namo namaḥ

nihatadaityāyai tubhyaṃ devyai namo namaḥ nihatadaityāya śāṅkarāya namo namaḥ namaste'stu śatakrato ! sarvaṃ namastasmai havirbhuje loko'yaṃ pretanātha ! namo'stu te nir-ṛtaye nityaṃ rakṣasāṃ pataye namaḥ jaleśāya pāśahastāya te namaḥ sarveṣāṃ namastasmai nabhasvate guhyakanāthāya dhaneśāya namo'stu te rohiṇīkānta! sudhākumbha! namo'stu te tubhyamīśānāya namo namaḥ vidhaye caturvaktrāya te namaḥ anantāya namo'stu te namastubhyamutsavasyeha vṛddhaye samprītāstebhyastābhyo namo namaḥ tārādi namontaṃ ca bhuvepadam dhanau śarāgnisvaragau caṇḍaśabdastataḥ param viśvakṣetrādhipataye viśvasiddhipradāyine tato'ntargopuradvāri tīkṣṇanetramṛgāsyayoḥ pārṣadān sarvānanenaivānumantrayet rudrapārṣadāḥ sarve gṛhṇantu balimuttamam mahākālaṃ bhūtanāthaṃ mahīdharam namontaiḥ svairnāmabhirvikired balim syuḥ pratidiśaṃ tebhyo nāmabhiḥ svairbaliṃ haret śatakratutanuraprameyo'tha vīryavān

svāṅgadīpastamoghnaśca sṛṣṭikṛccoruvikramaḥ agniragnisamānaśca jvālāmālī ca viśvabhuk raktavapurdhūmraḥ saptārcirviśvabheṣajam dārukaścetyāgneyyāṃ koṭināyakāḥ pretādhipo dharmaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇākṣa eva ca kṛtāntaśca satyāsatyapriyaḥ suhṛt rākṣasaścāsuraḥ kravyād vīrahā nir-ṛtistathā kaikaseyaḥ krūraḥ krūravapustathā vīrūpākṣo'tha bhasmāṅgo nair-ṛtyāmatha viṃśatiḥ pāśapāṇirānando'mbupatiḥ śivaḥ pratyaṅnivāso jalado jīvano nakravāhanaḥ sūkṣmaḥ sparśanaśca prabhañjanaḥ kūrmo'tha kṛkaro devadatto dhanañjayaḥ viṃśatikoṭīśā vāyavyāṃ tu gaṇeśvarāḥ kuberaśca jambhalaḥ śibikuṇḍalī śrīdo jyeṣṭho mālādharo dhanī viṃśatikoṭīśāḥ kauberīṃ diśamāśritāḥ yogī kapilaḥ piṅgalocanaḥ kapardīśo vṛṣavāho vṛṣadhvajaḥ mahānādo brahmamūrtiścaturmukhaḥ manyuraṅgāraḥ śikhibhūṣaṇaḥ diśi koṭīśā viṃśatiḥ pramatheśvarāḥ dīrghabāhuḥ prakāmaśca bhartā hartā vicakṣaṇaḥ ghoraśca kimpururdanujaḥ kṣamī tārādibhirnamontaistu pṛthageṣāṃ tu nāmabhiḥ

dikṣu bhūtakrūreṇa vā niśi tato'bhyetya bhūtidādīn yathākramam snātvā balidānādanantaram yānāderavaropyātha devaṃ pīṭhe nidhāya tu atrotsavadinānāṃ tu vijñeyā rātrayaḥ kramāt brahmabhūtendragandharvayakṣarākṣasarātrayaḥ viṣṇurātramaṣṭamaṃ paricakṣate sapuṣpakuśaśuddhānnaṃ brahmarātre baliḥ smṛtaḥ khyātaṃ bhūtarātre tu dāpayet baliṃ dadyāt tu deśikaḥ yakṣarātrākhye puṣpānnājyāmbubhirbaliḥ tvatha paiśāce māṣānnaṃ kṛsaraṃ madhu pāyasaṃ sājyaṃ vikirennavame punaḥ kecidācāryāḥ prāhūrvai gaṇasaptakam navapakṣe tu skandamātṛsamanvitāḥ tilaistaṇḍulamiśraistu pitṛrātre dvitīyake sakṣīrapiṣṭasaktvadbhirnāgarātre caturthake sājyena ṣaṣṭhe śaive tu dāpayet tu dadhyannaṃ mātṛrātrake ato'dhikadinaiḥ śreṣṭhādyutsaveṣu yathākramam prasthairekaviṃśatisaṃkhyayā śālyādyanyatamaiḥ śuklaistaṇḍulaiḥ sādhitaṃ haviḥ syuḥ snātā dvijāḥ śuklāmbarādikāḥ sājyaṃ sakadalīphalam uktotsavadinānyevamativāhya yathāvidhi

vācayitveṣṭvā sulagne gaṇanāyakam navaguṇaṃ sauvarṇaṃ ca samauktikam gandhapuṣpādyairbhasitaṃ cāstramantrataḥ hṛdā śūlāstrasya ca kautukam rakṣāṃ ca nikṣipya nīrājyārātrikeṇa tu yathāpūrvaṃ nityapūjāṃ samāpya tu viniveśyāgre tasya prācyāṃ tu vottare vitānacchatrakalaśadīpadarpaṇacāmaraiḥ dhaute vāsasā paridhāpya tu svalaṅkṛtāḥ kanyā gāyantyo madhurasvarāḥ dadhyakṣatājyadūrvāgragandhabījāṅkurāṇi ṣaṭ cūrṇaṃ haimapātrādisaṃsthitam devasya śirasyāropya mūlataḥ devamastraṃ caṃ parimṛjyātha vāsasā taccheṣaṃ bhaktamūrdhasu sakalīkaraṇaṃ vidadhyāt athātra tīrthayātrārthaṃ sthaṇḍile'gniṃ nidhāya tu pālāśīḥ samidho'tha ghṛtaṃ carum prāyaścittaṃ tilājyābhyāṃ mūlāt pūrṇājjuhotu ca caivājyaṃ hutvā tvatha jayādibhiḥ devamāropya tīrthasnānāya tu vrajet puraskṛtya snānopakaraṇaiḥ saha pradīpadhūpakalaśairvidhṛtaiścāṣṭamaṅgalaiḥ viśiṣṭasindhunadyabdhitīrthādyaṃ pracurāmbumat coktāṃ svastisūktaṃ ca maṅgalam

paṭheyurgītavādyādau jayaśabde ca mūrcchati vitānādyaiḥ pīṭhe devaṃ niveśayet yamune sarasvatītyādīnāpi ca devaṃ trirmajjayitvā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ nivedyāntamathādhāya sthaṇḍile śivapāvakam hutvātha pūrṇāṃ ca tīrthānyāvāhya pūjayet sviṣṭakṛtaṃ hutvā tīrthe jaleśvaram vācayitvātha tīrthe devaṃ praveśayet gandhāmalakahāridracandanāgarukuṅkumaiḥ śaṅkhabheryādinirghoṣairvedaghoṣaiścaturdiśam hiraṇyaśṛṅgamityādisūktamāntājjapedapi vāpi te sarve mucyante sarvakilviṣaiḥ pīṭhagaṃ devamābhūṣya vasanādibhiḥ yathāpūrvaṃ yānamāropayecchanaiḥ maṇḍapāntarniveśyeśamiṣṭvāthāstraṃ ca pūjayet mūlaliṅgagataṃ śambhuṃ saviśeṣaṃ tato yajet saṃpūjya gandhādyairdhvajaṃ tamavatārayet svadhāmāni yathājoṣaṃ bhajantviti yojayenmūlavṛṣabhe saviśeṣaṃ ca taṃ yajet nikhilātodyairvinā dīpairvrajed bahiḥ lokeśān brahmādīn sandhigocarān atha prātaryathāpūrvaṃ nityapūjāṃ prakalpayet kalaśairupapattitaḥ saśiṣyāya hiraṇyavasanāni ca paricārāṃśca brāhmaṇān vratinastathā

karmakarāṃścānyān dīnānāthāṃstathārthinaḥ samārabhya snapanāntadineṣvapi pradadyādannapānādi suvyañjanarasottaram sarve bhavanti gaṇanāyakāḥ śailādhirājasutayā sahito gaṇendraiḥ ca trīṇi śreṣṭhaṃ ca snapanatrayam ekāśītyāṣṭayuktena śatena dviśatena ca śataistathaiveṣuśataiḥ saptaśatairapi aṣṭottarasahasrairvā sahasrakalaśaistataḥ aṣṭottaraśatādīnāṃ * * * * * * paraḥ kalaśairnavabhiḥ pūrvamalpākhyaṃ snapanaṃ smṛtam aṣṭhottaraśatādyaistu * * * * * * * * maṇḍapāt pṛthageva hi atiśakarikātyaṣṭikarairatidhṛtermitaiḥ sahasrakalaśasyātha * * * * * mādhamāḥ tu hastānāṃ trayastriṃśadbiruttamaḥ syuḥ susamāḥ sarve'pyekajātitarūdbhavāḥ rudrātijagatīsaṃkhyaiścātiśakvarikāmitaiḥ tannāho'rkāṅgulairalpe tato dvitricaturguṇaiḥ lupāvaṃśānuvaṃśādyamūrdhvapracchādanaṃ tathā vidheyaṃ syād yathāyuktyupapattitaḥ sarve kartavyā maṇḍapāḥ kramāt iṣṭakādārumṛtsnābhiḥ parito baddhakuṭṭimam vācayitvā tu vāstuhomaṃ ca kārayet tadardhaṃ vā tato'rdhaṃ vā yathāvidhi

sadvasanacchannairmuktādāmāvalambitam nānāphalālambitanīprakam pañcame vāhni sarvaṃ snapanavāsarāt gavyena prokṣya cā(ve? vo)kṣaṇādibhiḥ kumbhāstravardhanīpūjābhramaṇārcanataḥ param padavinyāsaṃ prāgudagvyāyataiḥ samam caturaśrāṇi kalpayet kṛtvā tenālpasnapanaṃ smṛtam paṅkimekaikāṃ dikṣu mārjayet koṇeṣvekai * * * * * * * * * * * * ekādaśapuṭe kṣetre madhye navapadaṃ bhavet mārjayet * * * * * * * * * * koṣṭhaṃ ca mārjayet vyaktakoṭīni saptasaptapadaṃ yathā aṣṭadikṣvaṣṭanavakaṃ syānmadhyanavake'mbujam bāhyataḥ paṅktiṃ nidhāya tu caturdiśam koṇaikapadalopataḥ nidhāya tu caturdiśaṃ bāhyaikapaṅktikam padānyabjaṃ ca madhyataḥ vīthyormadhye caturdikṣu navakāni pramārjayet prāgvat tripañcapuṭake saptasaptapadāni tu navakaṃ paritaḥ paṅktilopataḥ vimṛjenmadhyakoṣṭhaṃ ca lopayet trisaptapuṭake kṣetre madhye nandapade'mbujam navakānyaṣṭau tadbāhye * * * * *

dvipañcāśatsamadhikaṃ padānāṃ dve śate sphuṭam tadbāhye paṅktyatikramāt vīthīṣaṭkaṃ svavyāyataṃ bhavet madhyabrahmapadāmbhoje śivākhyaḥ kalaśo'pi ca lumpedaśeṣataḥ tatastrikoṣṭhāt paritastripadācca paraṃ tataḥ vīthayo'ṣṭau bhavanti hi aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyāni trikānyapi bhavanti hi kalaśāsteṣu madhye śivaghaṭo'dhikaḥ * * * * * * * * * * * ya vilaṅghanāt pratidiśaṃ tatra vīthayoṣṭau bhavanti hi vyūhāḥ syurmadhyavyūhe tu madhyataḥ viṃśatyadhikaṃ padasaptaśataṃ smṛtam kṣetre vibhājite pañcacatvāriṃśatpuṭe same parito vīthyai lumpecca tadbahiḥ paritaḥ paṅktīrvimṛjed vīthiṣu triṣu paritaḥ prāgvat punaḥ paṅktidvayād bahiḥ pratipaṅktidvayaṃ lumped dvārārthaṃ svadigāyatam vikārakumbhanyāsārthaṃ rakṣenmadhyapadāni tu bahiḥ pañca padāni dvāri mārjayet tatastu viparītenāpyupaśobhā vimārjayet tāvatyaḥ pañcāvaraṇasaṃjñite kṣetre tvekonapañcāśatpuṭe madhyagataiḥ padaiḥ bāhyapaṅktau dikṣvekakoṣṭhakam tripadaṃ lumpet tato madhyāmbujād bahiḥ

tadbāhye cāpi paritastatastritripadāntaram syurmadhyame vyūhe pañcakānyatha ca kramāt koṇeṣu vikāranavakaṃ pṛthak bāhyanavakaṃ caturdikṣu vilopayet koṭimadhyasthamevaṃ padasahasrakam bāhye śiṣṭapaṅktidvayena tu kalaśāstatpuṭeṣu vai tripañcāśatpuṭe kṣetre madhyasthanavakeṃ'mbujam dikkoṣṭhamekaikaṃ lumped dvāraprasiddhaye paritaḥ paṅktiṃ vīthyarthaṃ parimārjayet parito lopyā paṅktistu vīthaye dvāravīthyarthaṃ bāhye vīthyāṃ ca yojayet antastripaṅktīḥ parito mahāvīthīstu mārjayet rakṣedaṣṭadiśāsvaṣṭau teṣu sandhighaṭān nyaset tattvakoṣṭhāni saṃsthāpya lopyaṃ paṅktidvayaṃ kramāt kṛtisaṃkhyāni tannandapadānyantarvilopayet paṅktitrayaṃ bāhye paṅktimekāṃ vilopayet prārabhya paṅktirekā yathākramam tattvakoṣṭhānāṃ dvādaśātra bhavanti hi antarvyūhe) kṛtighaṭā(n?) dvitīye sāṣṭakaṃ śatam sandhiṣvaṣṭau caturthe tu catvāriṃśadghṭādikam jñeyaṃ madhye śivaghaṭo'dhikaḥ dvicatvāriṃśat syurubhaśobhāśca tatsamāḥ lāṅgalākārakoṇāni sarvavyūhe tu kalpayet madhye saṃsthāpya nava saṃpuṭān

ekāśītipadavyūhāstvevaṃ syuḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ catvāri śobhāścaivopaśobhikāḥ madhyavyūhasya madhyasthanavakenāmbujaṃ likhet caturdikṣu dvārārthaṃ tripadāni tu bahirdikṣu vyūhamekaṃ pṛthak pṛthak kṛtivyūhāsteṣāṃ madhyaikakoṣṭhakam caturdikṣu paṅktyorekaikakoṣṭhakam evamekonapañcāśat kṛtivyūhe padāni vai ityekaviṃśativyūhe sahasrakalaśāḥ smṛtāḥ itthaṃ padāni vinyasya paritaścopalipya tu vārdhaṃ prasthaṃ pādena nikṣipet sthaṇḍilaṃ kuryāt kevala śālibhistu vā kalaśān sūtraveṣṭitān savidhānakān athācāryaḥ saśiṣyastu snātaḥ śuklāmbarādibhiḥ svācāntaḥ sūpaviṣṭastu bhūtaśuddhiṃ vidhāya tu yathāpūrvaṃ sakalīkṛtavigraham prāgvacchāntikalādīni dvārāṇi kusumādibhiḥ vinyasya dehalyāṃ vāstupā * * * * * yathoddiṣṭānavokṣyārghyajalaiḥ kramāt kalaśaṃ * * * * * * * * praṇavaṃ sṛṣṭikrameṇoccārayan kramāt sitavastrāvṛtān pṛthak saśālitaṇḍulāpūrṇaphalopetavidhānakān pañcopacāraistān homaṃ kuryād yathoditam hotavyaṃ prākkuṇḍe sthaṇḍile'pi vā

athāṣṭottarasāhasre sahasrakalaśe'pi ca madhyāgnervibhajya tu? yathāvidhi vyūhaikaviṃśatiryatra sahasrakalaśe smṛtā mārjiteṣvagniṃ juhuyād brahmabhiḥ kramāt tattatkalaśasaṃkhyātamardhaṃ pādamathāpi vā tatsampātaghṛtaṃ sarvamekīkṛtya kuśāgrataḥ sāmānyaṃ snapanānāmudīritam navakādīnāṃ śaivatantrapracoditāḥ puṣyarāgaśca vaiḍūryaṃ nīlaṃ gomedakaṃ kramāt maṇibhiścoktairgandhapuṣpakuśāmbubhiḥ tvaindrānmadhyāntasnapane kramaḥ puṣpāmbudhūpāntaritaṃ catuṣkānantaraṃ yathā pañcaviṃśatikasyāpi pañcaratnāmbu madhyataḥ cārghyaṃ pañcagavyaṃ diśāsvatha cekṣurasakaṣāyāmbu phalāmbu ca caiva gandhāmbu puṣpāmbhaścaiva dakṣiṇe pravālāmbu tilāmbhaścottaratrike brahmāṇi cāṅgāni madhye mantrāśca daivatam daivaṃ mantrāścānte namonvitāḥ īśāna ekapiṅgekṣaṇastathā madhyaghaṭādāpyakumbhādyaṃ pūraṇādiṣu punantvityarghyeṇa cāgnimīleti gavyataḥ dadhikrāvṇeti vai dadhi * * * * * * * * sumitrānastu lājakān śucayo brahmajajñānamityapi

vāstoṣpate śannodevyādināpi ca dūrvāmbhasāyaneteti śriyo jāteti cotpalān āśuḥśiśāna-ādyena snapayet pārvatīpatim brahmabhiścāṅgairgāyatryā śivasaṃjñayā atha tvekonapañcāśatkalaśānāṃ tu madhyataḥ pādyācāmārghyagavyājyamadhukṣīradadhīni ca candanāgarukarpūrakuṅkumośīravāribhiḥ kusumotpalakalhārapadmaśvetotpalairapi karavīraiśca pañcakaṃ pūrayet kramāt aindrādikāṣṭadiṅmadhya * * * * * mūrtayaḥ madhyāduttarakoṣṭhānāṃ śarvādyaṃ mūrtipāṣṭakam madhyasthenāṣṭakenābhiṣecayet pāvamānīhiraṇyādicatuṣkoṇasthapañcakaiḥ athaikāśītike madhyakalaśe ratnapañcakam pādyācāmārghyagavyājyamadhudugdhadadhīnyapi kuṣṭhaṃ māṃsīgranthimuraṃ tathā taṭākagirivalmīkakūlīrahradamṛttikāḥ vāruṇyāṃ navake kramaśaḥ smṛtāḥ cātha nālikeraṃ ca jāmbavam tāṭākaṃ hṛdāmbhaḥ śubhakūpajam nīvāramudgamāṣāśca siddhārthayavaśālayaḥ harikrāntā musalī bhṛṅgarājakaḥ dravyāṇyetāni syuryathākramam kahlāramaiśānyāṃ navake kṣipet idaṃ viṣṇurvicakrama āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuvaḥ

madhuvātā-ṛtāyate navakenāporājānamiti sūktataḥ tapasa ityudaṅnavakena tu śucayaḥ pāvakādyanuvākataḥ hiraṇyaśṛṅgamityādyenānuvākāntataḥ kramāt madhyasthaśivakumbhena mahatyā vyomavidyayā samāpūrya tadbāhyāṃśatrikeṣvapi śirīṣabilvamadhukaiḥ saptaparṇāsanārjunaiḥ madhyādipūrvanavake kuśamūlāṣṭamṛttikāḥ niṣpāvā yāmye madhyādito nava pūrayet paścime nava kauberyāṃ pūrayennava ca bhasma cāpyanalāṣṭake sadābhadrā musalī nair-ṛtāṣṭake dūrvetyuktaṃ syānmārutāṣṭake trikeṣu śrīparṇī śamī ca khadiraṃ tataḥ saralaṃ sarjameva ca dhātrī ca catuḥkṣīranagā api catustrikāṇāṃ tu pūrvādikramayogataḥ koṇakoṣṭhacatuṣkasya kṣmādimūrticatuṣṭayam āporājānamādyāt prāg yāmye puruṣasūktataḥ mantrāḥ syurāpo viṣṇuśca pūrvayoḥ āgneyasyāṣṭakasyemāṁ rudrāya sthiradhanvane hiraṇyaśṛṅgamityādyād vāyavyāṣṭaghaṭairapi varuṇaścendrāgnī daivataṃ kramāt

prārabhyāṅguṣṭhamātraśca bhuvaneśvarasaṃjñakaḥ mahātejā mantrāstaddevatāśca te viṣṇvādika cātha dadhikrāvṇādikatrayam mimikṣetyādyaṃ ca madhuvātā ṛtāyate dadhyāditritayasyāpa ṛgvedādestu pāvakaḥ daivamāpyāyasvādike śaśī paṅktyarṇavyomavyāpiṣaḍarṇakau madhyena śivakumbhena mahatyā vyomavidyayā dvipañcāśatsamadhikadviśatasnapanasya tu dikṣvaṣṭanavakānyapi tadbahiḥ aṣṭottaraśatoktaistu dravyairevābhipūrayet kramādebhirdravyairadbhiśca pūrayet mālyaṅgaścaiva bhadrā ca tadvad drāvaṇabilvakam prācyāṃ somakarpūravallike śvetārkamaruṇāgastikusumaṃ kāñcanārakam śvetamandāraṃ pāṭaladvayam kusumaṃ lavaṅkasya ca pallavaḥ śvetapallavapuṣpe dve śvetadūrvā mahāmarī śephālī bṛhatī tathā pārśvadvādaśakānyaṣṭāvāpūrya svacchavāribhiḥ aṣṭottaraśataproktaimastraistairnavakaiḥ kramāt saṃsnāpya śiṣṭadvādaśakena tu kalaśatriśatasyāpi hemaratnakuśāmbubhiḥ tīrthādbhiḥ samāpūryāsya bāhyataḥ navakāntaḥ sthapadānāṃ tu catuṣṭayam

dvipañcāśaddviśatavad dravyairmantraiśca daivataiḥ dvādaśāṣṭaprasaṃkhyāni hemāmbhobhiḥ prapūrayet sapañcaratnahemādbhiḥ samāpūrya yathāvidhi madhyatrikāṣṭake caiva sadvādaśaśa(tān?taṃ) ghaṭān parito navakāvaraṇadvaye madhyakumbheṣu tāvaddravyāṇi nikṣipet kalaśān sarvāñ śuddhāmbhomiḥ prapūrayet rudreṇaivābhiṣecayet vallībhirabhiṣicya krameṇa tu saṃhitāmanubhiḥ kramāt gururdevaṃ tattatsūktānyanukramāt kuśakūrcaistu kalaśān saṃspṛśantastathā śivam śuddhādbhiḥ pūrayet saṃhitājapāt kramānmantrairaṣṭottaraśatoditaiḥ navakamadhyastha kumbhāstāvanta eva hi dravyadvādaśakaṃ śiṣṭaṃ koṇeṣvāvaraṇatraye madhyādikeṣu vyūheṣvapyekāśītiprasaṅgyayā tattaduddiṣṭamadhvānaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ caiṣu yojayet gururdevaṃ rudreṇa brahmabhistathā śrīsuktaṃ pavamānaṃ ca japeyuḥ kūrcapāṇayaḥ kuśatīrthajalairghaṭam agnyādikoṇakumbhāṃstu pādyācāmārghyagavyakaiḥ kaṣāyatoyagomūtrapuṣpagomayakāñcanaiḥ atha dvitīyāvaraṇe dūrvāyavatilāmbubhiḥ jambūśirīṣapālāśasaptaparṇāsanārjunaiḥ

niṣpāvakamahāvrīhiśyāmākāṇugavīthukaiḥ nīvāraiḥ pūrayet tu yathāvidhi ṣebha)giriśṛṅgebhyaḥ kulī(re? ra)kṣetrayormṛdaḥ varāhakṛ(ṣṭai?ṣṭā)śca mṛdo devagṛhasya ca campakadvayamunmattatrayaṃ vai pāṭalaṃ yavam vai tuladīdvayam nāraṃ ca puṣpe punnāganāgayoḥ mandāre karṇikāraṃ mahāmarī bakulaṃ nandyāvartaṃ kadambakam maruvakaṃ mustā gra(nthī? nthi)ruśīrakam aruṇāgastikusumamāmrapuṣpaṃ ca corakam musalībhadre dūrvādvayaṃ tathā itīmāni dvātriṃśadadhikaṃ śatam śaṅkhapuṣpaṃ tāpiñchaṃ ca tamālakam śyāmā paṭṭī rāvaṇabilvakam dūrvāsanaprasūne dve bakapuṣpaṃ tathārjakam muraṃ bhāṃsī karpūraṃ cāgarudvayam caṣālapadmākṣau gandhāmalakagandhakāḥ kākṣī sindūraṃ daradaṃ śikhā svarṇaṃ vaikrāntaṃ cābhrakatrayam nālikerāmrapanasarambhālikucaḍāḍimāḥ badaraṃ drākṣā nāraṅgāmalakīphale sarjalodhrau ca rauhītakavikaṅkatau sārāṇyeteṣāṃ ratnāni ca pṛthaṅ nava haridrāyavagodhūmaśālīcūrṇāni bhasma ca

karambāścoḍumbā balā cātibalā tathā ca rudrākṣaṃ ca yathākramam catvāriṃśacca dravyairuktaiḥ prapūrayet hemakarpūrakuṅkumaiḥ pañcamāvaraṇe tadvad dvāsaptatiśatadvayam pūrayecchivasāvitryā prādakṣiṇyād yathāvidhi gandhaṃ ca hiraṇyaṃ caiva nikṣipet syādīśāntaṃ kramo'yaṃ snapane'pi ca agnirakṣonīleśāntaṃ pūrayet snapayedapi sadāśivādayaścāpi śāntyatītādikāḥ kalāḥ śivakumbhe tu sarveṣu kalaśeṣvapi sarvatrāpi ca kumbheṣu svarṇaṃ māṣamitaṃ kṣipet tridvyekaniṣkaṃ śreṣṭhādyaṃ madhye śivaghaṭe kṣipet śuddhatoyena vastraṃ kūrcaṃ ca kāñcanam aṣṭottarasahasrasya prāgvacchivaghaṭaṃ jalaiḥ dravyairviṃśatibhiḥ kramāt sakarpūraiḥ pūrayet kusumānvitaiḥ tṛtīyāvaraṇaproktairmālyaṅgādyaiḥ prapūrayet dvitīyāvaraṇoditaiḥ śiṣṭāśītiprasaṃkhyānāṃ navakānāṃ yathākramam nadīmṛdādikairdravyaiḥ pūrayed vyomavidyayā tatastrayāṇāṃ vyūhānāṃ dikkoṇāntāṃstu diksthitān pūrvoktadravyamantraiśca sandhisthānapi pūrayet ekaviṃśatike vyūhe madhyakumbhaṃ ca tadbahiḥ tadbāhyaviṃśativyūhamadhyasthakalaśāṃstataḥ

tato'ṣṭadikṣu vyūhānāṃ bāhyāvaraṇagān ghaṭān mudgādibhistu tāvadbhiruktairdravyaiḥ prapūrayet samāpūrya pārśvavyūhāṣṭakaṃ bahiḥ nālikerapayobhiśca krameṇaivābhipūrayet catuṣkoṇasthakalaśāñ śiṣṭairdravyaistu pūrayet mantrāśca kathyante kramaśo'dhunā pṛthagūhyāni pañcāvaraṇavat kramāt mūlaṃ ca mantrāḥ syurvyomavidyayā dvitīyāvaraṇasyāpi vāmādyāḥ śaktayaḥ smṛtāḥ caturthāvaraṇasyātha daivamaṅguṣṭhamātrakam bhavaścātha mahādevo mahādyutiḥ kapālīśo'gnirudraśca yāmyo nir-ṛtisaṇjñakaḥ eteṣṭadiksthavyūhānāmadhidevāḥ kramāt smṛtāḥ pādyenedaṃviṣṇurādyādāpohiṣṭhetyanantaram ghṛtenāpi madhunā madhuvātataḥ upatvāgnetīkṣurasānmānastokāt karambhakaiḥ dhānābhiḥ puṣpāvatyā tu puṣpakaiḥ saktvadbhirabhiṣiñcenmaheśvaram vāstoṣpatetiśālyadbhirdūrvādbhiścāyaneti vai āśuśśiśāna-ādyena snapayenmṛttikāmbubhiḥ dhānyādbhiḥ sārādbhiḥ pauruṣeṇa tu bhasmādbhirimāṃ rudrāya kūpa (pai?jaiḥ) taṭākādbhiraghoreṇa samudragāt gaṅgeti gandhadvāreti gomayāt kuṅkumādbhiḥ sāvitryā ghanasārakaiḥ

mantreṇa bilvapañcāṅgavāribhiḥ cakṣuṣeti snapayet pallavāmbubhiḥ jātavedaḥpavitrādyairanuvākāntataḥ kramāt ityādyāddhaimāstrasalilairapi abhiṣiñcenmahādevaṃ puṣpadhūpajalāntaram digvidigyogāt kalaśaiḥ snapayecchivam sapuṣpaiḥśītavāribhiḥ kumbhānāṃ snapayitvoditakramāt vaiṣṇavīṃ raudrīṃ vimalāṃ ca kṛtāñjalim kuśāgrāṇi militvā mārjayecchivam snapayeccādbhiḥ kuryānnīrājanaṃ tataḥ devāṣṭamaṅgalaiścānyairlokapālāyudhairapi dadhyakṣataiśca sunyastaiḥ puṃsā nīrājayed vibhum timilānakabheryādyairninadadbhiranāratam snapayet tato madhyaghaṭena tu susūkṣmairahatairau(kṣṇaiḥ? rṇaiḥ) kārpāsikairapi mukheṣvarghyaṃ netreṇācamanaṃ tathā makuṭādyairyathāśobhaṃ piṇḍikābhūṣaṇāntakaiḥ supiṣṭena sakarpūrahimāmbhasā mālābhiralaṅkuryādajātataḥ śambhuṃ dīpaṃ dadyācca varmataḥ ārātrikamathāstreṇa bhramayitvāvatārayet śālijaistaṇḍulaprasthaistato'rdhairvāpyato'rdhataḥ cātha dadhyanna saharidraṃ susādhitam īśānādimukhāgreṣu prājyājyāktaṃ nivedayet

sūpadaṃśāḍhyaṃ samūlaphalamodakam lavaṅgajātitakkolakarpūrailānvitaṃ jalam sajātiphalatakkolakarpūrakramukānvitam pradakṣiṇīkṛtya cāgniṃ saṃrudhya vai kramāt dvārakokeśān bhojayed gurumūrtipān dīnāndhakṛpaṇādīṃścāpyanyānannārthino janān dakṣiṇābhiśca vasanābharaṇādibhiḥ yajamānaḥ sahācāryaḥ kṣālitāṅghrikarānanaḥ sagandhadūrvākusumaṃ jalaṃ saṃgṛhya pāṇinā ślokenānena pādayoḥ pūjitaśca tvaṃ dattaṃ deyaṃ ca yanmayā taccedaṃ mamāstu phalasādhakam karmedaṃ māstu me nātha! bandhakam śivaliṅgapratiṣṭhāyāṃ samāsāt sampradarśitā tattvamūrtyādivinyāsakramaḥ sarvatra vai samaḥ durgāgaurīsarasvatyaḥ śāstā kālī ca mātaraḥ pratiṣṭhāpyāḥ pūjyāścaiva pṛthak pṛthak samāsena yathāvadatha kathyate tatpratiṣṭhāvidhau beraṃ syānmukhyaṃ daśatālataḥ taddhemādiloharatnaśilāmayam ārādhyaśceti pūrvataḥ piṅgalaścaṇḍastīvraśca dvārapālakāḥ lokeśāstrāṅkitāḥ pūjyā dhvajāstadadhidevatāḥ parigṛhyātha lokeśān kumbhagān yajet svamūlāṅgaistataḥ kuryājjale cāpyadhivāsanam

snapayet prāgvat pūritaiḥ saptasaptakaiḥ pavamānaistathā kramāt daśapraṇavagāyatryā madhyena tvabhiṣecayet prāgvannidrākumbhaṃ ca vinyaset nyaseccātmāditattvāni jānukaṇṭhaśirovadhi cāpi raśmīn bhāgatraye kramāt bhūmyaptejomarudvyomamanohaṅkārabuddhayaḥ ca mitraśca varuṇo'śo bhagastathā mūrtipāstvete dvādaśaivātha śaktayaḥ vidyutā caiva kathitā sarvatomukhī svāṅgamūlakhaṣotkaiśca sāvitryā mūrtimūrtipaiḥ pālāśārkasamitsarpiścarulājatilākṣataiḥ sampātitājyena śāntikumbhajalairapi kriyāśaktiṃ saṃsmṛtya viniyojayet snānādikaṃ kṛtvā garbhāgāraṃ praviśya tu ratnādipañcavargāṃstu vinyasyeṣṭvābhimantrayet ādhāraśaktimāvāhya saṃpūjya vidhinā tataḥ saṃprāpte sthāpako mūrtipaiḥ saha jñānaśaktyātmakaṃ dhyāyan sthāpayet praṇavāṇunā daśapraṇavagāyatryā sāvitryā cābhimantrayet nidrākumbhenābhiṣiñcet kiñcicchāntyudakairapi yavacūrṇādyaiḥ kumbhāstrasalilaistataḥ yathāpūrvaṃ svamantreṇa samāpayet prabhutāsanaṃ pīṭhaṃ vibhūtivimalādikāḥ dīptādiśaktīścārādhya maṇḍale puruṣaṃ ravim

mūlo'ṅgāni khaṣotkaśca tathā sadaśatārakā daśapraṇavagāyatryāstattvasaṃkhyāpadāni tu vibhāvyaivaṃ tu tanmūrtau hṛdi haṃsaṃ satārakam [cārasya ku] svakuṇḍe'gnāvamībhirjuhuyād ghṛtam nityaśca tataḥ syādapi niścaraḥ syurebhirhutvājyamebhirdevaṃ tataḥ spṛśet aṅgamūlakhaṣotkādyairmantrairvyāhṛtibhistathā snapayet prāgvannivedyāntaṃ yajedapi bhūtabaliṃ dattvā yathāpūrvaṃ dinatrayam gāyatryā pṛthagaṣṭottaraṃ śatam * * * * * * * * tato'gnīn svahṛdambuje yajet trinetraṃ piṅgākṣaṃ raktaṃ raktāmbarādikam kalaśairdevamabhiṣicyoktamārgataḥ nityavidhānena vibhavānuguṇena tu pūjāṃ pravartayet samyak trisandhyaṃ sopacārakam nityotsave tu sūryasya dvārasthau caṇḍapiṅgalau mātaraścaiva durgā ca tejaścaṇḍaśca diggatāḥ pūjyāḥ syurgāyatryuṣṇiganuṣṭubhaḥ gopuradvāḥsthau pakṣau śuklāsitau yajet baliṃ dattvā balipīṭhād bahiḥ sthitaḥ [kh: tiḥ (?)] vyāpya tiṣṭhanti balikāṅkṣiṇaḥ tato dvādaśarāśibhyo yathāsthānaṃ pradakṣiṇam madhumādhavaśukrebhyaḥ śucaye nabhase tathā tapasyāya baliṃ kṣipet gaṇānāmaṣṭānāṃ svākhyāgaṇanamontakam

marudgaṇāstadvad yakṣabhūtagaṇāstathā saṃpūjya baliṃ caiṣāṃ vinikṣipet cāruṇāśvāṅkāṃ gaṇāṃścāvāhya pūrvavat kārayet prāgvaduttamādikrameṇa tu yebhūtādyairyathāpūrvamiṣṭvā tebhyo baliṃ kṣipet ṇa) vidhinā rāśibāhye kṣiped balim gaṇā ye tu vajrahastā mahābalāḥ balipīṭhasthagaṇebhyaḥ pūrvavad balim kautukabandhādyaṃ tīrthayātrāṃ ca pūrvavat mantrāḥ syuḥ pratiṣṭhākarma śaivavat vighneśādipratiṣṭhāsu prāyaśaḥ samameva tat dvārapālāśca mūrtimūrtīśaśaktayaḥ pūrṇabhadraśca praśānto vijayastathā kuṇḍodaro dvāḥsthastadvat kumbhodaro'pi ca kaubere meghanādamahodarau gaṇeśakumbhaṃ caiśānyāmastraṃ ceṣṭvā tayorbhramāt adhivāsasnapanayoḥ kramāt svīkṛtya maṇḍapau purādestu parikramya pradakṣiṇam mūrtayaḥ pañca manohaṅkārabuddhayaḥ bhogadā kāmarūpiṇī kṣmādimūrttīnāṃ tribhāge vinyasedimāḥ tu kumbhāstre dikṣu mūrtīśakumbhagān praviśyātha śaktiṃ kūrmaśilāṃ nyaset sarvagaṃ sūkṣmaṃ tadbījaṃ haṃsasampūṭam cāṅgāni gaṇānāṃtvādikaṃ tadā

padāni vighnagāyatryāḥ padādhvānye tu pūrvavat mantrapādoditā ye tu mantrā vighneśvarasya tu pratiṣṭhāpyāstanmantrāvaraṇādibhiḥ triguṇārkādibimbeśabrahmaviṣṇvīśapaṅkaje mūrtipaiścāpi tṛtīyaṃ tu caturthakam bhavedante vighnapāriṣadāya tu gaṇādhīśaṃ sthirādyairatha saptabhiḥ aṅgairgaṇeśagāyatryā gaṇānāṃtvādinā tataḥ sarvatra hutvā nītvā dinatrayam kṛtvā tu karma cāpariṣecanāt kumbhalokeśadvārapāṃstoraṇadhvajān vikīrya rātrau tu yathāvibhavamarcanam nityotsave gaṇeśasya dvāḥsthāḥ kuṇḍodarādayaḥ paścime vāyau tāro nāge tu caṇḍikā gaṇacaṇḍaśca tatraitān saṃpūjya vikired balim cordhve dvāraśrīrmadhyagopari madhyahārāyāmaṣṭadikṣu gaṇeśvarāḥ virūpākṣo vikaṭo bahubhakṣyabhuk prāgādi gajavaktraśca vighneśagaṇanāyakau nāgadanto rudravaktro(d)bhavastataḥ nityotsavavidhistulyastulyaścaiṣa mahotsave yathāpūrvaṃ gaṇān sarvānāvāhya vikired balim ca bāhye daśadiśāsvapi sārvabhaumaṃ supratīkaṃ ca dikkramāt gaṇā ye tu vajrahastā mahābalāḥ

rātrau bhūtakrūreṇa vai balim snapane śaivakathitāḥ svāṅgamūlataḥ gaṇādhīśamupacārairyathoditaiḥ ye tatra likhyante tantra[kh: tra]coditāḥ prāgvaccitrādibhedena śailī lohamayī tathā vā syāt ṣaṇmukhī ṣaṇmukhasya tu dvibhujān dvinetrāneva kārayet vā caturhasto mayūrasthaḥ sthito'thavā dhārayaṃstadvat kaṭisparśivarapradam adhohastāt prabhṛtyūrdhvaṃ syād dvādaśabhujo vibhuḥ bibhrat kartavyaḥ ṣaṇmukho vibhuḥ bibhrat ṣaḍvaktrastvekāsyo vā caturbhujaḥ vā syād daṇḍaśaktidharo'thavā maulikuṇḍalahārādyairyuktāḥ syuḥ skandamūrtayaḥ pratiṣṭhāpyāḥ ṣaḍ vā dvādaśa mūrtayaḥ toraṇāni syurlokesāstrāṅkitā dhvajāḥ pūrṇasenastataḥ param pratidvāraṃ lājakumbhau bījāṅkuraghaṭāvapi dūrvākuśāgramāṣāśca vrīhayastaṇḍulāstilāḥ skandaṃ mayūrasthaṃ kukkuṭe'straṃ ca vardhanīm tvākaraṃ netramokṣaṃ toyādhivāsanam kumārakumbhāstre mūrtikumbhāṃśca ṣaṇ nyaset ātmāditattvabhāgeṣu brahmādīṃstriguṇānvitān sanatkumāraḥ skandaśca viśākhaḥ ṣaṇmukhastathā devayānī ṣaṣṭhī vidyā ca kukkuṭā

mūrtimūrtīśaśaktīstu tribhāgeṣvapi vinyaset mūlāṅgamūrtimantraiśca juhuyuḥ śaktibhistataḥ mantroddhāre pūrvameva mūlamantraḥ pradarśitaḥ mahāsenaścaturthyanto vidmahetipadaṃ tataḥ prakārānte codayāt tārapūrvikā bhadrasenaḥ senānīśca bhavātmajaḥ mayūravāhanaścaiva gāṅgeyaśca tataḥ param svākhyābhistanmantrāḥ syurnamontakāḥ māyūrakhādirāśvatthaplākṣaudumbararauhiṇāḥ caruṃ yavān vrīhīllāṁjasiddhārthasarṣapān śāntikumbhāmbhasā tathā maṇḍapād dikṣu mantrairlokeśadaivataiḥ cāpi vāyavyāṃ bilvakārṣmarisambhavāḥ vāmataḥ pīṭhe kriyāśaktiṃ nidhāya tu praviśyātha lagne kūrmaśilāṃ nyaset vinyasya garteṣu madhye prāgādidikṣvapi rasaṃ ca māṇikyaṃ madhyād bāhye kramānnyaset vastrādinācchādya bahirnirgatya deśikaḥ pīṭhe pratiṣṭhāpya sthiraṃ yathā tasyāmāvāhayed devaṃ mantrairebhiranukramāt vibho iha vāraṇavāhana ! svahṛdambhojāt paraṃ tejo guhātmakam niṣkalāntaṃ tu mūlaṃ haṃsaṃ ca kīrtayet sudhāmbhobhirāplāvyātha sacetanām mūlāṅgāni ca gāyatrī mūrtimantrāśca sa smṛtaḥ

tathā mūrdhni nābhau guhye ca pādayoḥ mūrtīśanidrākumbhāstraiḥ snapayitva tu pūjayet kṣiptvā praviśyāntardehalyāṃ tannidhāya ca kṛtvārghyaṃ śuddhīḥ pañca vidhāya tu ādhāraśaktyanantākhyamayūrāsanagātragān vidyāyāḥ śaktīrmadhye ca pūjayet vyāpinī ceti pūrvādikramāllalitavigrahāḥ yajed divyāmbarādikaiḥ mūrtyaṅgaiḥ śaktibhiḥ sakalīkṛtam svāṅgaiḥ patrāgre [kh: grairmū] mūrtimūrtipaiḥ dvāḥsthaiścaturthaṃ lokeśaiḥ pañcamaṃ tu tadāyudhaiḥ sthirādibhiḥ saptamantrairhutvā spṛśed guham caturthadivase'bhyarcya dhūrtasenaṃ tu beragam raktavarṇaṃ nirmālyairabhipūjayet skandagāyatryā tilājye juhuyāt pṛthak sviṣṭakṛtaṃ hutvāgnīn hṛdi saṃharet snapayenmantraiḥ śaivoditaiḥ kramāt pradeyāni dattvā śaktyā tu pūrvavat pūrvoktaṃ puṣkalaṃ labhate phalam vighnaviśveśvarau cātha vīrasenasuṣeṇakau skandapāriṣadāntāḥ syurlokeśāḥ svasvadiggatāḥ dhūrtasenaṃ tathaiśānyāṃ saṃpūjyaiṣāṃ baliṃ haret tu balipīṭhāgrataḥ sthitaḥ sarve gṛhṇantu balimuttamam bāhyahārāyāmunmāthādīn gaṇeśvarān

unmāthaśca pramāthaśca subhāso bhāsvaro maṇiḥ daśamūrtibhyo balipīṭhe baliṃ kṣipet vardhanaśca kumudo nandanastathā vidhiścaiṣa tulyaśca syānmahotsave tataḥ skandagaṇān sarvān prāgvadāvāhayet guruḥ koṭikoṭigaṇeśāḥ syurdvātriṃśat syurgaṇeśvarāḥ sumukhaḥ suvrato vahnidiggatāḥ nair-ṛte kālo balaścātibalo'lasaḥ vāyavye meghamālī sthirastathā meghanādaśca saṃgrahonmāthavigrahāḥ catvāraḥ koṭikoṭigaṇeśvarāḥ skandapāriṣadānte tu svāhāntaṃ tu baliṃ kṣipet kurvīta yathāpūrvaṃ nimantrya tu pratisarārambhaṃ tvamanujñātumarhasī svakairmantraiḥ kṛtvā pratinivṛtya tu dattvā mukhyādisnapanena tu vidhivanmahāpūjāṃ pravartayet syāt tāraśaktiravādikaḥ daivaṃ tu devo harehariḥ svayam ṣaṭ tena śastrāntāni tu kalpayet hṛdādīni sve sve sthāne kramānnyaset tasyānte dhīmahe tacca naḥpadam gāyatrī yajanocitā cānte namaḥ syād yajane manuḥ sthāne harārdhe ca vāsudevaṃ tathānyataḥ

mūrdhāsyahṛtsuguhyāṅghryorharerardhaṃ nyaset kramāt kathyate tatrāpyadhivāsanamaṇḍapam śāntibhūtibalārogyāstoraṇe dakṣiṇārdhagāḥ vāmārdhe pūjanīyāḥ svanāmabhiḥ nandīśapūrṇau ca mahākālaśca puṣkaraḥ vīrasenaḥ ṣaṇmukhaśca suṣeṇakaḥ vikirakṣepapūrvaṃ tu kumbhe harahariṃ yajet madhyakuṇḍānalaṃ prāgvannavadhā saṃvibhajya tu mantrasantarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā kuryāccākāraśodhanam yathā pūrvaṃ maṇḍape śayanaṃ tathā sānantāṃ pṛthivīṃ sūkṣmayuktāmbhaśca śivottamam kumbhāṃstu nyaset tattvādikaṃ tataḥ tattveśān mūrtīḥ pṛthvyādikā ravim bhāgeṣu mūrtidvādaśakaṃ nyaset śivāṃ sūkṣmāṃ śāṅkarīṃ harivallabhām sāmānyaśaktayo hyetā haranarāyaṇasya yāḥ jñānā kriyā yogā tathaiva ca saṃpūjya dhyātvā tu sakalaṃ vibhum dhārikādyāśca śaktīraṣṭau yajedapi gāyatryā śaivoktena krameṇa tu mūrtipāścaiva saṃspṛśeyuḥ kramāt tridhā tulyamūhyaṃ syādaśeṣeṇa tu deśikaiḥ dhāriṇīṃ śaktiṃ tattvatattveśvarādibhiḥ pīṭhaṃ tatsthāṃ ca kriyāśaktiṃ ca śaktibhiḥ mūlenāvāhya tanmūrtiṃ mantradehaṃ ca bhāvayet

haṃsaṃ svahṛdayāmbujāt prakṣālya saṃsnāpya vedikumbhāstravāribhiḥ svamūlāṅgaiḥ svagāyatryā brahmabhiḥ praṇavādibhiḥ mantrādhvātha padairapi sthirādibhirmantrairhutvā spṛṣṭvātha pūjayet vidyeśvaraṃ guruṃ ceṣṭvā sakalīkṛtya vigraham sarasvatīṃ gaṅgāṃ yamunāṃ madhyataḥ śriyam mahākālaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ ca yajed dvārasya dakṣiṇe vāstvīśaṃ vedhasaṃ madhye tathānantāsanaṃ yajet mūlāṅgairarghyamāpādya jalakṣīrakuśākṣataiḥ tatprokṣitātmadravyādirastraprākārarakṣitaḥ dharmādīnapyadharmādīn māyāṃ vidyāaṃ guṇatrayam kesarayoḥ śaktīrvāmādyā vimalādikāḥ tanmūrtiṃ vidyāmantratanuṃ tathā āvāhanasthāpane ca sānnidhyaṃ sannipātanam gāyatryāsakalīkṛtya tu kramāt śūlaṭaṅkau ca śaṅkhacakre ca vāmataḥ dakṣiṇetarayoścarma vaiyāghraṃ pītamambaram tathāhimakarākārakuṇḍalaṃ sundarānanam sabilvadalanīlābjasarojatulasīsrajam ardhanīlagalollāsinaikāhimaṇibhūṣaṇam bhasmāṅgarāgollasitaṃ haricandanacarcitam dakṣiṇetarapārśvasthapārvatīśrīvirājitam śaktibhiścāṣṭamūrtīśairdvārapālakaiḥ harahariṃ hutvā ca samidādibhiḥ

cāpi mūlāṅgādyairyathākramam pālāśasamidājyairyathākramam prāyaścittaistathā hutvā pūrṇāṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ tathā toraṇadhvajalokeśadvārakumbhasthadevatāḥ saviśeṣaṃ tu dakṣiṇādyaṃ pradāya tu bhaktyā yatheṣṭaṃ labhate phalam pracaṇḍaśca bhṛṅgī vighnaśca dakṣiṇe lokapālebhyaḥ svaiḥ svairmantrairbaliṃ kṣipet gaṇeśaṃ vīrabhadraṃ ca mātṝḥ śāstārameva ca saśūlacakravaradābhītimiṣṭvā baliṃ kṣipet gopuradvāri saṃpūjyaiṣāṃ baliṃ kṣipet āyāntu pārṣadāḥ sarve śāṅkarā vaiṣṇavāśca ye nandīśādibhyaḥ kumudādibhya eva ca nandīśaśca mahākālo bhūtanātho mahīdharaḥ puṇḍarīko'tha vāmanaḥ tatastu balipīṭhe tu bhūtidādibhya eva ca musaline pāśine'ṅkuśine tathā pīṭhābjakarṇikāyāṃ baliṃ kṣipet nityotsavavidhistveṣa tulyaścāpi mahotsave svanāmnaiva baliṃ ca vikiret tataḥ mahākālo vidhātā ca vajrapāṇiḥ kratu(ḥ?) prabhuḥ vidyutprabhaścaiva śūlahastastrilocanaḥ mahāvīryo nityayogaḥ prasādanaḥ aśvagrīvo'śvavadano hyaśvajihvo'śvalocanaḥ kandaḥ kandukalocanaḥ

pāṇḍupṛṣṭhaśca durdinaḥ sudinastathā bhāvano bhagavān bhavaḥ viśvasenaśca viṣvakseno visāraṇaḥ kāmuko'kāmukaścaiva kāmahṛt kāmanāśanaḥ agniragnisamānaśca jvālāmālī ca viśvabhuk raktavapūrdhūmraḥ saptārcirviśvabheṣajaḥ yogapriyo dārujaścāpyāgneyo nidhanastathā maṇḍūrmaṇḍūkakākāsyau devo devalakastathā droṇamārīco mahiṣo bhīṣaṇastathā caiva matsarī maskarastathā siṃhamukhaścaiva nārasiṃho narastathā nālakarṇaścetyāgneyyāṃ diśi saptatiḥ pretādhipo dharmaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇākṣa eva ca kṛtāntaśca satyaḥ satyapriyaḥ suhṛt dharmajaścāpi dhanvī ca praśrayo nayaḥ niranukrośaḥ kubjaḥ pāṃsuvimardanaḥ saṃrakṣaṇastathā subhadraśca śārṅgī śārṅgadharastathā vallakīhasto dvirado vigraho'mbaraḥ rākṣasaścāsuraḥ kravyād vīrahā nir-ṛtistathā kaikaseyaḥ krūraḥ krūravapustathā vīrūpākṣo'tha bhasmāṅgaḥ sukṛtirvikṛtistathā māṃsakaściva rākṣaso rakṣakastathā vīraseno'kṣarāśaśca prāṇadaḥ praṇavastathā viśālākṣo raktajihvo vijihmakaḥ

sarvavid gauraḥ kāmarūpī virūpavān madanaścaiva vāruṇo vasureva ca varuṇa ityete nair-ṛte sthitāḥ pāśapāṇirānando'mbupatiḥ śivaḥ pratyaṅnivāso jalado jīvano nakravāhanaḥ kṣobhaṇaścaiva pāśī pāśadharo guruḥ bhadro vaikuṇṭhaḥ paramaḥ paraḥ vānarastārakaścaiva śaśakaḥ śākalaḥ śalaḥ [kh: vaḥ] kuravaścaiva vajranābho vināyakaḥ rodhano rodhastārkṣyo garuḍa eva ca vāyurgandhavahaḥ sūkṣmaḥ sparśanaśca prabhañjanaḥ kūrmo'tha kṛkaro devadatto dhanañjayaḥ marunmārutaśca vāto vahnisakho hariḥ baladhirvīro dvidhīro rodhako'pi ca sudhīścaiva samarthaḥ sāhaso dharaḥ rāgī secano'secanaḥ [g: secanasvanaḥ] svanaḥ karaṇaṃ kartā parādhīno balo'balaḥ somo māṇibhadro'tha guhyakaḥ kinnareśaścailabilirdhanadaśca dhanādhipaḥ uttarāśānivāsaśca tataḥ syādekakuṇḍalaḥ bhaṅgīraḥ surāṣṭraḥ kāṣṭhaliḥ kaliḥ cāmṛteśo'mbhaḥ keyurī kevalī valī nalakaḥ śunakaḥ krāthaḥ śyenaḥ śyenamukho'ruṇaḥ viśleṣaḥ kardamaḥ pūtivigrahaḥ uttarāśāsthitā hyete gaṇā haraharau smṛtāḥ

dhātā kapilaḥ piṅgalocanaḥ nīlagrīvaḥ kapardī ca vṛṣavāho vṛṣadhvajaḥ vaśī śambhurvivāsā vyasano budhaḥ brahmavid brahmo mārīco haripiṅgalaḥ sudṛṣṭiraṣṭātmā śaṅkaraḥ śāṅkarastathā sarvabhuk sarvo vinodī dīpakampakaḥ śikhaṇḍī cetyaiśānyāṃ saptatirgaṇāḥ praveśyāntaḥ snātvā prāgvad yajedapi prāgvad gaṇān sarvān visṛjya ca deśikādibhyo dakṣiṇāstadanantaram śaivoditakriyācakraṃ prāyastulyamihāpi hi pañcamasya tṛtīyakam lipisadīrghaṃ [k: repi] ca dvādaśasvaravān marut svarairyuto nādaḥ sāgniryukto hṛdādibhiḥ pūjāyāṃ śaktitāradvayādikā kanyākumāryaiśabdānte dhīmahīti padaṃ bhavet durgāgāyatrī pūjayedanayā śivām tāmagnivarṇāmagnetvaṃviśvānītyādikā tataḥ mantrādhvā durgāyāstantracoditaḥ svāsīnā sthitā vā mahiṣopari varadābhayaśaṅkhārihastā durgā caturbhujā śūleṣukhaḍgacakrāṇi dakṣiṇe'ṣṭabhujā yadā tathā vāme bibhratīmatha dakṣiṇe cādhaḥkarādyaṃ tu kuryād dvyaṣṭabhujā yadā kāryāḥ prāgvat kṣīratarūdbhavāḥ

subhadraśca sthāpyā vedādibhiḥ kramāt kumudā caiva vidyunmālā ca bhīṣaṇā syustatpatākāsu śaṅkhādya(trai? strai)stu cihnayet śra]ścātha pratidvāraṃ dve dve dūtyau krameṇa tu siṃhavaktrā cāpyaṣṭamī daityamardanī vikiravikṣepāt kumbhe siṃhagatāṃ śivām netramokṣaṃ jale vāsaṃ prāgvad grāmapradakṣiṇam kumbhāstranidrākhyamūrtikumbhāṣṭakārcanam kṣmādikāstvaṣṭau mūrtīśā dhārikādikāḥ vibhuśca jñānīṃ tu mūrtau pīṭhe kriyāṃ nyaset durgāmūlāṅgairātmatattvādibhiḥ kramāt pratiṣṭhāṃ lagne tu kuryād yuktapade guruḥ lauhīṃ durgāṃ tu śivavannyaset bhittāvālekhyagāṃ durgāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya sthiraṃ yajet ratnādipañcavargāṃśca nyaset pīṭhaṃ tathopari jñānātmikāṃ mūrtiṃ haṃsaṃ bījaṃ ca taddhṛdi cinmayīṃ śaktiṃ haṃsasaṃpuṭamadhyagam [k: ta] yojayenniṣkalāntaṃ tanmantramuccārayan sudhīḥ puṣpāñjalinā mūrtihṛtpaṅkaje nyaset sannidhāpyāmṛtīkṛtya cāvakuṇṭhya pracocya ca syāt padādhvā ca pañcadurgāpadairmataḥ prakṣālya salilairmūrtikumbhāstravāribhiḥ snātvā kṣālitapāṇyaṅghrirvighneśamabhipūjya tu dvāri jayāṃ ca vijayāmapi pārṣṇighātādibhirvighnān bhaumādīnapasārya tu

śastraprākāraṃ varmaṇā cāvakuṇṭhanam viśeṣārghyāt pañca śuddhirvidhāya ca prakṛtyai (ca) tato vajrāsanāya ca cāpi mahāpralayakāmapi avyaktaṃ niyatiṃ kālaṃ kalāṃ caindrādiṣu kramāt brahmaviṣṇuharavyāptapatrakesarakarṇikāḥ suprabhāṃ vijayāṃ dikṣu madhyataḥ sarvasiddhidām tatastu mūrttiṃ durgāyāḥ śaktidehaṃ ca mūlataḥ vyomāmbujasudhāsā[k: dhrā]racaitanyaparibṛṃhitām sthāpanādyairyathāpūrvamamṛtikaraṇāntakam arghyādyairupacāraistu yathāpūrvaṃ yajecchivām pīṭhaprānte'bjabāhye tu śaṅkhādyastrāṇyapi kramāt tato dikṣu mantrairlokeśadaivataiḥ siddhārthān pāyasaṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak pañcadurgābhirjuhuyād ghṛtam siṃhaṃ mātṝḥ svāśāsu vinyaset aṣṭottaraśatenāpi snapayitvā tu pūrvavat pañcadurgābhirmadhyamenābhiṣecayet saṃkalpya nityapūjādisiddhaye triṣṭupprabhṛtikān daurgān vanadurgādikāṃstu vā tattadvidhānatastvevaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yajanti cet nityotsave tu durgāyāḥ pūrvādidvārapālikāḥ jayantī ca kanyā vetrāsidhārikāḥ durgāpāriṣade ceti sarvatrāyojya nikṣipet hūṃ svāhā namaśceti baliṃ kṣipet

nikṣipeccaivaṃ siṃhikāyai baliṃ kṣipet hrādinyai cāpi mādinyai dvāryantargopurasya tu pīṭhāgrataḥ sthitvā mantramenamudīrayet durgāpāriṣadāḥ sarve gṛhṇantūpahṛtaṃ balim virajā mandarā vindhyavāsinī vikīryātha balipīṭhe'tha nikṣipet hemavarṇā ca kṛttikā cābhayapradā pīṭhamadhye cāsāṃ tasyai baliṃ kṣipet lekhyaḥ siṃhaḥ pūjyaśca mantrataḥ pratidiśaṃ tāśca sahasragaṇanāyikāḥ pūrvasyāmathāgneyyāṃ mahābalā yāmye ghoṣaṇī nandanī smṛtiḥ saptaitāstvaṣṭamī cāsyāṃ mahāsuravimardanī gaurī caṇḍā caṇḍī ca khaḍginī bhadrakālī vāruṇī cāmṛtāmbikā bhairavī prāṇā cetanā vāyugocare adbhutā ca madā cāṣṭau kauberyāṃ diśi nāyikāḥ śūlinī cāpyaṣṭamī syāt sarasvatī bāhyato dikṣu gaṇebhyaḥ pūrvavad balim kramānmantraiḥ pūrvoktairvikired balim daivatānāṃ ca bhedaḥ kaścid bhavediha tu citrā(tu? yāṃ) vaiśākhe ca viśākhabhe mahānavamyāṃ śaradi paurṇamāsyāṃ ca kārttike kāryo durgāyāstuṣṭaye nṛbhiḥ dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalaṃ sarvamabhīṣṭaṃ sulabhaṃ bhavet

taduktaṃ hi śaivānusārāt tanmūlabījaṃ prāgeva śaktisaṃjñaṃ pradarśitam sasūkṣmo'gnistato rudrapadaṃ ca dayitepadam saṃyutaḥ netrāśviśaravedāśvinetrasvārṇaiḥ svajātibhiḥ tṛtīyaṃ tu pañcamasvarasaṃyutam kāmaśabdau ca mālinyai ceti dhīmahi gaurīgāyatrī viniyogo'rcanādiṣu sapāśā sābhayā?ṅkuśā maṇikuṇḍalamaṇḍitā hemāṅgadollasadratnavalayāṅguliveṣṭanā nakharatnāṃśuvilasatpadābjāsaktanūpurā vaṃsvarū]rūpā manonmanyā gauryāstu pratimā bhavet śaivoktamārgeṇa sthāpayecchivām ṣoḍaśastambhayuktaḥ syādadhivāsanamaṇḍapaḥ bhadraśca vijayaścaiva vijṛmbho lohitastathā prācyāmajitā cāparājitā kumudāṃ caiva vidyunmālāṃ vibhūṣaṇām dvārdhvajayordūtyau yajet kumbhagate kramāt ghaṭe gaurīṃ siṃhe'straṃ vardhanīgatam pīnottuṅgastanaṃ śyāmaṃ bhūṣitaṃ satrilocanam piṅgordhvakeśaṃ nānāhibhūṣaṇaṃ saumyabhīṣaṇam madhyakuṇḍasthaśaivāgniṃ navadhā saṃvibhajya tu mūlāṅgairjuhuyurgurumūrtipāḥ grāmabhramaṇaṃ snapanaṃ tathā

pañcabhūtātmake devīṃ śāyayitvābhīpūjayet gaurīkumbhaṃ śiraḥsthāne nidrākumbhaṃ ca vinyaset gāyatrīṃ sāvitrīṃ ca sarasvatīm tribhāgeṣvapi ca nyasyet tattvaṃ tattveśvarān kramāt krameṇa hutvaibhyaḥ spṛśeyurgurumūrtipāḥ ratnādipañcavargāṃśca pīṭhaṃ cātha svamūlataḥ tacchaktibījaṃ tu vinyasya snapayet tataḥ mūlāṅgagāyatryā mantrādhvā syācca tatpadaiḥ pradhānanidrākhyamūrtikumbhābhiṣecitām snātvā prakṣālya caraṇāvācamya sakalīkṛta vijayā dvāri sthite vetrakare bhuvi kṣiptanārācaḥ praviśyāstraṃ nidhāya ca mūlāṅgapūritārghyaḥ san tilakī puṣpaśekharaḥ [he] siṃhāsanaṃ dhyātvā pādān dharmādikānapi patrādiṣu tataḥ śaktīrvāmādyāḥ kesarāgragāḥ mantradehaṃ ca cicchaktiṃ svāddhṛdambujāt caiva sānnidhyaṃ sannirodhaṃ prarocanam ceśānādīni kāsyahṛddaśanāṅghriṣu karālikāṃ cāpi mahocchuṣmāṃ ca kādiṣu sāvitrīṃ stanayorvinyaset tataḥ patreṣvaṅgāvṛtiṃ ceṣṭvā bāhye dūtyaṣṭakaṃ yajet bhuvanapālikā gandhapuṣpādyairdvāḥsthāścāpi jayādikāḥ vighnaṃ tato mātṝḥ śāstṛskandau niśākaram saṃsthāpya dikpālebhyo juhoti ca

darbhamālāparikṣiptāṃ svāstīrṇāmadhiropya tu ārdraikavasanāḥ sarve vaheyuḥ śastrajāpinaḥ grāmāderbāhyato dure nadyādestu samīpataḥ darbhairāstīrya parito vāmāste pāntu mantrataḥ śośucadayātsvasidbhirvādayantu ca saumyāstān [ntā] nirvārya punarnayet yāmyottarāyāmāṃ khātvā vasvavaṭaṃ bhuvi udakcitāyā vedāśraṃ kuṇḍaṃ kṛtvaikamekhalam hastamātraṃ ṣaḍaṃśoccaṃ suliptaṃ tattrayaṃ bhavet prādakṣiṇyaṃ tato gatvā sacive sthaṇḍilasya tu cātmānaṃ sā(dha? da)yitvāstravardhanī pāśupataṃ tatra vardhanyāṃ vikiropari pṛthvyādīnāṃ tu tanmadhye pārthive pañcakoṣṭhake koṣṭhacatuṣkeṣu marudrakṣogniśūlinām tadastrāṇi caturdikṣu vyutkrameṇābhipūjya tu bhasmavikīrya śivamarcayet kāṣṭhakīlānadhovaktrān raktasūtraniveṣṭitān kuśapuṣpatilākṣataiḥ pūtaṃ sthāpayed bhasmanāpi ca dhāraṇāśuddhe saṃhāriṇyā tu mudrayā nirūpyāsya kāsyahṛnnābhiguhyakāḥ śivaṃ ca vinyasya caitanyasthitaye tataḥ niyojya sampūjya śivādyāvāhanādikam janmādhikārabhogāntāṃ snātaśuddhiṃ ca niṣkṛtim kāraṇapādāna(?)madhikārārpaṇaṃ tathā

yāmyaśiraskaṃ tamāropyācchādya cendhanaiḥ prakṣipya mainamagnyādimantrataḥ śirasyasya pūrṇāṃ cānena pātayet mantrasampūtāṃ śāvyāmenāṃ mahāhutim sūryaṃ te cakṣurityādyāḥ ṣaḍṛcaḥ prajapedapi tāvadhovaktrau vahnau nikṣipya karkarīm tatsalilaiḥ snātaḥ pūrvasthāne vinikṣipet dhātāpunātvā(dyāḥ dyaiḥ)snātvā tīre kuśāstṛte dadyānmantrairebhistribhiḥ kramāt snātvodvayādyena samupasthāya bhāskaram saṃskartṛpūrvakāḥ śiṣyaputrapatnyādayo'pi ca tadāśaucaṃ sakṛdbhaktaṃ divaiva tu nu)yānādikaṃ kṛtvā sparśaṃ vāsya guroryadi daśabhirmātṛ(pitṛ)bhrātṛsutādayaḥ pañcame vāhni navamaikādaśāhayoḥ tadarthaṃ tu kuryuḥ sarve'sya bāndhavāḥ payasā cādbhistasminnasthīni nikṣipet naivaurdhvadehikāpekṣā mumukṣoriha vidyate pratidinamekottaravivṛddhitaḥ śrāddhīni da[sa]ttvāthaikādaśe dine brāhmaṇaṃ tvekaṃ varayitva śivā(stra? jña)yā[yam] darbheṣūpaveśyābhipūjya ca apūpavyañjanānnādyaṃ nyaset paridhibāhyataḥ dakṣiṇāgrāṃstu teṣu pātraṃ tu sādayet preta ityādyāt syāt svadhāgrahaḥ

nimittabhūtāyāṃ strīśabdāntamudīrayet somadevatyāt tilāṃśca madhuvātataḥ saṃśodhya yatkiñciccaitaduddharet poṣoktyāsminnāvāhayed dvijaiḥ sadarbhapāṇibhyāṃ taddakṣiṇakaraṃ spṛśet bhavāṃśceti prāpnavānīti so'pi ca dadyāt pretāya svadhānama-iti bruvan ādyād rakṣāyai sarvato'pi ca syānmantraḥ stryanto bhavet striyāḥ tasmai dadyāt tu dakṣiṇām tat sarvamamuṣmai saṃpradāya tu avāritaṃ tadannādyaṃ dattvā copavaset svayam copavaset kartā bhuñjīyāccāpare'hani ekoddiṣṭavidhānena dadyācca prativāsaram pratimāsaṃ tathā śrāddhaṃ piṇḍānapi ca nirvapet dvādaśa śrāddhaiḥ * * piṇḍāṃśca ṣoḍaśa saṅkalpya pūrvedyurviśiṣṭān varayed dvijān śucibhiḥ snātaiḥ brāhmaṇaiścarupākavat dakṣiṇatastadvaduttare laukikānalam pādaśaucādikaṃ kṛtvā prāṅmukhāvupaveśayet yavāmbunārghye saṃpādya sudhāṃ smṛtvā tu nikṣipet pitāmahāyātha tatpitre ca dvijāstrayaḥ vaṃśaśrutācārasaṃpannāḥ śivatatparāḥ devāṃśakalpitaṃ yat tat pātre kṣiptvābhidhārya tu darśayeccātha prācīnāvītamudvahan

udīratāmavarataḥ pitaraśśabdasaṃyutān dakṣiṇāgreṣu darbheṣu pṛthak pātrāṇi sādayet pātreṣu pitrādibhyaḥ svadhāṃ kramāt madhu somasya tviṣirāditaḥ āgacchantu pūrveṇa pitrādyākhyāpurassaram saṃpūjya darbhairācchādya dhautapādān dvijāṃstu tān darbhāsaneṣūpaveśya sarvāṃstānuttarāmukhān yāmye[kh: myena vi]'gnāviddhetvāgnimukhāntaram apūpamaṣṭadhā kṛtvā somāyetyādināṃśataḥ trikhaṇḍāni srucamādāya vai tataḥ juhuyāt pitṛtarpaṇapūrvakaiḥ bandhūnāṃ varṣe varṣe tu taddine athāṣṭakāśrāddhavidhiḥ kathyate'tra samāhitaḥ nityanaimittikānāṃ tu prāyaścittaṃ nigadyate kaniṣṭhasnapanaiḥ snapayet pūjayedapi hanti devasya rājñaḥ śaktiṃ ca hāpayet dhūpadīpavihīnaṃ yadarcanaṃ rogaduḥkhadam rāṣṭre balicchede prajākṣayaḥ vicchede rājñaḥ kartuśca nāśanam pramodād vāthavā vighnāt pūjādehiha vicyutau vṛṣayāgavihīne tu gavāṃ nāśo bhaved yataḥ dhvajahīnotsave rājñaḥ śatrupīḍā bhaved yataḥ tu dhvajasyaiśe kuṇḍe'gnau vṛṣamantrataḥ syād rājādīnāmamaṅgalam tu rāṣṭre rakṣā vinaśyati

vinā rogo rāṣṭre bhavati śāntaye vinā rāṣṭraṃ jalābhāvena pīḍyate dhvajāvarohaṇe hīne pīḍayeccaṇḍamārutaḥ utsavāvāhitānāṃ tu gaṇānāmavisarjane gaṇān sarvānabhipūjya visarjayet yānāde rājarāṣṭrādināśakṛt saṃveṣṭya samālipya ca tat sthalam beraṃ ca tatraiva vidhinārcayet nivedyātrāgnimādhāya prācyāṃ nāmāntasaṃskṛte sadyāntairgāyattryā śvetasarṣapaiḥ hutvāthādhāraśaktyādimantraiścāpi digīśvaraiḥ tilājyābhyāṃ śataṃ hutvā jayādiṃ niṣkṛtiṃ tathā gajo hiraṇyaṃ ca mahiṣyo mahiṣānvitāḥ rūpyaṃ ca dakṣiṇāḥ kathitāḥ kramāt patitaṃ bhinnaṃ tatroktāt tu caturguṇam pratiṣṭhāpya yātrāśeṣaṃ pravartayet gauravānuguṇena tu dakṣiṇāṃ cāpi dattvā pūjāṃ pravartayet | liṅge tu mānuṣe paścāt pratiṣṭhāmeva kārayet jīrṇasthāpanamātreṇa snapayitvā tu pūjayet saṃhitāmantraistatra hutvā śataṃ śatam snapanārthaṃ tu kalaśe kalaśeṣu vā astreṇājyaśataṃ hutvā teṣu saṃpātayed ghṛtam prāṅgaṇe vāpi mṛte vā rudhirakṣate sṛgālairvā gṛghrolūkaiśca gardabhaiḥ

bhuvaṃ khātvā dvihastaṃ parito'pyatha bhasma ca parityajya gomūtreṇābhipūrya tu gobhirākrāmayeccāṣṭamṛdbhirāpūrayedapi | dakṣiṇe'rdhendukuṇḍe'gnau saṃskṛte cāhite śive siddhārthāṃśca kramādaṣṭasahasraṃ tu pṛthak pṛthak samadhurā dūrvāḥ pāyasaṃ ca(ravaḥ? caruṃ) kramāt taddaśāṃśena sarvadravyairjuhoti ca pāṣaṇḍicaṇḍālaśvādispṛṣṭe'bhicārakaiḥ kṛtvātha kośaṃ tu kṛtvā yajñatarūdbhavam ca tāloccaṃ kṛtvā nīrandhramāhitam kaṣāyairaṣṭamṛdbhiśca gandhatīrthodakairapi mṛtyuñjayena mūlāṅgai rudraiśca pavamānakaiḥ sapta doṣagauravayuktitaḥ kṛtvā puṇyāhavācanam tathā rajasvalāsparśe juhotyaśucaye'gnaye mūrtidharo gururvā saṃsthito yadi agnyāditisṛbhiḥ saṃhitāstraiśca pūrvavat brāhmaṇādibhyaḥ pradeyaṃ syādavāritam uktahomādivicchede tatrāpyuktaprakārataḥ atha prāsādahārāsu valmīkaṃ vāthavā madhu viśeyurvā vimāne vāśaniḥ patet jāteṣu dhūmaketūdgamādiṣu vā śakracāpodgame niśi kṛtvā saviśeṣaṃ śivaṃ yajet alaṅkṛtya tu puṇyāhaṃ vikirakṣepapūrvakam

ṣaḍaṅgamūlenāṅgaiśca tadvarṇavihitaiḥ kramāt vighnamiṣṭvārghyamāpūrya tilakī puṣpaśekharaḥ evaṃ dhyātvā tu mūlāṅgaiḥ sakalīkṛtya pūjayet taddikṣu tadbāhye daśalokapān lakṣmīdevīsahādūrvākrāntyekādaśapaṅkajaiḥ rocanāgarukarpūramāṃsīkuṅkumacandanaiḥ tīrthasalilairbilvapatraiśca gharṣayet hemakumbhe'dbhirhemaratnādipūritaiḥ śivamāvāhya tasmin sampūjya lagnake yathāpūrvaṃ mukhyādisnapanena tu atha svinne saniṣṭhīve liṅge dhūmoṣmapīḍite dārumaye kośe pañcagavyaiḥ pṛthak kramāt candanādyairapyavaghṛṣyābhiṣicya tu vidhāyārghyādibhiḥ samyagabhyarcya tu sadāśivam snapanānāmekatamenopapattyābhiṣecayet vikīrya bhūtebhyo dattvānnādyaṃ ca dakṣiṇāḥ āvāhitaśivasyāgnernirvāṇe pūrvavat kramāt samittilacarūṃścāstrāt kṛṣṇādaṣṭasahasakam śive'gni * * naṃ spṛṣṭvā yadi syuḥ śivavahnayaḥ laukikāgnerdavāgnervā saṃsarge śucaye'gnaye aśuddhadravyasamparke * * jantau sahasrakam tathā hutvā raktānnena baliṃ niśi kṛtvāstrayāgaṃ tu saviśeṣaṃ śivaṃ yajet itthaṃ hi sarvadevānāṃ prāyaścittaṃ pṛthak pṛthak svasvatantroditaiścāpi samitprabhṛtibhistathā

yathāpūrvaṃ kṛtvā saṃpad vivardhate cāpi doṣāṇāṃ kāmānāṃ cāpyavāptaye uttarāyaṇasaṃsthe'rke'pyathavā doṣasaṃbhave caiva mahatīṃ śambhoḥ pūjāṃ pravartayet catuṣkālaṃ nityādaṣṭaguṇādhikam prakṛtiprasthataṇḍulaiḥ sādhitena tu sarvairbalimantrairyathākramam gaṇebhyo balimādarāt mṛṣṭānnaṃ pradadyādanivāaritam sutārorayajayapradaḥ āyuśśrīvardhanaścāsmāt kartavyo bhūtaye nṛbhiḥ vijayaśrīvardhanaḥ kīrtitaḥ sphuṭite bhinne calite patite hṛte ajñānādadhike vonamāne liṅge tu mānuṣe mantrāstalliṅgaṃ devaścāpi yataḥ sphuṭam talliṅgamāśrayantīha piśācā brahmarākṣasāḥ sakale'pi ca tulyāḥ syurete doṣāstathaiva hi doṣāstulyāstyājyāstatastu tāḥ bālālayaṃ mūle pañcāṃśe tu tribhāgataḥ tu paścimadvāre syānnair-ṛtyāṃ tu vānile śayanaṃ saṅkalpyoktavidhānataḥ dāravaṃ liṅgaṃ sapīṭhaṃ sumanoramam toraṇadvāralokeśakalaśārcanapūrvakam haimādyanyatamaṃ kumbhaṃ śayyāyāṃ vinidhāya tuṃ mūlāṅgabrahmamantrāṃśca vyomavyāpidvayaṃ tathā

yathāpūrvaṃ saṃspṛśya prajapecca tān yātrāhomaṃ tu mūlāṅgaiḥ kuryād garbhasya pūrvataḥ bho bhoḥ sattvena yenedaṃ duṣṭaliṅgaṃ samāśritam yathāpūrvaṃ vidyāvidyeśvarairyutaḥ ityuktvārghyaṃ ca dattvāsmāt piśācādīn visarjayet svenaiva ṣaḍaṅgāni svajātibhiḥ saṃsmṛtya prārthayenmanunāmunā asyoddhārācchāntirastu sarvebhyo vyāpakeśvara ! devenādiṣṭaḥ śāntihomaṃ samācaret liṅgasañcalanārthaṃ tu sahasraṃ juhuyād ghṛtam juhoti kṣaireyyā tataḥ pāśupatāstrataḥ saṃprokṣya śāntikumbhādbhistattadbhāge tu saṃspṛśet pratiṣṭhā kālena yāvatā tasya śakyate tu saṃruddhairmūlāṅgairbrahmabhistathā tasmin samāvāhya saṃpūjyārghyādibhiḥ kramāt śirasaiva vahan gacchet prādakṣiṇyaṃ svayaṃ guruḥ brahmabhirdikṣu koṇeṣvaṅgairjuhoti ca prātarbālālaye lagne dāruliṅgaṃ sapiṇḍikam tu tatrasthamevaṃ vijñāpayecchivam dārumaye liṅge sānnidhyaṃ kuru śaṅkara ! mantrāṃśca dhyātvā tasmin ṣaḍadhvanaḥ caturthadivase snānaṃ navakena vidhāya tu caṇḍaṃ visṛjyāpsu vinikṣipet pīṭhaṃ ceduddhṛtyānyatra vinyaset haimarajjvā baddhvā vṛṣabhayojite

vidhistvevaṃ dārujaṃ cecchivāgninā avivarṇamuduṣṭaṃ cet tadeva sthāpayet punaḥ pratiṣṭhāpyārcayet kuryādālaye nūtanaṃ punaḥ nūtanānyuktamārgeṇa pratiṣṭhāpya tu pūjayet yathāpūrvaṃ mūlaliṅgaṃ niyojayet kṛtvādhivāsanādyaṃ tu sthāpayed garbhamandire (bā? mū)laliṅge tu pūrvavat sanniyojayet sarvāṃstu samāhṛtya yathākramam suniṣpanne tanmantrān pūrvavat kramāt daśaguṇāṃ jīrṇoddhāre tu dakṣiṇām liṅgibhyastakṣabhyo'rthibhya eva ca pratiṣṭhite yad vā prāsādakaraṇe phalam jjīrṇoddhārāvasānaṃ suraguruvibudhastaṃ kriyāpādamūce vairāgyād vairāgyaṃ ca svabhāvataḥ saṃsārastvātmabuddhiḥ syād dehe svatvena vastuṣu bhūtāni śrotrādyādhārakānyapi tvagasṛṅmāṃsamedosthimajjāśuklaiśca nāḍibhiḥ catuṣṣaḍaṣṭajagatīvikārākṣicchadāmbujaiḥ tattacchabdādayaḥ pañca mano buddhirahaṅkṛtiḥ śrotrādayaśca vāgādyāstathādhyātmāni vai pṛthak jalaṃ pṛthivī ca tathānalaḥ adhyātmāni mano buddhirahaṃkāraśca tattrayam viriñcaścāapyadhidaivā?nyanukramāt vidyāditattvāni māyāntānyakhilāni tu suṣuptiścetyavasthātritayaṃ tathā

vyāpye mohābdhau vyāpakāḥ smṛtāḥ ṣaḍvikārairadhyastamatinaśvaram saṃsāre bhramatyātmā hyalakṣitaḥ jarāyujānyaṇḍajāni svedajānyudbhidānyapi manuṣyāṇāṃ paśūnāṃ ca bhavanti hi jarāyujāścāṇḍajāśca dehāḥ syurjalacāriṇam svakarmavaśagā bhavanti na bhavanti ca tvagādhe bhavasāgare sarve svargabhūnarakādiṣu śarīre'smin saundaryaṃ smaryate kutaḥ māṃsakeśanakhasnāyurudhiratvaksamāvṛte yadvāpyajñānibhirdehe sukhabuddhyātra bhaṇyate yathāgītaṃ mattonmattapralāpavat tathopādherupādhyantarasaṅgamāt pāmakaṇḍūtisaukhyaṃ vā tattulyaṃ surate sukham unmattaceṣṭitānnṛttaṃ na kiñcidapi hīyate tvagasthimāṃsādau katarat syānmanoharam sauhityaṃ duḥkhāpāyo na tat sukham tadātmasukhamuddiṣṭaṃ karaṇānāṃ tu saṃhṛtau vanādau ca prāptuṃ tacchakyate sukham parairyantritasyeva pakṣiṇaḥ rāgādyākrāntacittasya kutaḥ saukhyaṃ śarīriṇaḥ prakṣīṇendriyavṛttestu rogarāgādyupadravaiḥ yad duḥkhe narake'pi na tad bhavet patatāṃ patitānāṃ patiṣyatām

puṇyakṛdeva syāt svarge devādidehavān tvalpāṃ) śriyaṃ dīptāmanyeṣāmātmano'dhikām kṣīṇapuṇyānāṃ patanādyavalokya tu rājyādiṣu sukhaṃ syāccet sandhyādiduḥkhinaḥ tyāgenaivāmṛtatvaṃ hi prāptuṃ śakyaṃ manīṣibhiḥ trivargāṇāṃ dussaṃpādatayāpi ca paro yogaḥ sāṅgaḥ sādhyo vipaścitā muṇḍanānna syād daṇḍādergrahaṇādapi yadanyadapyevamādyaṃ dehasyoktaṃ na dehinaḥ veṣalaṅghanamātreṇa dehī mokṣaṃ kathaṃ vrajet kartā saṃskāryastatphalārthibhiḥ karmaṇāṃ nyāsaṃ sannyāsaṃ kavayo viduḥ svavarṇāśramayuktānāṃ tathā svasamayasya tu īśvarārpaṇabuddhyā tu karaṇaṃ nyāsa iṣyate nityasannyāsī yo na dveṣṭi na kāṅkṣati jaṭī vāpi dvidaṇḍo vātha [kh: sa] muṇḍitaḥ kṛtvā sāṅgayogaṃ samāśritaḥ yogamāha patañjaliḥ samuddiṣṭastathācāha mahāmuniḥ manaḥ kṛtvā svātmānaṃ paramātmani śivatvavyaktabhāvasya kaivalyaṃ yoga iṣyate rāgādyā yogāngānāṃ niṣevaṇāt yamāśca niyamāstadvadāsanaṃ prāṇasaṃyamāḥ pañcaprakārāḥ syurniyamāścaiva pañcadhā pañcavidhā dhāraṇā bahudhā smṛtāḥ

satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryāparigrahau manovākkarmabhihiṃsāstrividhāḥ prāṇināmiha satyaṃ yadā] bhūtānāṃ hitaṃ cet satyameva tat parigṛhītānāṃ tyaktānāṃ vāśramādiṣu parārthānāmanādānamasteyaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam tatrāpyupasthaviṣayanivṛttiṃ tu viśeṣataḥ yoṣitsaṃbhogavaimukhyaṃ brahmacaryaṃ paraṃ viduḥ ṛtusnātābhigamanaṃ brahmacaryaṃ paraṃ smṛtam asvīkaraṇamarthānāṃ mukhyaḥ syādaparigrahaḥ gṛhastho vā vānaprastho'thavā muniḥ asatpratigrahebhyastu nivṛttiraparigrahaḥ tadvadīśvarapūjeti pañca bhinnāstu te punaḥ acintanamakṛtyānāṃ yat tacchauca tu mānasam malānāṃ kṣālanañcāntaḥkaraṇasya viśodhanam varṇāśramādidharmāṇāmavirodhāgatena tu (ga)teṣvananuśokaḥ syād bhaviṣyārtheṣvalolatā harṣāgameṣvanutsekaḥ śokasthāneṣvaśokatā tathābhyāsastathopaniṣadāmapi nirdiṣṭastrividho'pi ca yoginām śarīrasya yattattapa udāhṛtam vratacoditakālāśī tapasvī yogabhāg bhavet coditārādhanaṃ śambhoryat tadīśvarapūjanam yajanaṃ karmaṇā manasāpi ca vasiṣṭhaśca yogācāryau mahāmunī

satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryaṃ dayārjavam āstikyaṃ dānamīśvarapūjanam āsanānyapi coktāni bahudhā pūrvapaddhatau padmasaṃjñaṃ ca bhadraṃ yogāsanaṃ tathā niviṣṭam tadāhuḥ prāṇasya dhāraṇaṃ dehe prāṇāyāma itīritaḥ kumbhakaścaiva recakaśceti te trayaḥ tribhiraṅgairyutastryaṃga syākutpūrakaṃ vinā (?) nirdiṣṭodghātamātrābhirvijñeyaḥ sa tu pūrakaḥ tiṣṭhed yadāsau kumbhakaḥ smṛtaḥ krameṇa yo mokṣo recakaḥ paripaṭhyate ṣaṣṭimātraḥ syāt pañcoddhātastu saṃsmṛtaḥ hyayaṃ mando madhyo'smād dviguṇo bhavet sagarbhāśca prāṇāyāmāstu te smṛtāḥ antarjapavihīnā ye te tvagarbhā iti smṛtāḥ kumbhīkṛtyodare vāyuṃ svasvamantraṃ dhiyā japet svamantraścet tasya syād dviśataṃ japaḥ hāpayi]tvāyataprāṇaḥ prāṇāyāmaṃ samācaret vidhātavyāstattaddhyānopabṛṃhitāḥ śarīrādadhikaṃ prāṇaḥ syād dvādaśāṅgulam sa ca tryaśro devādīnā nṛṇāmapi catuṣpadānāṃ hṛnmadhye kroḍamadhye'ṇḍajanmanām nābhicakraṃ tadūrdhvaṃ tu dvādaśāramasusthitiḥ prasuptabhujagākārā caturaṅgulavistṛtā

aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyāḥ syustāsāṃ mukhyāstu nāḍayaḥ piṅgā suṣumnā ca gāndhārī hastijihvikā piṅgalā ca suṣumnā cottamāḥ smṛtāḥ vimalā ghoṣaṇī pṛthvī tatastvāpyāyanī matā mṛdvaṅgī snaṃsanī? cāpi marśanī hṛtpadmagata āsanāddhṛdayasthitiḥ kurute nityaṃ ya(syā? smāt) prāṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | hānopādānakarmā ca tasmād vyāna iti smṛtaḥ gātranetravikārādyaṃ karmodānasya tu smṛtam tvagasṛṅmāṃsamedosthisaṃsthā nāgādivāyavaḥ nīlendragopagokṣīravidyudarkendusaprabhāḥ nāgasya kūrmasyonmīlanādikam śo(bhā? ṣādyaṃ) mṛtaṃ ca na vimuñcati bindormūrdhānamāsādya brahmarandhreṇa nirgatā sthite vāmadakṣiṇaprāṇayoḥ sṛte [kh: smṛ] vāmāṅghreraṅguṣṭhāgrād vinirgatā tvadho nābheḥ pāyumūlāntanirgamā | nāḍayo vimalādyāstu daśa hastāgranirgatāḥ viśvodarodaraṃ yātā sarasvatyapi meḍhragā tāḥ sarvāḥ padmatantuvi * * * bahirnirgatāgrā romasaṃjñāḥ śarīragāḥ koṭyo'rdhakoṭiśca keśaromāṇi dehagāḥ tu tato'rdhārdhaṃ sirāromāṇi saṃkhyayā sarve te prāṇinaḥ [nā] smṛtāḥ sevyāni tāni viditāni yathopadeśam

śuśrūṣārthapradānādyairārādhya paritoṣya ca guruṇā gatvā deśaṃ manoramam vātha prājya[k: ṇya]mūlaphalodake yogī nissaṃgo vijitendriyaḥ yuktasvapnāvabodhanaḥ picutūlādisaṃpūrṇa āsane sottaracchade cātha namaskṛtya tataḥ śivau matimān na drutaṃ na vilambitam hṛtkaṇṭhatālubhrūmadhyabrahmarandhrasthitāḥ kramāt vāmanāsāpuṭenātha pūrayenmarutodaram nirundhyānnirgamaṃ tasya kumbhakākhyaḥ sa tu smṛtaḥ vāmaghrāṇaṃ tu dakṣiṇenaiva recayet dvyaṣṭamātrābhirnābhipadme caturmukham catuṣṣaṣṭimātrāmātraṃ tu dhārayet śaṅkhacakradharaṃ saumyaṃ samādhisthaṃ caturbhujam makāramūrtiṃ tu bhrūmadhyakamale smaran eṇaṭaṅkadharaṃ saumyamindumauliṃ kapardinam vāyuṃ samāpūrya bhruvo'ntarāt japenmātratrayādhikam bhūtaśuddhyuktamārgeṇa prāṇāyāmāstu pañca te sandhyayorvāyumākṛṣya piban vāggmī ca jāyate mūrdhnyathātmānamādhāyāpūrya mārutam visṛjed vāyuṃ bādhiryādeṣa mucyate rujā dehe tatra tatra tu mārutam samutkṛṣya vahnisthāne niyojayet

nābherāmūrdhato vīṇādhvanirnādaḥ pravartate tasyātha prāṇo'pyuccaratīcchayā janayecchaśvadahorātre tu saṃkhyayā ghaṭikānāṃ smṛtaḥ ṣaṣṭyā tvahorātrastu mānuṣaḥ nābhipadme dhyātvā tu caturānanam dhiyaiva praṇavaṃ japan hṛdayābjasthaṃ vāsudevaṃ caturbhujam caturbāhumudārasthamukāramayavigraham vidhāya syāt prāṇāyāmastu vaiṣṇavaḥ rudraṃ dhyāyaṃstrilocanam pūrakādyairyathāpūrvaṃ raudro'yaṃ prāṇasaṃyamaḥ proktarūpādiṃ dhyāyaṃstāraṃ japan dhiyā mūrdhni kamale dhyāyan devaṃ sadāśivam sarvadoṣaharo'yaṃ syāt sādeśaḥ prāṇasaṃyamaḥ sarvakalmaṣadoṣaghnāḥ sarve sarvārthasādhakāḥ hṛtpadmamadhye vā vi(ndū? ndau) vā vyomapaṅkaje puryaṣṭakāṣṭacchadane svasvāṅgāvaraṇānvite japan buddhyā pūrakādikrameṇa tu hṛdayābjādau paśyañ jyotirnirañjanam dhyāyaṃstrimātraṃ cinmātrapraṇavaṃ vā dhiyā japan kuṇḍalinyāstu dhyāyañcchaktiṃ vinirgatām paramāmṛtaniḥṣyandaiḥ plāvyamānāṃ tato'pi hi suṣumnayordhvaṃ gacchantīmamṛtāsāravarṣiṇīm japan dhiyā yathāpūrvaṃ prāṇānāyamya yogavit praṇavādyāṃ tu saptavyāhṛtipūrvikām

paramātmānaṃ sāvitrīṃ sūryameva vā kurvan yogī siddhimavāpnuyāt manovākkarmajānīha pātakāni vināśayet aṣṭottarasatasyāpi (?) bhrūṇahatyāṃ ca nāśayet balādāharaṇaṃ teṣāṃ pratyāhāraṃ pracakṣate hṛdyanuṣṭhānaṃ pratyāhāraṃ vidurbudhāḥ sthāpanaṃ kecit pratyāhāraṃ vadanti hi kaṭistataḥ kando nābhī hṛdayavakṣasī cāṣṭādaśaiteṣu sthānāt sthānaṃ krameṇa tu rogaśāntiḥ syādāyuṣo vardhanaṃ tathā ātmanyavasthitiṃ buddherdhāraṇaṃ sampracakṣate kāraṇeśvarān tu tatraiva pratītyantaravarjitām praṇavākṣarasambhedāt kṣityādyairmaṇḍalākṣaraiḥ svamātmānaṃ sarvagaṃ? sarvavedinā sakalaṃ dhyānaṃ nirākāraṃ tu niṣkalam bhedairiṣṭasurākārasmaraṇaṃ hṛdayādiṣu bhruvormadhye bindau vā dvādaśāntage kadambagolakākāraṃ bhābhāsitadigantaram dvādaśāntasthaśivenāpyekatāṃ gatam vyāptaṃ dhyāyenniścalamānasaḥ ta]tayuktātmā yogī nirdhūtabandhanaḥ ṣaḍūrmibhirasaṃspṛṣṭo maitrādiguṇavarjitaḥ pāśān paraṃ nirvāṇamṛcchati dvādaśakāyāmaḥ samādhirbhavati sphuṭam

tadvacchivāhvayaṃ brahma paraṃjyotiḥ sunirmalam avasthātrayanirmuktaṃ ṣaḍbhāvavikṛteḥ param ākāśādimahābhūtaiḥ śabdādyairviṣayairapi ca purogābhyāmavidyayā sādeśeśvaravidyābhiḥ śaktyā cākhilakāraṇam sūkṣmaṃ tad yo'haṃ so'hamityapi cittaṃ sarvatra samadarśanāt śaśvat samādhiḥ paramaḥ smṛtaḥ karmaputrārthavarjanāt cinmātre śivenaikyena bhāvanā * ta eva vā miṣato mīlitākṣasya tiṣṭhataḥ yadā cetaḥ samādhisthasya niścalam jñeyastadvān yogīndra ucyate aṣṭaiśvaryaguṇā yogasyāntarāyā bhavanti hi tasmāt tadabhirocayet yogaśāstrebhyaḥ śivānugrahataḥ sphu(ṭam) tāmīśānaśivo'bhyadhād suraguruḥ siddhāntatāpaddhatim
